jobs.description:
Research Operations Director

Job Code: RESE21072

Job Family: Research Compensation Band: Band N FLSA: Exempt

JOB SUMMARY

The Research Operations Director leads the strategic and operational support of research initiatives across global health, and development sectors. The Director oversees the operational execution of a diverse research portfolio, ensuring projects are delivered on time and in compliance with ethical standards. They lead efforts to optimize workflows, manage shared resources, and interface with operations and enterprise services across the organization to support research initiatives.

RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES

Complexity & Problem Solving:

This role requires advanced problem-solving skills to navigate complex regulatory environments, multi-country research logistics, and evolving donor requirements. The Director identifies operational bottlenecks, develops scalable solutions, and ensures alignment with FHI 360’s mission and compliance standards.

  • Designing and implementing systems that streamline research operations across diverse geographies.
  • Anticipating and mitigating risks related to research implementation, ethics, and data security.
  • Driving innovation in research support services, including digital tools and process automation.
  • undefined

Expertise & Influence:

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Director develops systems and processes to support research implementation and oversight. They influence strategic decisions related to research infrastructure, compliance, and capacity building. Their work directly impacts the organization’s reputation to deliver high-quality, compliant and ethical research on all its projects, across segments and portfolios.

Key Accountabilities Include:

  • Leading the revision and enforcement of SOPs in conjunction with our Office of International Research Ethics, safeguarding and data security/privacy teams.
  • Serves as an integral part of discussions with new and continuing research partners,

potential funders, and in leadership meetings across the organization and externally

  • Provides oversight to the development and execution of research project plans, ensuring adherence to SOPs, guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
  • undefined

Collaboration & Interaction:

This role requires extensive collaboration across internal departments (e.g., Research, Legal, Finance, HR, IT) and with external stakeholders including donors and regulatory bodies. The Director communicates with clarity and diplomacy, often engaging with VP-level leaders and cross-functional teams to align research operations with strategic goals.

Responsibilities include:

  • Facilitating cross-functional working groups to support research project lifecycles.
  • Building strong relationships with country offices to ensure local context is integrated into operational planning.
  • Mentoring mid-level managers and fostering a culture of collaboration and accountability.
  • Implementing project management tools and dashboards to track progress and performance.
  • Leading post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and inform future practices.
  • Embraces other duties as assigned, contributing to the team’s multifaceted and evolving responsibilities.
  • undefined

Task Management & Efficiency:

  • May supervise direct reports.
  • Overseeing research teams and managing operations.
  • Provide leadership for vendor identification and selection, ensuring proper oversight and performance management.
  • Embraces other duties as assigned, contributing to the team’s multifaceted and evolving responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Understanding of global research operations, including IRB processes, donor compliance, and international research regulations.
  • Expertise in operational strategy, risk management, and quality assurance in research settings.
  • Strong leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and data systems used in research environments.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Project, Excel, and Word, with experience using project management software.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or its international equivalent in Public Health, Social Sciences, Research Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in operations or project management
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-country portfolios.
  • Fluent in English language.
  • Experience in NGO or non-profit research settings.
  • Relevant degree or its international equivalent, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience to perform job responsibilities effectively.
  • undefined

Certifications:

  • Project Management (PM) certification preferred but not required.

Preferred Qualifications:

5 years’ experience in a leadership role is preferred

We welcome candidates with other relevant certifications or their international equivalents.

TRAVEL

5-10%

TYPICAL PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Typical office environment. Constantly uses a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer. Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

TECHNOLOGY

Computer/Laptop, Microsoft applications (i.e., Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams), cell phone/mobile technology, and standard office equipment.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Chief Client Officer is responsible for leading the organization's client strategy, relationship management, and client success functions across all segments. The role focuses on driving long-term client value, satisfaction, retention, and growth by ensuring exceptional service delivery and deep, trusted client relationships. The CCO acts as the executive voice of the client within the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Relationship Management

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive client strategy aligned with business goals.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key clients and strategic accounts.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for high-value client issues and engagements.

Client Growth & Retention

  • Drive client retention, loyalty, and expansion across portfolios.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing client base.
  • Develop strategies to increase client lifetime value (CLV).

Client Experience & Success

  • Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality client experience across all touchpoints.
  • Oversee client onboarding, engagement, and success management processes.
  • Implement frameworks to measure and improve client satisfaction (NPS, CSAT).

Account Management & Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee key account management teams and client delivery functions.
  • Ensure client expectations are met through effective service delivery.
  • Coordinate resolution of complex client issues with internal teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales, operations, product, marketing, and support teams.
  • Ensure client feedback is integrated into product development and service improvements.
  • Align internal teams around client needs and priorities.

Client Insights & Analytics

  • Analyze client behavior, feedback, and performance data.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to improve client engagement and satisfaction.
  • Provide actionable insights to executive leadership.

Business Development Support

  • Support sales teams in acquiring high-value clients and strategic accounts.
  • Participate in client pitches, presentations, and negotiations.
  • Strengthen executive-level client relationships during pre- and post-sales cycles.

Governance & Reporting

  • Establish KPIs for client success, retention, and growth.
  • Provide regular reports and updates to CEO and executive leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and contractual obligations.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and mentor client success, account management, and service teams.
  • Build a client-centric culture across the organization.
  • Drive continuous training and professional development initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or related field; MBA preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in client management, account management, customer success, or senior leadership roles.
  • Proven track record of managing enterprise or high-value client relationships.
  • Strong experience in service delivery, relationship management, or client success leadership.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Strong strategic and commercial thinking.
  • Customer-centric leadership mindset.
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills.
  • Executive presence and stakeholder management.

Performance Metrics

  • Client retention and churn rate.
  • Client satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  • Revenue growth from existing clients.
  • Success of key account management initiatives.
  • SLA adherence and service quality performance.

If you want, I can also create:

  • LinkedIn Boolean search for Chief Client Officers
  • Yes/No prerequisite screening questions
  • MCQ knockout questions
  • Short LinkedIn job post version
  • Industry-specific versions (banking, SaaS, consulting, fintech)

Position Overview

The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision. The role focuses on identifying growth opportunities, driving transformation initiatives, improving competitive positioning, and ensuring alignment of all business units with corporate objectives. The CSO acts as a key advisor to the CEO and leadership team on strategic direction and enterprise-wide priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Strategy Development

  • Develop and execute the organization's short-, medium-, and long-term strategic plans.

Growth & Expansion Strategy

  • Support scalable and sustainable business growth strategies.

Business Transformation & Execution

  • Drive enterprise-wide transformation initiatives (digital, operational, organizational).
  • Translate strategic plans into actionable business roadmaps.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of industry trends, competitors, and macroeconomic factors.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve competitive advantage.
  • Identify risks and opportunities impacting business performance.

Mergers, Acquisitions & Partnerships

  • Lead or support M&A strategy, due diligence, and integration planning.

Performance Monitoring & KPIs

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with finance, operations, HR, marketing, product, and technology teams.
  • Ensure alignment of departmental strategies with enterprise goals.
  • Drive organization-wide coordination of strategic initiatives.

Innovation & Future Planning

  • Identify emerging trends, technologies, and business models.
  • Drive innovation initiatives and future-focused strategic planning.
  • Support digital transformation and modernization efforts.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present strategic recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.
  • Engage with investors, partners, and external stakeholders on strategic matters.
  • Act as a key advisor to the CEO on critical business decisions.

  • Strong understanding of market dynamics, financial analysis, and organizational strategy.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent analytical and business acumen.
  • Leadership and executive influence skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation capabilities.
  • Ability to drive change and manage complex transformations.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of strategic growth objectives.
  • Success of transformation and execution initiatives.
  • Market share and competitive positioning improvement.
  • M&A and partnership value creation.
  • Alignment and execution efficiency across business units.

Company Overview:

Leading with our core values of Quality, Integrity, and Opportunity, MedInsight is one of the healthcare industry’s most trusted solutions for healthcare intelligence. Our purpose is to empower easy, data-driven decision-making on important healthcare questions. Through our products, education, and services, MedInsight is making an impact on healthcare by helping to drive better outcomes for patients while reducing waste. Over 300 leading healthcare organizations have come to rely on MedInsight analytic solutions for healthcare cost and care management.

MedInsight is a subsidiary of Milliman; a global, employee-owned consultancy providing actuarial consulting, retirement funding and healthcare financing, enterprise risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation as well as a range of other consulting and technology solutions.

Position Summary:

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) opportunity is part of a newly restructured business development team at MedInsight. This high visibility role drives the top of our sales funnel: researching accounts, building new relationships, and generating qualified meetings and opportunities. This hire will work with the Senior Vice President of Sales and the Manager of Sales Development, alongside a strong team of Business Development Executives (BDEs) and Account Executives (AEs), to achieve pipeline goals. They will also partner with Marketing and Enablement to build strategic prospect plans, stay organized in the CRM, and drive results.

This is a strategic and collaborative role, and the right candidate is a high-potential, coachable self-starter who is eager to roll up their sleeves, learn quickly, and grow in their sales career. As the MedInsight business development team evolves, this is an incredible opportunity to join the firm in its next phase of growth and build your trajectory alongside it.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Generate qualified meetings that lead to meaningful, revenue-producing pipeline for our sales team
  • Lead strategic outbound prospecting through research, calls, emails, and LinkedIn to identify, engage, and qualify new prospects and spark interest in an initial meeting
  • Conduct outbound opportunity development through partnership with BDEs, AEs, and Marketing
  • Support pipeline growth within existing client accounts by partnering with the team to identify expansion opportunities
  • Understand prospects’ challenges, along with healthcare industry trends and insights, to craft credible outreach
  • Collaborate on sales and prospecting best practices and bring creative lead generation ideas to each team meeting
  • Add, maintain, and track business development efforts, forecasts, and activity in the CRM and sales tech stack
  • Achieve (and exceed) your monthly and annual Sales Accepted Lead (SAL) and pipeline targets

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Preference for candidates that have business development, sales, healthcare, insurance, analytics, or related experience
  • Experience with sales enablement tools such as Gong Engage, Salesforce, Orum, and ZoomInfo is a plus
  • Ownership and Accountability: Owns their numbers, pipeline, and follow-through; honest about their misses and proactive in flagging obstacles early
  • Coachable and Growth-Minded: Actively seeks feedback and applies it, eager to learn the playbook and progress in sales career
  • Resilient: Sustains effort and a positive attitude through the inevitable no's, treating rejection as part of the process, learning from it, and bouncing back quickly
  • Competitive and Strategic: Internally driven to win and hit goals, and thoughtful about how they get there, building multi-threaded outreach that engages the right stakeholders across the right channels
  • Consultative and Confident: A critical thinker able to effectively comprehend complex business issues and communicate in a way that works for varying stakeholders
  • Intellectually Curious: Genuinely curious about prospect challenges and the healthcare market, researching before reaching out and asking sharp questions to understand why
  • Articulate: Effective communicator, clear and concise in both verbal and written communication
  • Organized and Adaptable: Adept at planning and execution, capable of prioritizing and accomplishing goals across a spectrum of concurrent tasks for varying stakeholders
  • Energetic, Optimistic and Hard-working: Maintains a can-do attitude and is unrelenting in the pursuit of excellence

Location

This role can be located remotely within the United States. The expected application deadline for this job is October 15, 2026.

Compensation

The overall salary range for this role is $54,900 - $97,865. For candidates residing in:

  • Alaska, California, Connecticut, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York City, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Washington, or the District of Columbia the salary range is $63,135 - $97,865.
  • All other locations the salary range is $54,900 - $85,100.

A combination of factors will be considered, including, but not limited to, education, relevant work experience, qualifications, skills, certifications, etc.

What makes this a great opportunity?

  • Join an innovative, high growth company with a solid industry track record
  • Bring your expertise and ideas to directly impact and help build the next generation of MedInsight products and solutions
  • Enjoy significant visibility in your work and be recognized for your wins
  • Work for a company that values your wellbeing and professional growth, offering a flexible work environment, generous benefits package, and investment in the development of your career

Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees’ health, financial security, and well-being. Benefits include:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision – Coverage for employees, dependents, and domestic partners
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential support for personal and work-related challenges
  • 401(k) Plan – Includes a company matching program and profit-sharing contributions.
  • Discretionary Bonus Program – Recognizing employee contributions
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) – Pre-tax savings for dependent care, transportation, and eligible medical expenses
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) – Begins accruing on the first day of work. Full-time employees accrue 15 days per year, and employees working less than full-time accrue PTO on a prorated basis
  • Holidays – A minimum of 10 paid holidays per year
  • Family Building Benefits – Includes adoption and fertility assistance
  • Paid Parental Leave – Up to 12 weeks of paid leave for employees who meet eligibility criteria
  • Life Insurance & AD&D – 100% of premiums covered by Milliman
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability – Fully paid by Milliman

Equal Opportunity

Vervolgens vertaal je deze inzichten naar een robuust en toekomstgericht datamodel voor nieuwe analytische en voorspellende toepassingen. De focus ligt niet alleen op het rapporteren van historische cijfers. Je gebruikt data en kennis van supply chain om scenario's door te rekenen en toekomstige behoeften, volumes en capaciteiten beter te voorspellen.

  • Je vertaalt informatie uit Excel naar gestructureerde data, een datamodel, analytics en forecasting.
  • Je ontwerpt een logisch, performant en herbruikbaar datamodel.
  • Je werkt mee aan de functionele en data-architectuur van de toekomstige oplossing en documenteert die in een functionele blueprint.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met supply-chainexperten, key users, data engineers en andere stakeholders.

  • Je hebt ervaring als functioneel analist.
  • Je hebt kennis van supply chain en forecasting. Ervaring met supply chain en forecasting in de energiesector is relevant voor deze rol.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met complexere projectwerking waarbij meerdere stakeholders betrokken zijn.
  • Je hebt kennis van data governance.
  • Je kunt bestaande Excelmodellen analyseren, ontleden en doorgronden.
  • Je kunt datamodellen interpreteren en toepassen.
  • Je communiceert sterk en stemt helder af met verschillende stakeholders.
  • Je hebt ervaring met Databricks.
  • Je kunt werken volgens een projectmethodiek.
  • Je kunt een functionele blueprint opstellen.

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus as a Senior Electrical Engineer.

In this role, you will take technical ownership of electrical engineering and power system projects from initial scoping through final design and issued-for-construction (IFC) deliverables. You will independently execute medium- and low-voltage power system design, protection and control (P&C) engineering, and power system studies while ensuring that work meets Qualus standards, applicable codes, client requirements, project budgets, and schedules.

Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to translate field conditions and client needs into practical, constructible engineering solutions. You will work directly with project managers, designers, engineers, field personnel, and clients while also supporting business development through site walks, scope development, and technical proposal input.

Responsibilities

  • Perform power system studies, including short-circuit, protective device coordination, arc-flash, load-flow, grounding, and related analyses.
  • Lead and independently execute medium- and low-voltage electrical design for brownfield and greenfield projects, including outdoor substations, unit substations, power transformers, protection and control systems, power monitoring systems, and breaker and relay replacements.
  • Develop technical specifications for medium- and low-voltage electrical equipment.
  • Direct and coordinate with CAD/design staff in the development and revision of electrical drawings, including one-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, schematics, and related design documentation.
  • Review and interpret field data to support engineering analysis, design development, and project execution.
  • Develop and review protective relay setpoints, settings, and associated documentation.
  • Analyze power monitoring data and develop technically sound recommendations for clients.
  • Perform engineering reviews to ensure deliverables are accurate, coordinated, constructible, and compliant with applicable codes, standards, specifications, and client requirements.
  • Serve as a technical representative of Qualus, often alongside sales and business development, during customer meetings, site walks, project kickoffs, and other client-facing activities.
  • Coordinate with project managers, engineers, designers, field personnel, and other Qualus teams to establish project requirements and execute work efficiently.
  • Assess project-specific engineering resource needs and communicate staffing, schedule, scope, or technical concerns to the project manager.
  • Participate in project kickoff and coordination meetings to align the project team on scope, specifications, budget, schedule, deliverables, and safety requirements.
  • Identify changes in scope or project conditions and provide timely technical input needed to support change management.
  • Coordinate with equipment manufacturers and suppliers to identify materials and equipment that meet project technical requirements.
  • Maintain required safety and technical training and comply with Qualus, client, and industry safety requirements.
  • Complete required project documentation, including timekeeping, change documentation, technical reports, and other deliverable-related records, accurately and on time.
  • Travel to customer facilities and project sites as required, up to approximately 30%.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline from an ABET-accredited institution.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • 5+ years of relevant electrical engineering experience involving primary power distribution, protection and control, electrical equipment, and/or industrial power systems.
  • Demonstrated experience developing protective relay setpoints and settings files.
  • Working knowledge of applicable electrical codes and standards, including NEC/NFPA 70, ANSI C57, ANSI C37, and NESC.
  • Experience applying electrical engineering codes and standards to substation and industrial power distribution designs.
  • 2+ years of AutoCAD experience.
  • 3+ years of experience with power system modeling and analysis software such as ETAP, SKM PowerTools, and/or EasyPower.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate technical findings and recommendations to clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage engineering assignments while maintaining accuracy, quality, and attention to detail.

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Vlogger (Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging expert Vloggers to contribute to a cutting-edge customer project focused on capturing high-quality, naturalistic video data using 360° and action cameras. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Contributors will record themselves performing everyday activities across indoor, outdoor, and vehicle environments using compatible equipment, providing crucial video resources for advanced AI research.

Scope of Work

  1. Capture a diverse set of continuous video clips (minimum 60 seconds each) of everyday activities in a range of environments, including indoor, outdoor, and in-vehicle settings.
  2. Consistently utilize compatible 360° or wide-angle cameras (e.g., Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX series) with at least 170° FOV and 720p resolution, ensuring stable, third-person perspective according to project standards.
  3. Implement appropriate mounting solutions, such as backpack or vehicle mounts, to maintain a clear third-person view where your entire body and surroundings are visible throughout each activity.
  4. Follow provided guidelines and instructions for camera placement, activity selection, and safety to ensure data consistency and collection integrity.
  5. Document, organize, and submit video files in accordance with project specifications, ensuring all deliverables meet technical and quality requirements.
  6. Communicate proactively and clearly in both written and verbal form regarding progress, questions, and any technical challenges.
  7. Adapt to occasional updates in collection tasks, environments, or technical requirements as defined by project needs.

Compatible camera examples include:

  1. Insta360 X3, X4, X5, X6
  2. DJI Osmo 360
  3. GoPro MAX, MAX2
  4. Other action or 360° cameras that meet the minimum 170° FOV and 720p requirements

Examples of compatible third-person mounting rigs include:

  1. Insta360 Third-Person Backpack Mount and other harness-mounted extension systems.
  2. Owning a compatible backpack or vehicle mount is a plus and may let you start collecting sooner.

Third-Person Camera Setup

  1. Mounted above and behind you
  2. Angled slightly downward
  3. Positioned far enough back to keep your entire body consistently visible
  4. Stable enough to maintain the required third-person perspective during normal movement

If using a camera with less than 360° FOV, the mounting setup must position the camera far enough away to keep your entire body in frame while also capturing the surrounding environment. Your full body should remain visible throughout normal movement without frequently leaving the frame.

Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.

Expected Recording Tasks may include:

  1. Natural everyday activities
  2. Indoor and outdoor activities
  3. Walking and moving through different environments
  4. Vehicle navigation and driving-related recordings
  5. Other similar real-world activities provided in the collection instructions

For vehicle navigation tasks, the camera must be securely mounted to the vehicle.

Recording Requirements

  1. Capture a variety of activities and environments
  2. Each continuous clip must be at least 60 seconds long
  3. Record at a minimum resolution of 720p
  4. Follow the required camera position for each assigned task
  5. Keep the relevant activity and surrounding environment consistently visible
  6. Follow all provided recording and safety instructions

jobs.excerpt: Position DescriptionValiant Solutions is seeking a Red Team Tester – Junior to support authorized red team, penetration testing, and adversarial security assessments across our government customer's systems and applications.
jobs.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Red Team Tester – Junior to support authorized red team, penetration testing, and adversarial security assessments across our government customer's systems and applications. Working under the guidance of senior team members, you will identify exploitable vulnerabilities, validate security controls, document attack paths, and deliver actionable findings that strengthen the customer's cybersecurity posture. You will build test scenarios around real-world adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and document your work using the MITRE ATT&CK framework

Named one of the Washington Business Journal’sBest Places to Work every year since 2014, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: Remote with ad hoc travel to the Washington DC Metro area.

This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Required Clearance: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance

Eligibility Requirements: U.S. citizenship is required to obtain the necessary clearance for this position.

Required Experience:

  • 3 to 5 years of work experience in the subject area.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent applicable experience.
  • An industry professional certification; Security+, CEH, eJPT, PNPT, or OSCP preferred.
  • Hands-on cybersecurity experience in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, security testing, ethical hacking, or related activities.
  • Working knowledge of network protocols, operating systems, web technologies, and common security vulnerabilities.
  • Familiarity with penetration testing methodology and vulnerability exploitation.
  • Understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and common attacker TTPs.
  • Experience with tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Wireshark, Nessus/Tenable, BloodHound, or comparable offensive security tools.
  • Familiarity with Windows and Linux environments.
  • Scripting experience in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Exposure to AWS cloud security testing.
  • Ability to clearly document technical findings and remediation recommendations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-115.

Responsibilities:

  • Support authorized red team and penetration testing engagements across customer systems, networks, applications, APIs, and cloud environments.
  • Conduct vulnerability validation and exploitation activities under established rules of engagement (ROE).
  • Assist with reconnaissance, enumeration, attack-path analysis, exploitation, and post-exploitation activities.
  • Perform web application, network, API, and infrastructure security testing.
  • Support testing scenarios based on real-world adversary TTPs.
  • Apply the MITRE ATT&CK framework to categorize and document adversary techniques.
  • Assist with testing security controls and identifying weaknesses that could lead to unauthorized access or privilege escalation.
  • Document testing procedures, evidence, vulnerabilities, attack paths, and results.
  • Develop clear technical findings that describe vulnerabilities, risk, evidence, and recommended remediation.
  • Retest identified vulnerabilities after remediation.
  • Maintain knowledge of emerging vulnerabilities, exploits, attack techniques, and defensive technologies.
  • Follow the customer's rules of engagement, security requirements, and testing procedures.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

  • A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $115,000 to $125,000. This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Valiant Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact .

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods and consistently operating a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education, and experience. Should Valiant Solutions or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

Lead the architecture, standards, security and performance of an enterprise OutSystems case management platform, including its integration with AI and agentic AI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the end-to-end architecture for the platform and ensures the detailed design and development is aligned with the Enterprise Architecture of the organisation.
  • Translate business requirements, including application resiliency requirements, into application platform architectural specifications
  • Review quality of common services and modules developed by applications and advise on enhancement if needed
  • Design the architecture blueprint of the organisation's business, information and ICT assets, by using multiple architectural models.
  • Use, govern and enhance the architecture blueprint to ensure that the business and ICT are aligned.
  • Define the application platform reference architecture (for OutSystems) and reusable component standards for the case management platform (e.g. Architecture Canvas layering, shared modules and templates), so case management applications are built consistently and reuse common components
  • Govern application architecture quality and the integration of applications hosted on the case management platform with the enterprise AI Foundation Platform (currently using Amazon Bedrock) and the shared agentic AI modules, so AI capabilities are embedded into case management workflows
  • Define non-functional requirements for the case management platform (performance, scalability, availability, resiliency and security) and verify them through capacity planning, performance and load testing, and tuning, so the platform sustains enterprise-level workloads
  • Define the observability architecture for applications hosted on the case management platform and AI agents (logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLIs/SLOs and alerting standards) so platform and agent behaviour can be monitored end to end
  • Define the reference architecture for agentic AI on the case management platform, including agent patterns, tool and API integration, agent identity and access, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and where guardrails and controls sit
  • Ensure designs comply with IM8 / ICT&SS management policies, and lead the architecture and security submissions (e.g. System Security Plan, Architecture Review Board) for the case management platform and agentic AI changes
  • Conduct proactive reviews of platform and application controls at regular intervals against ICT&SS / IM8 requirements and the System Security Plan (SSP), track findings to closure with the DevSecOps and AI engineers, and report control health to the organisation

Requirements

  • Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related disciplines
  • At least 7 years of relevant work experience, including at least 3 years as a technical lead or system architect (e.g. system design, performance tuning, prototyping and maintenance)
  • Hands-on experience in at least 3 full project development life cycles
  • Experience in designing and implementing enterprise applications on the OutSystems low-code platform, including reusable modules, integrations and performance tuning. Must possess excellent data modelling and SQL skills.
  • Solid understanding of Service Oriented Architectures, web services and APIs, and public web sites / eservices development.
  • Experience in server-side .Net and/or Java development is an advantage.
  • Solid technical skills and the ability to leverage them to determine the best solution to a technical problem
  • Ability to analyse and identify comprehensive solutions considering all functional implications while developing a workable solution
  • Results and customer-oriented mindset
  • Strong organization and people handling skills
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to pitch ideas and influence stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of Government ICT&SS management policies (IM8), System Security Plan (SSP) requirements and observability concepts, and has applied them in system design, guardrails and monitoring
  • Experience governing a Centre of Excellence for application platforms and common agentic services with demonstrated success in managing controls and observability.
  • Strong understanding of GovTech techstack to ensure platform interoperability with WOG common products and services
  • Experience defining non-functional requirements and designing for high performance, high availability and scalability
  • Familiar with ICT&SS and SSP requirements, able to conduct proactive reviews of controls at regular intervals and drive remediation

Added Advantages

  • OutSystems certifications such as Architecture Specialist or Associate/Professional Reactive Developer
  • Experience integrating AI or generative AI services (e.g. Amazon Bedrock) into enterprise applications
  • Experience with Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) and familiarity with IM8 and government security requirements
  • Experience designing agentic AI solutions (e.g. tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop controls, Amazon Bedrock Agents)

The Role:

Agenus is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Statistical Programming to support statistical programming activities across our oncology clinical development programs. This is a highly hands-on role responsible for developing, validating, and delivering high-quality clinical trial datasets, statistical analyses, and regulatory submission outputs.

The Senior Manager will work closely with Biostatistics, Clinical Development, Data Management, and external programming vendors to ensure the accuracy, quality, and timely delivery of programming activities. The ideal candidate brings strong oncology programming experience, direct involvement in regulatory submissions, and the technical expertise to independently develop submission-ready deliverables. jobs.description:
Role at a glance

You open the door to Manara's enterprise and government deals: you find the right people, start the conversation, qualify the need and hand a ready meeting to the Commercial team.

  • Title: Business Development Representative (SDR/BDR)
  • Team: Commercial
  • Reports to: Abdelrahman Ayman, VP Commercial
  • Works with: Senior Commercial Lead, Sales Ops, Marketing
  • Markets: GCC, with a current focus on Saudi Arabia, UAE and Qatar
  • Buyers: Governments and ministries, semi-government entities, enterprises and foundations
  • Type: Full-time
  • Location: Remote within MENA

About Manara and this role

Manara unlocks talent in emerging markets to grow, lead and thrive. We upskill people at scale through programmes bought by governments, ministries, enterprises and foundations across MENA.

Our deals are long-cycle and multi-stakeholder, so pipeline has to be built months ahead. This role is the engine at the top of that funnel: consistent, well-researched outreach that turns cold accounts into qualified meetings for the Commercial team.

What you'll do

Your job is to create qualified first meetings with the people who decide on workforce and talent programmes.

Research and target

  • Build and maintain target account lists by market and segment: government, semi-government, enterprise and foundations
  • Map buying committees at each account: HR and L&D leaders, workforce and talent directors, digital transformation heads, and the budget owner
  • Track triggers that make an account timely: national workforce strategies, new funding programmes, hiring growth, leadership changes

Prospect and open conversations

  • Run multi-channel outreach through Apollo sequences, LinkedIn, phone and WhatsApp where appropriate
  • Write short, personalised messages in English and Arabic that link Manara's programmes to each account's goals
  • Use Claude to research accounts, draft first-touch messages and prepare call notes faster, without losing the personal touch
  • Follow up with persistence and respect for local business etiquette

Qualify and hand over

  • Run first discovery calls to confirm need, budget owner, timing and decision process
  • Hand qualified meetings to the Senior Commercial Lead or VP Commercial with a clear written brief
  • Support event and leadership-travel prospecting: book meetings ahead of conferences and trips in each market

Keep the data clean

  • Log every touch, call and meeting in HubSpot the same day
  • Keep contacts, companies and deal stages accurate so pipeline reporting can be trusted
  • Share what's working (messages, channels, segments) in a short weekly update

What we're looking for

We want a hunter who enjoys the volume, keeps going after a no, and writes like a person, not a template.

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years in an SDR, BDR, lead generation or inside sales role, ideally B2B SaaS, EdTech or services
  • Fluent English and Arabic, written and spoken
  • Proven record of booking meetings through cold outreach, with numbers to show it
  • Comfortable with a CRM and a sequencing tool (HubSpot and Apollo, or similar)
  • Resilient and self-driven: you set your own daily rhythm and hit it

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling to government or semi-government buyers in the GCC
  • Network or market knowledge in the UAE, Qatar or Saudi Arabia
  • Familiarity with workforce development, L&D or talent programmes
  • Already using AI tools such as Claude in your daily workflow

How you'll live Manara's values

We review everyone against the same seven values. Here is what each one means in this role.

  • Urgency: Outreach starts in week one; replies get a same-day response
  • Experimentation: Test new messages, channels and segments every month, and report what you learn
  • Ownership: Your pipeline numbers are yours; you flag gaps before anyone asks
  • Responsiveness and over-communication: A clear weekly update on activity, meetings and what's working
  • Continuous feedback (Tough Love): Tell the team which messages and segments aren't landing, and ask for direct feedback on your calls
  • Scale: Turn what works into repeatable sequences and templates others can use
  • Brand Ambassador: Every first touch represents Manara to a ministry or a CEO; make it worth their time

What we offer

  • Base salary plus commission on qualified meetings and the opportunities they create
  • A modern sales stack from day one: HubSpot, Apollo and Claude
  • Direct coaching from the VP Commercial, with weekly call reviews
  • A clear path to Account Executive for strong performers
  • Work that matters: every deal helps people across MENA build skills and careers

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on the best cold outreach you've run: who you targeted, what you wrote and what it booked.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Majors sales team is responsible for revenue growth in new and existing customers that represent the largest prospective accounts for Samsara by total addressable opportunity. This role can be office-based or fully remote covering a certain geography.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the Upper Mid West United States.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • 5+ years of experience working with line of business stakeholders in SLED/Government entities
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $200k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and executive city/county relationships
  • Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability thriving in a dynamic, fast paced environment

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) for full-time employees for this position is below. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$350,000—$350,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Descripción

DIRECTOR/A COMERCIAL BILINGÜE | SEGUROS Y NEGOCIOS INTERNACIONALES | BOGOTÁ

En ACIERTA HEADHUNTER lideramos esta búsqueda para una compañía internacional del sector asegurador, con operación regional y una propuesta de valor especializada para clientes corporativos.

¿Te interesa asumir la dirección comercial de una organización con alcance internacional, fortalecer un equipo de alto desempeño y convertir la estrategia en crecimiento rentable, fidelización y nuevas oportunidades de negocio?

Revisa el perfil completo y aplica o compártelo con profesionales del sector asegurador

DESCRIPCIÓN GENERAL
Buscamos un/a Director/a Comercial Bilingüe para liderar la estrategia de crecimiento de una compañía del sector asegurador con cobertura internacional.

Esta posición tendrá la responsabilidad de organizar, desarrollar y movilizar al equipo comercial, integrado por Key Account Managers, comisionistas y profesionales freelance, asegurando una gestión disciplinada del pipeline, el cumplimiento de objetivos y la construcción de relaciones sostenibles con clientes corporativos.

El reto va más allá de supervisar ventas. Buscamos una persona capaz de interpretar las necesidades del mercado, conectar las áreas comercial y técnica, fortalecer la propuesta de valor y tomar decisiones que impulsen la rentabilidad, la fidelización y la expansión del negocio.

Es una oportunidad para un/a líder con visión internacional, criterio comercial y capacidad para convertir relaciones estratégicas en resultados medibles.

Requisitos

FORMACIÓN ACADÉMICA
Profesional en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Negocios Internacionales, Comercio Exterior, Economía, Mercadeo o carreras afines.

Se valorará especialización en Dirección Comercial, Gerencia de Ventas, Seguros, Negocios Internacionales o áreas relacionadas.

La especialización podrá homologarse con experiencia relevante y comprobable dentro del sector asegurador.

Inglés avanzado C1 o superior, indispensable para interactuar con clientes, aliados y equipos internacionales.

Conocimientos de Excel y Power BI son importantes.

EXPERIENCIA Y CONOCIMIENTOS
Mínimo 6 años de experiencia profesional en áreas comerciales, desarrollo de negocios o gestión de cuentas corporativas.

Al menos 3 años liderando equipos comerciales o desempeñándose en posiciones de coordinación, dirección o gerencia.

Experiencia comprobable en el sector asegurador, reasegurador, corretaje de seguros, riesgos corporativos o servicios financieros relacionados.

Se valorará experiencia en negocios vinculados con logística, comercio exterior, transporte terrestre, aéreo o marítimo.

Experiencia liderando Key Account Managers, ejecutivos comerciales, comisionistas, canales externos o equipos independientes.

Conocimiento de venta consultiva B2B, negociación de alto nivel y desarrollo de cuentas estratégicas.

Capacidad para comprender coberturas, riesgos y necesidades del cliente, articulando soluciones con el área técnica.

Experiencia en planeación comercial, presupuestos, forecast, pipeline, indicadores y seguimiento de productividad.

Conocimiento en fidelización, renovación de cuentas y crecimiento del portafolio por cliente.

Manejo de CRM y plataformas digitales para seguimiento comercial.

Conocimiento general de sistemas de gestión de calidad y seguridad y salud en el trabajo.

RESPONSABILIDADES CLAVE
Diseñar e implementar la estrategia comercial de la compañía, alineada con los objetivos de crecimiento, rentabilidad y expansión internacional.

Liderar, organizar y desarrollar al equipo comercial, asegurando claridad en metas, segmentos, responsabilidades y prioridades.

Fortalecer la gestión de Key Account Managers, comisionistas y profesionales freelance.

Impulsar la captación de nuevos clientes corporativos y el crecimiento de las cuentas existentes.

Asegurar una gestión rigurosa del pipeline, forecast y oportunidades comerciales.

Coordinar con el área técnica la construcción de soluciones aseguradoras acordes con los riesgos y necesidades de los clientes.

Liderar las negociaciones estratégicas y acompañar los procesos comerciales de mayor impacto.

Diseñar iniciativas de fidelización, renovación y venta cruzada.

Presentar resultados, riesgos, proyecciones y recomendaciones a la gerencia.

Representar comercialmente a la compañía ante clientes, aliados y actores relevantes del mercado.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES
Construir el plan comercial anual y traducirlo en objetivos concretos por canal, segmento y responsable.

Definir territorios, cuentas objetivo, prioridades y estrategias de abordaje.

Liderar reuniones de seguimiento, comités comerciales y sesiones de revisión de resultados.

Acompañar al equipo en negociaciones complejas, presentaciones ejecutivas y cierres estratégicos.

Analizar el desempeño comercial y tomar acciones frente a desviaciones en presupuesto, conversión o productividad.

Desarrollar planes de formación, entrenamiento y acompañamiento para la fuerza de ventas.

Diseñar y administrar esquemas de incentivos alineados con crecimiento, margen y calidad de la cartera.

Evaluar riesgos comerciales y coordinar con el equipo técnico la estructuración de propuestas.

Hacer seguimiento a renovaciones, oportunidades de venta cruzada y potencial de crecimiento por cliente.

Promover el uso disciplinado del CRM y la actualización permanente de la información comercial.

Preparar informes ejecutivos sobre ventas, forecast, pipeline, actividad y resultados.

Participar en la selección y vinculación de nuevos integrantes del equipo comercial.

Identificar tendencias del mercado, movimientos de la competencia y nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas internas, lineamientos de calidad y disposiciones de seguridad y salud en el trabajo.

COMPETENCIAS CLAVE
Visión estratégica: para anticipar oportunidades, interpretar el mercado y definir caminos de crecimiento.

Liderazgo comercial: indispensable para movilizar equipos diversos hacia objetivos comunes.

Orientación a resultados: para mantener el foco en cumplimiento, rentabilidad y expansión.

Negociación e influencia: necesarias para gestionar clientes corporativos, aliados y decisiones de alto impacto.

Comunicación ejecutiva: clave para interactuar con equipos internacionales, áreas técnicas y alta dirección.

Toma de decisiones: para priorizar oportunidades, ajustar estrategias y actuar frente a desviaciones.

Pensamiento analítico: importante para interpretar indicadores, riesgos, productividad y desempeño comercial.

Desarrollo de equipos: fundamental para elevar capacidades, autonomía y nivel de ejecución.

Resiliencia: necesaria para sostener el desempeño en ciclos comerciales exigentes.

Trabajo transversal: esencial para conectar comercial, técnico, operaciones y gerencia.

Orientación al cliente: para construir relaciones de confianza y soluciones de largo plazo.

Integridad: indispensable en la gestión de información, condiciones comerciales y relaciones institucionales.

Beneficios

OPORTUNIDAD Y BENEFICIOS
Posición estratégica con exposición directa a la alta dirección.

Remuneración competitiva.

Esquema de comisiones y bonificaciones por desempeño.

Contrato laboral con condiciones acordes con el nivel del cargo.

Acceso a formación continua en seguros, normatividad, estrategias comerciales y liderazgo.

Participación en una operación con alcance internacional.

Oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo dentro de la organización.

Cultura orientada al servicio, la innovación y el cumplimiento de objetivos.

Herramientas tecnológicas para la gestión comercial y el análisis de riesgos.

Programas de bienestar y cumplimiento de las disposiciones de seguridad y salud en el trabajo.

Esta oportunidad está dirigida a líderes comerciales con experiencia en seguros, capacidad para desarrollar equipos y criterio para conducir negociaciones corporativas en contextos internacionales.

Buscamos una persona que no solo administre una fuerza de ventas, sino que fortalezca su nivel de ejecución, identifique nuevas oportunidades y convierta la estrategia comercial en relaciones sostenibles y resultados rentables.

Aplicar directamente en esta oferta es la mejor forma de hacernos llegar tu hoja de vida y tenerla en cuenta para este proceso.

FULL-STACK ENGINEER

RESPONSIBILITY

The Full Stack Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining scalable, high-performance, and secure web applications. The role requires expertise in frontend and backend development, cloud technologies, DevOps automation, and application security. Engineers must work in an agile, DevOps-driven environment, ensuring high software quality, security, and maintainability.

  • Take full ownership of end-to-end application development, integrating frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive, accessible, and performant web applications.
  • Implement modern frontend architectures, ensuring reusability, scalability, and security.
  • Develop high-performance backend services and APIs, ensuring reliability, security, and observability.
  • Work with Quality Assurance (QA) engineers to ensure automated test coverage and proactively fix bugs and defects.
  • Optimize full-stack CI/CD deployment strategies, ensuring seamless and automated releases.
  • Work with DevOps teams to automate infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, and cloud deployments.
  • Ensure full-stack security, including authentication, authorization, API security, and frontend security best practices.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to improve application performance and developer productivity.

EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS NEEDED

Full Stack Development:

  • Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or related disciplines.
  • Experience with Git and modern branching workflows (GitFlow, trunk-based development).
  • Strong proficiency in both frontend and backend development.

Frontend Technologies:

  • JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Frontend frameworks such as React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, or Svelte.
  • Mobile app development using Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), or React Native.
  • UI component libraries such as Material-UI, Tailwind CSS, or Bootstrap.
  • Experience with wireframing and prototyping tools (Figma).

Backend Technologies:

  • Node.js, Express.js, NestJS.
  • Ruby on Rails (RoR).
  • Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot).
  • Python (Django, Flask, FastAPI).
  • Golang
  • RESTful APIs, GraphQL, gRPC, and WebSockets for service communication.

Observability & Monitoring:

  • Experience implementing application performance monitoring (APM) tools (Datadog, New Relic, Sentry, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Knowledge of logging frameworks (ELK Stack, Loki, Fluentd) to track and debug issues across distributed systems.
  • Ability to set up dashboards and alerts for real-time application health monitoring.

Backend Scalability & API Design:

  • Strong experience in API design principles, including REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and WebSockets.
  • Knowledge of API rate limiting, caching strategies (Redis, Varnish), and performance optimizations.
  • Familiarity with backend service scalability strategies (horizontal scaling, autoscaling, load balancing).
  • DevOps, Cloud, and Infrastructure:
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Jenkins).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cloudflare Workers).
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).

Security Best Practices:

  • Strong knowledge of frontend security (CSP, CORS, XSS prevention).
  • Experience with backend security (OAuth, JWT, API rate limiting, encryption).
  • Familiarity with cloud security (IAM, Secrets Management, OWASP Top
  • 10).

Software Quality & Testing:

  • Experience with unit and integration testing (Jest, Cypress, Playwright, Pact).
  • Backend testing using Postman, Supertest, contract testing.
  • Bonus Experience (Added Advantage):
  • Experience with low-code platforms (OutSystems, Mendix, Appian).
  • Familiarity with micro-frontends and modular frontend architectures.
  • Experience working with edge computing (Cloudflare Workers, Lambda@Edge).

Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

Retail Production Assistant

SoFi is seeking a proactive, high-energy Production Assistant to serve as the backbone for our top-producing Retail Mortgage Loan Originators (MLOs). In this role, you aren’t just a support player; you are the engine that keeps the loan origination process moving.

You’ll act as the primary bridge between borrowers, realtors, and our internal operations team, ensuring every file is structured for success from day one. If you are detail-focused, tech-savvy, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to talk to you.

What You’ll Do

  • Business Development & Retention: Develop and execute targeted marketing strategies to engage the existing book of business for client retention, while proactively building relationships with prospective clients and key centers of influence to drive new-to-bank growth.
  • Loan Structuring & Analysis: Pull and analyze credit reports, review income/asset documentation, and assist MLOs in determining the optimal loan structure for clients.
  • Pipeline Management: Run Desktop Underwriter (DU), stack files for submission, and proactively request/clear underwriting conditions to ensure "on-time" closings.
  • Client Advocacy: Serve as the primary point of contact for borrowers and realtors, providing status updates and maintaining a seamless white-glove experience.
  • Front-End Support: Take initial application information over the phone, schedule high-priority appointments, and manage MLO calendars.
  • Data Integrity: Track all document requests in Encompass and Salesforce. Review incoming files within 24 hours to catch discrepancies, omissions, or income/asset issues before they hit underwriting.
  • Problem Solving: Collaborate directly with MLOs and Underwriters to resolve complex file issues and documentation gaps.
  • Compliance: Maintain strict adherence to company policy and state/federal regulatory guidelines (RESPA, TILA, etc.) to ensure every file is audit-ready.

What You’ll Need

  • Experience: At least 2 years of professional office experience, with a minimum of 1 year specifically in the mortgage or banking industry.

The Marketing Manager is responsible for positioning and communicating the sopp+sopp proposition, and for developing and delivering the go-to-market strategy that supports our sales and business development growth plans.

This is a hands-on role for a commercially minded marketer who can both set the strategy and deliver it. Reporting to the Business Development Director, they will be the key marketing stakeholder for the sopp+sopp leadership team, developing plans based on business priorities and being prepared to challenge the status quo. They will work closely with the Activate Group central marketing team, led by Kate Rooney, Head of Marketing and Communications, which provides design support and manages awards entries across the group.

Activate Group is a growing UK business with 1,000+ team members nationwide. This is an exciting opportunity to build a long-term career with a company that values its people and offers genuine development and progression opportunities.

  • Build and deliver the sopp+sopp marketing strategy and plan, aligned to sales targets and business development priorities, across all market-facing channels

  • Work closely with the sales and business development team to generate and nurture leads, and support core sales activity including significant bids and tenders, sales collateral and events
  • Plan, write and produce content for websites, blogs, case studies, slide decks, emails, social platforms and publication partners, on time and to a consistently high quality

  • Help colleagues across sopp+sopp get the most from these tools by sharing good practice and practical guidance

  • Measure and report on marketing performance, including lead generation, pipeline contribution and content engagement, and use the data to improve results
  • Work in partnership with the Activate Group central marketing team, providing clear briefs to the group designer for visual media and supplying sopp+sopp input for awards entries managed centrally
  • Ensure all collateral (e.g., infographics, slide decks, video, website, email layouts) meets Activate Group brand guidelines and is relevant to the target audience
  • Contribute to group marketing strategy and shared ways of working alongside the central marketing team
  • Plan and deliver external campaigns, including events, publication partnerships and targeted campaigns, and liaise with external suppliers of photography, video, exhibition and promotional material

Skills and experience

Essential:

  • At least five years of experience in B2B marketing, covering proposition or product marketing, digital marketing and content creation
  • Ability to create a marketing strategy and do the hands-on work to deliver it
  • Ability to define value propositions for services and solutions
  • Experience of market research and turning insight into practical marketing plans
  • Confident, practical user of Claude or similar intelligent writing, research and analysis tools, with the curiosity to find and test new ones

Every role at Activate Group is aligned to our wider business vision and purpose – making someone’s bad day better. You’ll understand how your role contributes to the bigger picture and how your work helps deliver excellent outcomes for customer and partners.
