jobs.description:
As a Field and ABM Manager at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just running events; you are the person who makes vCluster Labs the name Europe’s AI cloud builders know. Europe is where sovereign AI is being built, from regional AI clouds and telcos launching GPU services to governments that need data to stay local. You’ll own account-based and field marketing for every target AI cloud and enterprise account in Europe, and you’ll support Middle East and APAC accounts until those regions have dedicated coverage. The 2027 plan, the account list and strong product marketing, DevRel and ecosystem teams are already in place. You’ll be one of the first hires on the growth team that brings it to life.

As a Field and ABM Manager, your role will include:

  • Account-Based Marketing: You will run ABM by tier. For our highest-priority European accounts, you’ll build 1:1 plans with AEs that include an executive sponsor, a custom business case, personalized pages, direct mail and invite-only dinners. For the next tier, such as sovereign EU clouds, NVIDIA Cloud Partners and telcos, you’ll run 1:few campaigns and adapt each quarterly campaign kit to European languages, regulations and buying processes.

  • The Sovereign AI Cloud Story: You will own the regional program for our Q3 sovereign AI campaign, built around RAISE Summit Paris. You’ll run roundtables and briefings on data residency and tenant isolation at the infrastructure layer for the buyers who care most about them.

  • Field Marketing & Events: You will plan and run executive dinners, roadshows, workshops and co-hosted events with NVIDIA, OEMs and ecosystem partners. You’ll turn KubeCon Europe, MWC Barcelona and ISC Hamburg into Tier 1 meetings and VIP dinners, and you’ll measure every program by how it moves accounts forward.

  • Buying Groups & Thought Leadership: You will reach the economic buyer, technical decision maker, champion, product owner and gatekeeper in every account, each with a message built for their role and market. You’ll put our executives, engineers and customers in front of European buyers through panels, roundtables and local media. You’ll also work with Content and Product Marketing to adapt assets for European audiences.

  • Sales Partnership & Measurement: You will agree on target accounts with European AEs and SDRs every quarter. Every touch gets a named follow-up owner and an SLA, and every high-intent event signal reaches an AE within two business days. You’ll track account progression weekly and program ROI quarterly, then scale what works and stop what doesn’t.

  • Early Impact: In your first 30 days, you’ll lock Tier 1 account plans with Sales and map the European field calendar for the first half of 2027. Within two quarters, every Tier 1 account in Europe will have an engaged buying group of 3+ roles and your field events will hold a 50%+ show rate. By the end of 2027, RAISE Paris and the sovereign campaign will have produced named Tier 1 and Tier 2 meetings and opportunities.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • ABM & Field Experience: 7+ years in B2B field marketing, ABM or demand generation across European markets, including at least 3 years running ABM against a named account list. You’ve run field programs that sourced or advanced pipeline in complex enterprise deals with many stakeholders.

  • Technical Buyer Fluency: Experience marketing to technical buyers in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, HPC, data centers, telco or developer platforms.

  • European Market Depth: You know how European buyers evaluate vendors, including GDPR, data residency and sovereign cloud requirements.

  • Executive Presence: Comfort hosting senior executives and running events across several countries.

  • GTM Tooling: Hands-on experience with Salesforce, HubSpot and ABM or intent tools such as 6sense, Demandbase or Clay.

  • Builder’s Mentality: A bias for action and the ability to build programs from scratch on an early-stage team. You’re fluent in English, have the right to work in Europe and are open to travel up to 40%.

Bonus points for:

  • Languages: German or French.

  • Regional Network: Existing relationships with sovereign AI clouds, regional cloud providers or telcos in Europe.

  • Partner Co-Marketing: Experience co-marketing with NVIDIA, OEMs or European cloud and data center partners.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Role Title: Art and Photography Curators

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $55 to $100 per hour

Location: Fully remote, worldwide

You’ll need: Professional experience curating, acquiring, cataloguing or attributing art or photography for a museum, gallery, auction house, archive or collection

Your tasks: Review works and image sets, judge attribution, context and presentation, and explain your decisions in writing

You’ll review artworks and photographs and judge them: what they are, where they come from, how they should be shown and described. This is a good fit if you work as a curator, collections specialist, gallery or auction specialist, or photo archivist and make decisions about what to acquire, show or attribute.

Scope of Work

  1. Look at works or sets of works and decide which fit a given theme, show or collection.
  2. Judge attribution, date, medium, edition and print type (for example, vintage vs. later print) from what is shown and described.
  3. Flag provenance gaps, doubtful attributions and condition or display risks.
  4. Check that titles, labels and descriptions are accurate and fair to the work.
  5. Flag rights, consent or ownership issues.
  6. Write a short explanation for each decision so a reviewer can follow your reasoning.

What we’re looking for

  1. Professional work as a curator, assistant curator, collections or exhibitions specialist, gallery director, auction house specialist, art or photo archivist, or registrar.
  2. Experience with real decisions: selecting works, attributing them, planning displays or handling loans and acquisitions.
  3. For photography: familiarity with prints, editions and photographic processes.
  4. Comfort explaining why a work belongs in a show or why an attribution is doubtful.
  5. Clear written English.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply with your resume and a short profile.
  2. Complete the curation interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with exhibitions, collections and attribution. You don’t need to prepare, look at anything or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward.
  3. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs.
  4. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue.

jobs.title: Field and ABM Manager, North America
jobs.excerpt: As a Field and ABM Manager at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just running events; you are the person who turns our most important North American accounts into pipeline.
jobs.description:
As a Field and ABM Manager at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just running events; you are the person who turns our most important North American accounts into pipeline. You’ll own account-based and field marketing for every target AI cloud and enterprise account in the region, and you’ll decide which accounts get attention, when, and through which programs. One of your dinners puts our executives in a room with the CTO of a target AI cloud, shapes how that room thinks about the software layer, and ends with a booked meeting. The 2027 plan, the account list and strong product marketing, DevRel and ecosystem teams are already in place. You’ll be one of the first hires on the growth team that brings it to life.

As a Field and ABM Manager, your role will include:

  • Account-Based Marketing: You will run ABM by tier. For our highest-priority accounts, you’ll build 1:1 plans with AEs that include an executive sponsor, a custom business case, personalized pages, direct mail and invite-only dinners. For the next tier, such as NVIDIA Cloud Partners and telcos, you’ll run 1:few campaigns and adapt each quarterly campaign kit for North America.

  • Field Marketing & Events: You will plan and run executive dinners, roadshows, workshops and co-hosted events with NVIDIA, OEMs and ecosystem partners. You’ll turn flagship moments like NVIDIA GTC San Jose and KubeCon North America into Tier 1 meetings and VIP dinners, and you’ll measure every program by how it moves accounts forward. You may also support some events in Asia Pacific.

  • Buying Groups & Thought Leadership: You will reach the economic buyer, technical decision maker, champion, product owner and gatekeeper in every account, each with a message built for them: business impact for the CEO, tenant isolation and architecture for the CTO, and reliability and SOC 2 posture for SRE and security. You’ll put our CEO, CTO and customers in front of target buyers through roundtables, panels and briefings. You’ll also work with Content and Product Marketing to turn each program into reusable assets.

  • Sales Partnership & Measurement: You will agree on target accounts with AEs and SDRs every quarter. Every touch gets a named follow-up owner and an SLA, and every high-intent event signal reaches an AE within two business days. You’ll track account progression weekly and program ROI quarterly, then scale what works and stop what doesn’t.

  • Early Impact: In your first 30 days, you’ll lock Tier 1 account plans with Sales and map the North American field calendar for the first half of 2027. Within two quarters, every Tier 1 account in the region will have an engaged buying group of 3+ roles and your field events will hold a 50%+ show rate. A growing share of meetings and opportunities will also be marketing-influenced, including partner-attached ones from NVIDIA and OEM programs.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • ABM & Field Experience: 7+ years in B2B field marketing, ABM or demand generation, including at least 3 years running ABM against a named account list.

  • Pipeline Impact: A track record of field programs that sourced or advanced pipeline in complex enterprise deals with many stakeholders.

  • Technical Buyer Fluency: Experience marketing to technical buyers in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, HPC, data centers or developer platforms.

  • Executive Presence: Comfort hosting senior executives. You can plan a VIP dinner for 20 CTOs and run the room.

  • GTM Tooling: Hands-on experience with Salesforce, HubSpot and ABM or intent tools such as 6sense, Demandbase or Clay.

  • Builder’s Mentality: A bias for action and the ability to build programs from scratch on an early-stage team. You’re also open to travel up to 40%.

Bonus points for:

  • Partner Co-Marketing: Experience co-marketing with NVIDIA, OEMs or cloud providers.

  • Regional Network: Existing relationships with AI cloud, telco or GPU infrastructure buyers in North America.

  • Open Source & Infrastructure: A background at an open-source or infrastructure software company.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: $140K - $160K

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect / Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Contract Duration: 12 months Engagement: Full-time contract Location: Remote, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina Project ObjectiveOur client is looking for a senior, hands-on Data Architect / Engineer to lead the design and delivery of an analytical data platform in Microsoft Fabric.
jobs.description:
Contract Duration: 12 months
Engagement: Full-time contract
Location: Remote, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina

Project Objective

Our client is looking for a senior, hands-on Data Architect / Engineer to lead the design and delivery of an analytical data platform in Microsoft Fabric.

The objective is to offload historical and analytical workloads from a core transactional product into a secure, governed analytical data store. The solution must preserve the authorization context required for downstream consumption, support customer-facing reporting, and establish a foundation for future data products.

You will own the technical delivery of this initiative, working with internal teams and external technical partners from discovery and architecture through implementation, production readiness, documentation, and knowledge transfer.

Key Outcomes

  • Deliver a production-ready architecture that separates transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Design and implement ingestion and historical offload from Azure-based transactional databases into Microsoft Fabric.
  • Establish a layered or medallion architecture covering source-aligned, transformed, and consumption-ready data.
  • Create analytical and semantic models that support secure downstream reporting and customer-facing use cases.
  • Understand the application's roles, permissions, and visibility rules, and translate the required authorization context into appropriate analytical access patterns.
  • Design for historical preservation, change handling, retention, deletions, reconciliation, and future transactional data purging.
  • Implement the engineering controls required for production operation, including testing, data quality, monitoring, recovery, security, and deployment.
  • Assess the existing ingestion and analytical processes, retaining what works and improving or replacing what does not.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture decisions, operational runbooks, and implementation knowledge throughout the engagement.
  • Transfer knowledge to the internal Data & Analytics team so the platform can be operated and extended after the contract.

Required Experience

  • Senior-level experience delivering data architecture and data-engineering solutions in production environments.
  • Proven experience transforming data from complex OLTP applications into analytical platforms, data warehouses, lakehouses, or OLAP solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience building data solutions in Azure, with practical experience or working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience designing layered or medallion data architectures, analytical models, semantic layers, and downstream consumption patterns.
  • Strong understanding of historical data offload and lifecycle management, including incremental change, deletions, retention, archival, reconciliation, and purge considerations.
  • Experience designing secure analytical solutions based on application roles, permissions, tenant boundaries, and access-control requirements.
  • Experience with both single-tenant and multi-tenant data environments.
  • Advanced SQL and strong hands-on Python skills for building maintainable, testable, production-ready data pipelines and transformations.
  • Experience with PySpark or comparable distributed data-processing frameworks.
  • Ability to work across architecture and implementation, independently solve complex problems, and translate decisions into working solutions.
  • Experience leading technical delivery across internal teams and external partners.
  • Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools for technical discovery, development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation, with appropriate review and validation of outputs.
  • Strong written and spoken English.

Engagement Expectations

You will act as the primary technical owner for the assigned project scope. Success requires hands-on delivery, proactive identification of technical risks, clear communication of decisions and trade-offs, and close collaboration with Data & Analytics, Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, and external delivery partners.

The engagement is expected to produce a working, supportable solution, not only an architecture recommendation or proof of concept.

Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.

About the Company

Our client helps some of the world’s largest brands control how they collect, share, and use data. Its enterprise platform connects privacy governance, consent management, and AI governance, giving organizations the controls they need to protect customer information and adopt AI responsibly.

Customers include Hilton, Sephora, AT&T, Allianz, and CVS, with many relationships spanning more than five years. Recognized as a Leader in the Magic Quadrant, our client pairs product innovation with established enterprise adoption.

The company is profitable and founder-led. Its Founder/CEO also serves as CTO: he built the original technology and personally secured major enterprise customers in the company’s first few months. You will work directly with a founder who understands the product, the buyer, and what it takes to win complex accounts.

The Mission

Give enterprises the ability to innovate with data and AI while respecting individual privacy and choice.

Our client turns that mission into practical controls: connecting customer permissions, privacy obligations, and AI governance to how data moves through the business.

Lead an existing enterprise sales team and help turn a strong customer and product foundation into the next stage of revenue growth.

As Head of Sales, you will manage approximately 2-3 AEs and 5-6 BDRs. You will own team execution, coach sellers, strengthen pipeline generation, and personally contribute to closing business.

This role suits a leader who wants broader responsibility without losing touch with customers. You will work directly with the Founder/CEO on sales strategy and execution, with meaningful influence over hiring, team development, and how the business goes to market.

Our Work Environment

Benefits

  • Paid Company holidays plus additional company-wide days off for team members to rest and recharge

  • Four Day Weekends for President’s Day, Memorial Day, and Labor Day

  • Free Subscription to LinkedIn Learning to support professional development

  • 401k match

  • Health & Financial Wellbeing support

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options

  • Virtual and in-person team events

  • Community groups open to all team members

  • Paid 12 weeks off for parental leave

Compensation

  • Base range of $55,000 - $70,000 based on experience + variable compensation with uncapped commissions.

  • This is a full-time remote position, Exempt - not eligible for overtime.

Our Commitment to Pay Transparency: What Does That Mean For You?

  • We will not ask you what you are currently earning.

Teton is building the predictive intelligence layer for senior care. Our AI and computer vision platform passively and privately understands what is happening across residents, staff and space, then turns it into actionable insight for frontline caregivers, operators and owners.

Founded in Copenhagen in 2020 and backed by a $20M Series A led by Plural, Teton is used every month by more than 10,000 care staff across the US and Europe. Operators running Teton report 50–70% fewer falls and a 20% reduction in temporary and night staffing. We are now scaling across US skilled nursing and senior living portfolios.

The role

The Director of Skilled Nursing Regulatory & Compliance is Teton's senior authority on federal and state SNF regulation. You will translate regional and national knowledge of SNF compliance across all 50 states into Teton's product, so our platform helps operators meet the Requirements of Participation, perform well on surveys and protect residents.

You will work across product, clinical, legal and customer teams. Your guidance shapes what we build, how our insights are positioned, and how SNF operators use Teton to stay survey-ready every day.

Translate regulation into product

  • Serve as Teton's subject-matter expert on 42 CFR Part 483 (Requirements of Participation), the State Operations Manual Appendix PP, F-tags and the long-term care survey process.

  • Map what Teton's platform observes (falls, supervision, rounding, call response, behaviors, staffing patterns) to the regulations and F-tags it supports, such as accidents and supervision, quality of care, and sufficient staffing.

  • Define compliance requirements with product, data science and engineering; review features and validate that outputs support, and never undermine, regulatory obligations.

  • Track CMS rule changes, survey guidance updates, minimum staffing developments, and state legislative and regulatory changes, and turn them into roadmap input.

Protect Teton and our clients

  • Advise on how in-room sensing and AI must be deployed in each state, including resident consent, privacy, electronic monitoring laws and HIPAA.

  • Partner with legal and security on policies, documentation and contract language tied to SNF regulation.

  • Make sure Teton's documentation and insights hold up to surveyor, state agency and auditor scrutiny.

Drive client outcomes

  • Help SNF operators' compliance officers, administrators, DONs and regional leaders use Teton to stay survey-ready and support Plans of Correction.

Build internal capability

  • Train Teton's commercial, customer success and product teams on SNF regulation and survey fundamentals.

  • Create state compliance playbooks and a repeatable process for launching Teton in new states.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of direct involvement in compliance and regulatory oversight for skilled nursing facilities, ideally at the regional or national level for a multi-state operator.

  • Expert, current knowledge of 42 CFR Part 483, SOM Appendix PP, F-tags, the LTC survey process and enforcement remedies.

  • Working knowledge of state SNF licensure and regulatory requirements across multiple states, and how state survey agencies differ in practice.

  • Track record of leading survey readiness, Plans of Correction, mock surveys and compliance programs across a portfolio of facilities.

  • Familiarity with incident and abuse reporting, resident rights, HIPAA and OIG compliance program guidance for nursing facilities.

  • Clear communicator who can explain complex regulations to clinicians, engineers and executives alike.

Nice to have

Why Teton

jobs.description:
Full-Stack Engineer - Operations Engineering Team

Hybrid or Remote working in the UK or Germany.

We’re looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to build the systems that power iwoca’s German business.

You’ll join the Operations Engineering team, a cross-functional group that builds the proprietary tools (like our CRM) that our German operations staff use every day. You’ll own high-impact projects from the ground up, using your technical experience and curious mindset to improve how we serve small businesses while also helping to level up the wider engineering team.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Operations Engineering team is a cross-functional group consisting of three full-stack engineers and one product manager. The team works closely with the Operations, Operations Strategy and Analytics teams to deliver impactful changes across the wider Operations function. The team builds and maintains the internal systems – including tools for underwriting, notifications, and account management – that power iwoca’s German market. They support more than 70 colleagues across sales, credit, and collections who rely on these tools every day.

As the German business grows, the Operations Engineering team is moving beyond small improvements and into reworking how work is done. By reducing manual steps and improving how information flows through the company, the team directly influences how quickly other teams can act, how reliably iwoca can support its customers, and where we can most effectively spend human effort.

The role

You’ll work on the systems that internal teams rely on to serve customers. You’ll take an initial problem, engage with stakeholders, and develop solutions through to delivery and see the outcome in daily use. You’ll design and build full-stack services that support core operational workflows, including customer communication, underwriting, and collections.

  • Simplify workflows: You’ll decide when and what to automate, translating operational needs into reliable code that reduces manual effort.

  • Evolve the architecture: You’ll identify ways to modernise our systems, managing trade-offs to keep them dependable as they scale.

  • Advocate for quality: You’ll be a key part of the team, using code reviews and design sessions to advocate for better engineering practices and staff user experiences.

  • Expand your scope: You’ll join a growing team that supports individual ownership, offering you opportunities to lead projects end-to-end, developing your commercial judgement.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Proven track record designing and building backend systems using Python, with the ability to work across front-end codebases, particularly React or TypeScript, to deliver projects end to end.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow—whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

  • Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL or similar, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations.

  • Able to use lateral thinking to anticipate technical challenges and to improve existing systems that support complex workflows.

  • A track record of taking work from an initial problem through to delivery, including shaping solutions, making trade-offs, and iterating based on how systems are used.

  • Strong communication skills to be able to explain complex technical topics in simple terms and to articulate and influence decision making within the team.

Bonus:

  • Knowing how to scale systems: Familiarity with working on internal tools or platforms used by large operational teams.

  • Framework experience across Python and TypeScript such as Django, FastAPI and React.

  • Modern deployment experience: Working with CI/CD pipelines or deployment workflows.

  • A data-driven mindset: Using data or metrics to assess whether changes have had the intended effect.

The salary

We expect to pay from £75,000–£90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation Range: £75K - £90K

Head of Revenue Operations

Based in NYC ideal, but would consider other profiles.

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our product alleviates administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden healthcare professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

With strong demand and clear product-market fit, Teton now operates in more than eight countries across multiple care verticals, from senior living and care homes to skilled nursing and hospital systems - and we continue to expand. This is a rare opportunity to own the systems, data, and processes behind a multi-country, multi-vertical go-to-market engine, and to build the foundation that scales it.

Reporting to the VP of Sales, the Director of Revenue Operations will own Teton's end-to-end GTM infrastructure across Marketing, Business Development, Account Management, and Customer Success.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • GTM systems & data: Own the revenue tech stack (HubSpot, enablement, enrichment and AI tools), automation, integrations, and data hygiene, so every team, territory, and vertical works from a single source of truth.

  • Revenue analytics & forecasting: Build forecasts across territories and verticals based on what actually drives revenue (pipeline, conversion rates, rep capacity), track pipeline health, show which marketing and sales activities generate revenue, and report accurately to the board, flagging risks early.

  • Territories, quotas & comp design: Design territory structures and account coverage across countries, verticals, and segments; model capacity and headcount plans; set quotas; and build incentive plans aligned to enterprise SaaS-plus-hardware economics and a land-and-expand motion.

  • Deal desk & commercial operations: Design and enforce scalable processes for pricing governance, exception handling, and contracting workflows. Partner with Sales, Legal, and Finance to support complex multi-site enterprise deals, and public tenders.

  • Revenue lifecycle & operating cadence: Establish shared definitions, SLAs, and handoffs across Marketing, Business Development, Account Management, and Customer Success. Act as the glue between Marketing, Sales, and Customer leadership, keeping MQL/SQL standards, pipeline hygiene, renewals and expansion contracts, and the weekly and quarterly operating rhythm on track.

  • New vertical & market launches: Stand up the GTM infrastructure for each new vertical and country (segmentation, target account models, reporting, and comp) so new teams are productive from day one.

  • Team & process scaling: Build and lead the RevOps function, standardize playbooks across territories, and drive continuous improvement across GTM.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 7+ years in GTM or Revenue Operations at B2B SaaS companies, including at least one startup where you set the RevOps strategy, laid the foundations and systems from scratch, and scaled them through Series B and beyond.

  • Education: Degree in an analytics-heavy discipline (STEM, economics, computer science) or equivalent experience.

  • Stack architect & data owner: Admin-level HubSpot/CRM expertise, with the ability to scale it into a global, enterprise-grade system across multiple countries, currencies, and business lines through governance, automation, and integration with sales, marketing, and CS tools.

  • Forecasting & revenue analytics: A track record of improving forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene, building exec and board dashboards, and showing which marketing and sales activities actually generate pipeline and revenue. Fluent in ARR, NRR, and conversion metrics across a land-and-expand model.

  • Coverage, quotas & incentives: Experience designing territories and capacity models, setting quotas, and building comp plans for long enterprise cycles and hybrid SaaS-plus-hardware economics, ideally across multiple countries and segments.

  • Multi-market complexity: Experience supporting a GTM organization that sells into several verticals or countries, each with distinct buyers, sales cycles, and pricing.

  • Change leadership: Proven ability to drive adoption by codifying processes, shipping concise playbooks, training teams, and iterating based on data-observed friction.

  • AI-literate toolset: Pragmatic use of AI and automation to boost precision, personalization, and productivity, without sacrificing quality.

  • Bonus: Experience in healthcare technology, senior living, or hardware-enabled SaaS.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

  • A career-defining opportunity to shape the revenue engine of a category-defining AI company.

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

  • 401(k) plan, paid time off, and health, dental, and vision insurance.

What It's Like Working at Teton

We're a growing team of extremely hard-working and talented people. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged, it's expected. It's a hands-on environment where you'll be challenged, supported, and constantly learning.

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job. With us you will have an opportunity to make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride and not just a job, jump on board.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Principal National Support Engineer II provides the highest level of technical expertise and experience to the Fujifilm Healthcare Medical Informatics business covering all currently offered products including, but not limited to: storage systems, PACS (Radiology/Cardiology), VNA, Mobility, 3D Systems, Syncomm and Clinical Information Systems. While this position primarily supports the Technical Assistance Center (TAC), technical leadership and direction is provided to all other functional departments within the business including development. In some cases, support is also provided to the modality side of the business as well.

The Principal National Support Engineer II will assist in driving all aspects of customer support related issues that are mostly technical in nature, although system administration and clinical support is provided utilizing the escalation process. The Principal National Support Engineer II will evaluate, triage, present and work in concert with development to ensure optimal customer experience and timely resolution to high priority issues.

Additionally, the Principal National Support Engineer II is tasked with documenting all activities associated with an issue and providing communications (service bulletins, procedures, etc.) to the TAC, Project Engineering and Upgrade teams and in some cases directly to the customer. As needed, training is to be provided by the Principal National Support Engineer II to the various technical (in some cases) non-technical areas on new software/product releases.

The Principal National Support Engineer II is also tasked with leading support issues to resolution being seen at customers site and work directly with development by functioning as a dedicated technical liaison.

In addition, the Principal National Support Engineer II will provide after-hours technical support via the On-call process for down-site situations 24/7.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead major incident resolution efforts, taking ownership of the most critical customer cases end-to-end.
  • Act as a designated Subject Matter Expert (SME) for specific product areas, providing advanced guidance to peers and junior engineers.
  • Deep Technical Individual Contributor: Expert troubleshooter and primary interface for complex escalations, mastering 3 core product lines and able to effectively support a minimum of 1 or more of other products offered by Fuji.
  • Proactively mentor and guide junior technical support engineers, contributing to their technical development.
  • Tasked with providing advanced technical training to the TAC, Upgrade and Project Engineer team members.
  • Tasked with the review and triaging of escalations received from TAC for domestic customers, present this issue to development, and work with development until resolution.
  • Tasked with the review and triaging of escalations received from International Partners, presenting the issue to development, and works with development until resolution.
  • Work in concert with TAC and/or directly with domestic customers as needed until resolution.
  • Work in concert with TAC and/or directly with International Partners as needed until resolution.
  • Works directly with development on special projects, new software/product releases or as needed.
  • Tasked with communicating clinically related issues to development.
  • As needed, drive technical issues directly with customers.
  • When requested, assist the marketing and sales teams is responding to technically related questions presented in Request for Proposal (RFP) received to win new business opportunities.
  • Operates with minimal managerial supervision, while being driven through self-motivation and driving issues to completion.
  • Engages immediately upon request from TAC on issues with high visibility customers and highly complex escalation.
  • Provide technical assistance to the international partners.
  • Provide on-call assistance to TAC, PE, or UE teams for down sites after hours support.
  • Collaborates with peers and all other FUJIFILM teams to solve complex technical issues and develop innovative solutions.
  • Adheres to the Escalation Process requirements for timely escalated issues according to established procedures.
  • Consults with TAC and Development to analyze Synapse issues that require Development action.

  • Provides insight and direction during the process of creating, reviewing, and publishing documentation, and publishing of Knowledge Base articles in a timely manner.

  • Maintains an expert working knowledge of current medical imaging products and related technologies.

  • Stays abreast of the latest industry/technology advances through continuous education.

  • Provides guidance to the team members based on management direction.

  • Works cross-functionally with other Synapse teams/products as required and handles other duties as assigned.

  • Positive customer surveys, documentation accuracy and consistency, and special project completion, and completion for all assigned training are standard expectations for all FUJI engineers.

  • Maintains a high level of success with yearly goals provided by your manager and metrics defined on a team level.

  • Working outside of normal business hours, overtime, holidays, and participation in an on-call rotation are required to cover the needs of the business.

  • Based on the need, short notice overnight travel, based on the needs of the business, to work on customer systems may be required.

  • Adheres to the Company's quality and regulatory compliance requirements, without exception, and ensures that all job duties inherent in the position description are performed in accordance with established policies and procedures.

  • Comply with all applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) medical device regulatory requirements, applicable ISO 13485 standard requirements and all other applicable laws, regulations, and standards.

Additional responsibilities for a Principal National Support Engineer II consist of the following and is not limited the items listed below:

  • Provide 24/7 down-site support as required
  • Assist in the Management of key issues at the customers site that have been escalated to development.
  • Provide down site support as needed 24/7.
  • Facilitates the coordination of internal departments within HCUS required for issue resolution.
  • Act as dedicated technical liaison to development when working key issues at a customer site.
  • Works with the customer to establish timelines for action items.
  • Provide Technical expertise and experience to the Principal National Technical Engineer Team members.
  • Begin contributing to small to medium-sized internal projects aimed at improving support tools or processes.

Key Performance Indicators:

To maintain this position, the Principal National Support Engineer II must:

  • Maintain all currently held Industry certifications.
  • Maintain and expand the expert knowledge of their current primary product line and future releases.
  • Continue in driving and working issues within development until resolution.
  • Provide advanced technical knowledge Lead National Support Engineer and other parts of the organization including (but not limited to) TAC, PE, and UE teams.
  • Create, review and publish applicable documentation in timely fashion.
  • Respond to escalation requests within the response times identified in the approved escalation process.
  • Conduct training to other parts of the organization via virtual meeting and/or in person training classes.

Qualifications:

  • Masters (preferred) with 6 years industry experience or Bachelor’s Degree with industry experience of 8 years or comparable work experience of 10 + years of industry experience.
  • Leading Industry Certifications, not limited to:
  • Security Certification (Security + or higher).
  • Current VCP Certification.
  • VCP certification.
  • CISCO Certification.
  • Oracle Certification.
  • Microsoft Certification.
  • AWS Certification.
  • Minimum ten (10) years of progressive experience as a Technical, Systems, Software or Quality Assurance Engineer in Medical IT and/or Imaging products.

Physical Requirements:

The position requires the ability to perform the following physical demands and/or have the listed capabilities:

  • The ability to sit up 75-100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to stand, talk, and listen for 75% of applicable work time.
  • This position is very active and requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, and/or crawling under a desk.
  • Ability to be able to lift and/or move items that weigh up to 50 pounds frequently.

jobs.excerpt: About UTOPIAUTOPIA is a venture studio (Utopia Studio) and fund manager platform (Utopia Capital) headquartered in Doha, operating across the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Africa.
jobs.description:
About UTOPIA

UTOPIA is a venture studio (Utopia Studio) and fund manager platform (Utopia Capital) headquartered in Doha, operating across the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Africa. The platform combines early-stage venture funds with an in-house studio that builds companies directly, supported by a proprietary technology infrastructure that shortens the time from idea to build. A team of 30 runs capital deployment, company-building and infrastructure together, giving the platform direct access to markets, data and operating relationships across three regions.

UTOPIA is anchored by sovereign wealth and Qatar's leading development institutions, and is invested in alongside family offices, high-net-worth investors and foundations. The platform is regulated by the Qatar Financial Centre Regulatory Authority (QFCRA), and its investor base sets the standard for the financial rigour, compliance and operational discipline it runs to. UTOPIA builds and backs early-stage ventures led by domain experts, with capital efficiency and disciplined execution central to how it operates.

The Role

The Legal & Compliance Manager keeps the platform's regulatory, compliance and legal obligations current and on time across both Utopia Studio and Utopia Capital. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. The Manager owns the compliance calendar, prepares and coordinates filings, keeps registers and records accurate, and puts the policies and frameworks set by leadership into day-to-day practice. Regulatory strategy and controlled-function accountability sit with the COO and CEO. The MLRO and Compliance Officer functions are held externally through a service provider, and this role works alongside them to make sure the platform meets its obligations on time.

Reports to: COO.

Direct reports: None.

Works closely with: COO, CFO and finance, People & Operations, the outsourced MLRO / Compliance Officer, external counsel and company secretary, and the Utopia Studio and Utopia Capital teams.

Location: Doha, Qatar (full-time, with some remote allowances during the summers)

Compensation: circa US$50,000 per annum.

What you will own

There are four areas of ownership: regulatory filings, compliance operations, legal administration, and governance records. Together they keep the platform's obligations met on time across both entities.

Regulatory filings & reporting

  • Own the platform's regulatory filing calendar across both entities: track every QFCRA (and other applicable) deadline, and support the Compliance Officer with preparing submissions and accurate and on-time filings.

  • Coordinate periodic regulatory returns and maintain a clear record of what has been filed, when, and what is next due, so status is visible at any moment across all group entities

  • Own the compliance and filing cycle for the fund vehicles (Cayman & QFC)

  • Own the reporting calendar to our investors and LPs: track deliverables and milestones, prepare and coordinate the periodic reports, and make sure every submission is complete, accurate and on time.

Compliance operations

  • Run day-to-day compliance monitoring against existing policies, and act as the internal point of contact for the outsourced MLRO and Compliance Officer, gathering information, completing first-line checks and following actions through to closure.

  • Execute onboarding and KYC due diligence, screening, and the upkeep of conflicts, gifts and entertainment registers.

  • Prepare (when needed) compliance reporting packs for the COO and board, and support supervisory engagement and audits by assembling documentation and tracking remediation actions to closure.

  • Coordinate the fund-level AML and economic substance obligations in Cayman with the outsourced administrator and appointed officers, keeping the platform's records aligned with what is filed offshore.

Legal & contract administration

  • Draft, review and process standard-form agreements (NDAs, vendor, engagement and service agreements) and manage the contract lifecycle from request to execution to storage.

  • Maintain the contract register and central legal repository so every agreement is filed, findable and current.

  • Coordinate with external legal counsel on matters beyond standard scope, managing instructions, turnaround and documentation.

  • Own corporate housekeeping across the platform's entities, ensuring that registrations, renewals, licences and statutory records are completed on time.

Governance & records

  • Keep the platform's policies, registers and corporate records organised, version-controlled and up to date.

  • Maintain accurate entity and shareholding records across the Group and keep the corporate register current.

  • Ensure documentation is retained and organised to the standard the platform's regulator and investor base expect.

Who we are looking for

  • 4–6 years in a compliance, regulatory reporting or filings function, ideally within a regulated financial services, fund management or professional services environment.

  • A bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as accounting, finance, business or economics.

  • A law degree or specialist compliance certification is not mandatory, though a legal or compliance background is advantageous. What matters most is the years you have spent working hands-on inside a compliance or reporting function.

  • Practical familiarity with regulatory filing and compliance processes; direct QFCRA, DFSA, FSRA or comparable exposure is a strong advantage.

  • Meticulous and deadline-driven, taking pride in nothing being late, nothing being missed, and every record being accurate.

  • Highly organised and self-directed, comfortable owning a calendar of recurring obligations and chasing the inputs you need from others.

  • Practical and execution-minded, more focused on getting the filing done correctly

  • GCC experience preferred; familiarity with Qatar's institutional and regulatory landscape is an advantage.

  • Temperament: reliable, discreet, calm under deadline pressure, and comfortable holding colleagues to account to get documentation in on time.

Why this Role

  • Real ownership of the platform's day-to-day regulatory and compliance execution across both a fund manager and a venture studio.

  • A clearly defined, hands-on role reporting directly to the COO, focused on day-to-day execution while strategy and accountability sit above you.

  • Institutional context: sovereign-grade anchor partners, a QFCRA-regulated environment, and an investor base that sets a high operational standard.

  • A platform at the point where it scales, giving you the chance to build reliable, repeatable compliance operations for both entities.

We believe innovation should be inclusive and globally distributed. Our team is built on openness, curiosity, and collaboration — with people from across the GCC, Africa, and Southeast Asia working together to build meaningful ventures.

All roles are based in Doha, Qatar, with flexible hybrid options and global travel opportunities (unless otherwise stated). We welcome talent from every background to join us in shaping the future of AI-native innovation.

jobs.description:
My jsme Teya!

Teya vznikla na základě jednoduchého přesvědčení: lokální podniky si zaslouží víc.

Jsou to kavárny, restaurace, salony, obchody a podnikatelé, kteří vdechují život našim ulicím, vytvářejí pracovní místa a drží komunity pohromadě. Finanční služby jim však život příliš dlouho jen ztěžovaly – zbytečně složitými nástroji, špatnou podporou a komplexností, která je při podnikání jen brzdí.

Teya existuje proto, aby to změnila.

Budujeme finanční platformu pro lokální podniky po celé Evropě – platformu postavenou na jednoduchých nástrojích, propracovaném designu a reálné lidské podpoře. Naši členové na nás spoléhají, že jim pomůžeme podnikat s jistotou, a tato zodpovědnost formuje způsob, jakým pracujeme. Postupujeme rychle. Záleží nám na kvalitě. Jdeme do hloubky detailů. A věříme, že skvělé výsledky a upřímná pohostinnost by měly jít ruku v ruce.

Pokud chceš vytvářet smysluplné produkty, řešit reálné problémy a přinést lokálním podnikům skutečnou změnu, ozvi se nám!

Co tě u nás čeká? 🚀

Hledáme zkušeného obchodníka do terénu na pozici Business Development Manager, který se připojí k našemu rychle rostoucímu obchodnímu týmu, vezme věci pevně do rukou a pomůže nám posunout byznys na další úroveň.

  • Autonomie a výsledky: Konzistentně plnit KPI s minimální mírou vedení a udržovat přesné záznamy v CRM, reporting a dokonalý přehled o pipeline.

  • Akce v terénu: Proaktivně vyhledávat a oslovovat potenciální zákazníky ve svěřeném regionu prostřednictvím přímého oslovování, networkingu a doporučení.

  • Konzultativní prodej: Setkávat se se zákazníky osobně, rozumět jejich potřebám, výzvám a cílům a budovat důvěru skrze hodnotový prodej a dlouhodobé vztahy.

  • Nové segmenty a větší klienti: Rozšiřovat dosah Teya do nových segmentů a získávat větší, vysoce hodnotné klienty a podniky s více provozovnami s využitím (nejen) tvých dosavadních kontaktů.

  • Rozvoj produktové znalosti a podpora týmu: Rozvíjet silnou znalost produktů a řešení Teya, školit ostatní a podporovat juniornější obchodní zástupce prostřednictvím koučování, stínování a sdílení znalostí.

  • Zpětná vazba a inovace: Sdílet a vytvářet poznatky o potřebách zákazníků, konkurenci a trhu s cílem zlepšovat produkty, procesy a zkušenost obchodníků, včetně identifikace příležitostí pro partnerství a integrace.

  • Strategické projekty: Zapojovat se do mezioborových strategických projektů a navrhovat zlepšení, která mají přímý dopad na výsledky oblasti a kvalitu výstupů.

  • Upselling a cross-selling: Budovat dlouhodobé vztahy se zákazníky a aktivně identifikovat relevantní příležitosti k rozvoji jejich spolupráce s námi.

  • Reprezentace a kultura: Reprezentovat Teya jako důvěryhodný, profesionální ambasador vedený našimi hodnotami a přispívat ke spolupracující, výkonnostně orientované prodejní kultuře, která si cení učení.

  • Týmová podpora: Nejsi na to sám. V týmu si radíme, sdílíme tipy a navíc se inspirujeme od kolegů z Velké Británie, Maďarska, Chorvatska nebo Islandu.

Co k tomu potřebuješ? ✅

  • Jazyky:Češtinu/slovenštinu (C1) a angličtinu na plynulé úrovni (B2) – budeš v kontaktu s českými klienty i kolegy ze zahraničí.

  • Drive: Zkušenost s obchodem alespoň 3 roky, silná orientace na výsledky, vedení obchodních jednání na úrovni, plánování, reportování a doručování cílů.

  • Komunikace: Musíš si umět s lidmi povídat, vysvětlit jim složité věci jednoduše a umět je přesvědčit.

  • Týmový duch: I když jsi v terénu sólo, pořád jsi součástí party, která táhne za jeden provaz. Mrkni na náš Instagram @, ať vidíš, s kým do toho jdeš!

  • Odolnost: Fintech roste raketově. Musíš umět reagovat na změny a nebát se dynamického prostředí.

Co za to?💰

  • Férová fixní mzda + motivující bonusy – tvoje snaha se cení!

  • Flexibilita – nemáme pevnou pracovní dobu a na home office se vždy domluvíme

  • 26 dní volna + 3 sick days – protože odpočinek je základ

  • BenefitPlus karta, Stravenky a Příspěvek na Dopravu (Lítačka) – vše, co potřebuješ pro pohodlný pracovní život, od Multisportky přes obědy až pocestování po městě.

  • Péče o duševní zdraví s Hedepy – abychom ti pomohli udržet si psychickou pohodu a balanc.

  • Pravidelné týmové meetingy a školení – dny plné inspirace, sdílení zkušeností, skvělé atmosféry i příběhů našich zákazníků

Chceš do toho jít?

Celý proces se snažíme držet svižný a přátelský – stejně jako naše kultura. Žádná zbytečná kola navíc, ale férový a otevřený přístup.

jobs.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Please note that eligibility may vary depending on your location, as some regions may not be supported by the client.

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

  • Ability to lead large and/or enterprise-wide engagements, facilitate meetings, create action plans, mentor teams of junior team members and effectively manage client escalations.

  • Salesforce.com Certifications (Admin, Service, Experience, etc.) strongly preferred
  • Salesforce Agentblazer Innovator preferred
  • Build and Empower Teams: Leading, motivating, and holding accountable project and internal/external team members in a matrixed organization. Fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Influence and Communicate: Act as the primary communicator for the program, taking project level details and aggregating up to provide clear and concise updates to multiple levels of leadership, including executive sponsors.
  • Program Health Reporting: Defining and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure program success and health.
  • Value Realization Reporting: Support creation of the business case/ROI aligned with the required data driven metrics for objectively measuring outcome attainment
  • Location Preferences: Ottawa, Toronto or Vancouver

Security Clearance:This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian Government Security Clearance. Candidates are not required to hold an active clearance at the time of application or interview; however, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain clearance as a condition of employment.

  • Reliability Clearance: Requires providing 5 years of verifiable work and residence history, generally from within Canada.
  • Secret Clearance: Requires providing 10 years of verifiable work and residence history, generally from within Canada

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

  • Review and annotate document images to accurately identify text, paragraphs, tables, and other document elements.
  • Correct Optical Character Recognition (OCR) errors, including spelling mistakes, missing characters, formatting inconsistencies, and transcription inaccuracies.

  • Process multilingual documents while preserving language-specific characters, writing systems, and special symbols.
  • Follow project guidelines and annotation standards to ensure consistent, accurate, and reliable outputs.
  • Identify discrepancies in annotated data and make corrections in accordance with established instructions.
  • Maintain high levels of transcription accuracy and data quality while meeting project deadlines.
  • Review complex document layouts and technical content to ensure the integrity of digitized information.
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders and follow quality requirements throughout the document annotation process.
  • Native or near-native proficiency in Haitian Creole or Quechua.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify minor errors in text, formatting, and document layouts.
  • Demonstrated ability to transcribe text accurately and reproduce exact characters, punctuation, symbols, tables, and mathematical expressions.
  • Familiarity with OCR text correction, document annotation, bounding box adjustment, or related data quality tasks.
  • Understanding of Markdown formatting and structured document representation.
  • Ability to review multilingual text while preserving special characters, diacritics, and language-specific writing conventions.
  • Strong reading comprehension and the ability to follow detailed instructions and annotation guidelines.
  • Ability to work independently, maintain consistent quality, and meet project deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when identifying discrepancies in document data.
  • Ability to work with complex document layouts, scanned images, tables, mathematical notation, and technical content.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in data annotation, OCR correction, document digitization, transcription, or data quality review.
  • Familiarity with scanned documents, complex layouts, tables, mathematical notation, and LaTeX equations.
  • Experience working with multiple languages, multilingual documents, or non-Latin scripts.
  • Experience following structured quality assurance procedures and annotation guidelines.
  • Ability to maintain high accuracy and consistency when processing large volumes of document data.

The organization is looking for candidates with native or near-native proficiency in Haitian Creole or Quechua, strong attention to detail, and the ability to accurately process complex document layouts, tables, mathematical expressions, and multilingual text.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Student Loan Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location:United States (Remote)

Time Commitment: 15-25 hours/week, short-term project

micro1 is looking for Student Loan Specialists to help evaluate and improve AI systems on federal student loan topics. You’ll use your borrower counseling experience to check that questions sound like ones real borrowers would ask and that answers are correct and useful. Accuracy comes first. No AI experience required; your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Review sample federal student loan questions, identifying and flagging those that do not reflect real-world borrower inquiries.
  2. Draft and refine rubrics that outline what constitutes accurate and comprehensive answers to repayment, forgiveness, and relief program topics, such as income-driven repayment (IDR) plans and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).
  3. Expand rubric coverage to include loan servicing challenges, deferment, forbearance, and default management scenarios.
  4. Evaluate AI-generated answers using your rubrics, thoroughly checking for inaccuracies, missing details, or outdated guidance.
  5. Provide concise, constructive written feedback to the project team asynchronously, supporting ongoing improvements to answer quality.
  6. Spot and communicate instances of incorrect guidance, ambiguous borrower communication, or problematic servicing advice.
  7. Collaborate with other experts as needed to ensure rubrics and feedback reflect current federal student loan practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. At least one year of direct experience advising borrowers on federal student loans in contexts such as nonprofit counseling, college/university financial aid offices, loan servicing, or default management.
  2. Demonstrated expertise with federal loan repayment strategies, income-driven repayment (IDR) plans, forgiveness programs (such as PSLF), deferment, forbearance, and default resolution.
  3. Practical knowledge of loan servicing operations, servicer-related challenges, and strategies for communicating with borrowers effectively.
  4. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey technical guidance clearly and efficiently.

  • Lead SD-WAN design and architecture for enterprise clients, creating scalable and resilient network solutions

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to managed services engineers, sharing best practices and expertise
  • Integrate UCaaS solutions including MetaSwitch platforms with enterprise networks
  • Implement Zero Trust security models across SASE deployments
  • Develop and maintain network automation scripts and procedures
  • Provide advanced engineering support and serve as technical escalation point
  • Create detailed technical documentation, runbooks, and training materials
  • Collaborate with Command|POD teams to ensure 100% uptime SLA compliance

  • Lead network transformation projects from legacy architectures to SASE/SD-WAN solutions
  • Takes on additional responsibilities and projects as needed to support the success of the team and organization

What you'll need for success:

  • 7-10 years of enterprise network engineering experience in managed services environments
  • Strong SD-WAN design and architecture experience with proven track record of successful enterprise deployments
  • Expert-level knowledge of SASE and SD-WAN technologies, specifically:
    • Cato Networks SASE Cloud Platform
    • Fortinet FortiGate, FortiManager, and FortiSASE
    • Versa Networks Unified SASE Platform
    • Cisco Meraki full stack (MX, MS, MR) with SD-WAN
  • Deep understanding of SASE architecture including ZTNA, CASB, SWG, and FWaaS
  • Strong experience with network security including NGFW, IPS/IDS, and Zero Trust architectures
  • Proficiency in routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) and switching technologies
  • Experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP) and multi-cloud connectivity
  • Experience with UCaaS platforms, particularly MetaSwitch
  • Proven ability to mentor and develop technical skills in other engineers
  • Solid understanding of QoS, traffic shaping, and WAN optimization
  • Automation skills using Python, Ansible, or similar tools
  • Experience with RESTful APIs and network programmability
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with packet capture and analysis tools
  • Relevant certifications highly desired (CCNP, Fortinet NSE, Cisco Meraki, Versa, Cato)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to interface directly with clients
  • Experience working in MSP/managed services environments

Why you'll love life at Command|Link
