Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

jobs.description:
Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology here.

Job Summary:

Wealth Enablement ensures every client-facing team member feels supported and knows what to do, when, and why when serving clients. The VP will centralize content strategy, lead curriculum development, and drive solution adoption for a more consistent, proactive client experience. The VP will lead the Enablement function to build scalable, AI-enabled training and content infrastructure across Wealth Management and Wealth Solutions. This leader will set strategy, build the team, and drive behavioral change and adoption at scale — bridging corporate functions and the field.

Essential Job Functions for this role include:

Content Strategy & Curriculum Ownership

  • Own the centralized content strategy across all client-facing cohorts — Wealth Management (advisors and client service) and Wealth Solutions (Tax, Estate, Financial Planning, Emerging Solutions).
  • Maintain curriculum architecture that separates the CS (Relationship Manager and Service Operations Associate)/Advisor and WM/WS tracks, tailoring content to each audience's complexity and behavioral needs.
  • Create high-quality, scalable advisor playbooks, onboarding frameworks, and field-facing tools that equip advisors to deliver better client outcomes — evolving from episodic content to a centralized, maintained system.
  • Partner with Relationship Expansion so advisor-facing content is built for field delivery, not just housed centrally.

Advisor Adoption & Behavioral Change

  • Lead the function's evolution from a generalist support model to a specialized team that drives measurable behavioral change and builds advising capabilities across advisor teams.
  • Use our product pilot and launch methodology to serve as the field advocate for new technology, tools, and solutions — including AI-powered capabilities — before and during rollout.
  • Define growth gearing ratios (FTE per cohort size) and build the organizational infrastructure to scale onboarding and ongoing enablement as Mercer grows through M&A.
  • In partnership with Partner Success, build on-demand support capacity for acquisition integrations so newly joined advisor teams are onboarded rapidly and effectively.

Team Leadership & Organizational Build-Out

  • Build and lead a structured Enablement team organized across Wealth Management and Wealth Solutions — ultimately with dedicated Directors and FTE support for each.
  • Recruit for skills that match each cohort's complexity, replacing a generalist model with domain-specific expertise that can credibly engage and influence advisors.
  • Use team operating rhythms, performance telemetry, and accountability frameworks to measure content effectiveness, field adoption, and client impact.
  • Serve as the long-term architect of Mercer University — the 3-year horizon vision for Mercer's internal learning and development infrastructure.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Relationship Expansion to ensure Enablement content is deployable by field leaders and embedded in advisor meeting cadences.
  • Work alongside Segment Delivery to align accreditation and training programs with segment-specific delivery models (Ascend, Regis, Custom Wealth, WealthPath).
  • Serve as a business-to-technology bridge — advocating for advisor needs in product design so what's built drives the right field outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • 10+ years of experience in enablement, learning & development, or field effectiveness roles within wealth management, financial services, or a complex, field-oriented professional services organization.
  • Demonstrated success building or scaling centralized enablement functions — not just managing existing L&D programs, but architecting new ones from the ground up.
  • Track record of driving measurable advisor or field sales behavioral change, with evidence of adoption outcomes and performance improvement.
  • Experience managing and developing teams of content creators, trainers, and program managers, ideally using AI to accelerate their output.
  • Familiarity with the complexity of a post-M&A integration environment and the enablement demands it creates.
  • Ideally, the candidate will have a CFP and / or previous experience directly serving clients.
  • Strategic thinker who can translate business priorities (NRR, retention, 'One Mercer' delivery) into curriculum design and behavioral change programs that strengthen the client experience.
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator who builds influence without direct authority across Relationship Expansion, Segment Delivery, Operations, and Technology.
  • Data-informed approach — uses telemetry, adoption metrics, and field feedback to iterate and improve content and delivery systems.
  • AI-fluent — well-versed in AI tools and able to apply them to accelerate content creation, personalize learning, and scale enablement, while championing responsible adoption across the field.
  • Exceptional communicator and executive presence — able to represent Enablement to senior leadership and serve as a credible spokesperson for field needs in the product design process.
  • Builder mentality — energized by ambiguity and the opportunity to create structure where none exists.
  • Advisor- and client-first orientation — knows advisor adoption drives client outcomes, and designs every program with both the field and the end client in view.
  • Collaborative and low-ego — this role requires deep partnership across WO&E and the broader business; success requires earning trust, not asserting authority.
  • Comfortable with pace — Mercer is a high-growth, acquisition-driven firm; the Enablement leader must operate in a dynamic environment while maintaining quality and consistency.

Work Schedule:

This professional role requires availability during standard business hours of Monday through Friday from 8AM to 5PM. At times, the role may have early or late hours to meet business tasks and deadlines for external and internal client needs.

All roles classified as a non-exempt are required to record working time into the timekeeping system daily at the start and end of each workday plus a 30-minute unpaid lunch period.

Working Conditions:

This position may be in a professional office environment or a dedicated home office workspace which is free of interruptions. Whether position is in a dedicated office space or home office workspace, basic technology needs will be provided to satisfy position requirements. Routinely sitting and standing for periods of time. No heavy lifting over 10 lbs.

We encourage all interested candidates to apply as early as possible. If a final decision has not been made by the initial deadline, subsequent applications will be reviewed as they are received.

Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

Ready to own the close and turn complex TPA data into numbers everyone can trust?

Why This Role Matters

Every decision our TPA business makes starts with financials people can trust, and you’re the one who makes that possible. As TPA Accounting Manager, you run the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for the TPA entity, making sure the books are accurate, compliant, and tightly controlled. You’ll work across internal teams and back TPA initiatives with the financial rigor they need to succeed. The reliability of our reporting and the quality of our audits both run through your work, so when you perform at your best, the whole organization can move forward with confidence.

What You'll Actually Do

  • Own the close: Lead the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for key areas of the TPA entity. You’ll prepare and post journal entries, complete account reconciliations and accruals, and upload data in the ERP against the close calendar, all in line with US GAAP and internal accounting policies.
  • Apply ASC 606 to TPA contracts: Identify performance obligations in TPA service contracts and evaluate variable consideration, including performance guarantees and fees at risk, so revenue is recognized correctly.
  • Track performance guarantee exposure: Account for related client credits and keep the business informed of potential financial impact, so no one is surprised at quarter-end.
  • Reconcile and audit large data sets: Tie out data across the ERP, TPA systems, and third-party reports, and catch discrepancies before they reach the financials.
  • Hunt down root causes: Investigate and resolve discrepancies alongside system and operations teams, then put corrective actions in place that keep the same issue from coming back.
  • Power compliance and licensing: Prepare TPA financials for license renewal and for regulatory and fiduciary account requirements.
  • Build a strong control environment: Document processes, controls, systems, and workflows so the way we work is clear, repeatable, and audit-ready.
  • Drive the annual audit: Prepare the gross-to-net adjustment, supply backup documentation, respond quickly, and close out open items.
  • Partner with Tax: Coordinate on sales/use tax, legal entity financials, and other tax inputs, so Tax has what it needs when it needs it.
  • Streamline and automate: Identify and lead opportunities to simplify reconciliations, cut manual effort and errors, and automate recurring work.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance
  • 5 to 7 years of progressive accounting or financial operations experience
  • Preferred: experience in a TPA, health insurance, or broader insurance environment
  • Preferred: experience with performance guarantees, fiduciary accounts, or statutory reporting
  • Preferred: experience leading process improvement or automation initiatives

Technical Skills:

  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP, including revenue recognition under ASC 606
  • Advanced Excel and proficiency with Microsoft Office
  • Root cause analysis of complex, large-volume data sets
  • Preferred: hands-on experience with NetSuite, QicLink, and Javelina

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $120,000 - $140,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

jobs.description:
Start Date: ASAP

Role Type: Full-Time, Salaried

Background: Software development

Location: Remote,Flexible (USA based)

Salary: $160,000-$190,000 per year, plus benefits

Who We Are:

The Modern Classrooms Project (MCP) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that empowers educators to build classrooms that respond to every student’s needs. Founded by two award-winning teachers, we lead a movement of educators in implementing a self-paced, mastery-based instructional model that leverages technology to foster human connection, authentic learning, and social-emotional growth.

To date, we have reached over 100,000+ teachers through our free online course in 150+ countries. We are an ambitious, idealistic team led by former classroom teachers, and we are passionate about what we do.

Job Description - Why we need you!

For the past eight years, we have empowered educators to use technology more effectively. Last year, we secured funding to begin developing our own edtech software products.

We need an experienced, hands-on, AI-native Senior Software Engineer to help transform our product vision into reality. You will be a foundational member of our new technical team, taking the lead on back-end and generative AI content pipelines, and creating intuitive, powerful tools that will directly support educators and students every day.

Key Responsibilities

As Senior Software Engineer, you will be a senior individual contributor on our engineering team, reporting to the Head of Engineering and collaborating closely with the Chief Innovation Officer to ship features that make a real difference for students and educators.

You’ll be joining a small and growing team of talented software engineers working together to solve the problems our teachers face every day, make teachers more effective, and make our evidence-based model more accessible to any educator who wants to help all of their students succeed. We need you to help us make that happen.

You will:

  • Ship multiple substantial features per week. This is a minimum velocity bar, not an exaggeration. You will leverage AI and agentic coding to build incredible software, very, very quickly.
  • Operate as the technical lead and steward of your agentic coding pipeline. Write detailed prompts and specifications, and embrace Spec-Driven Development. Compose orchestrator agents and dispatch agent teams. Engineer RALPH Loops with well-formed completion promises. Actively multitask between several agents to simultaneously develop multiple substantial features in parallel.
  • Build the AI workflow engine that powers our products. Develop state-of-the-art graph-based agentic orchestration workflows with nodes and conditional edges, structured outputs, interrupts and human-in-the-loop circuit breakers. Implement durable execution, long-running work that survives process restarts, rate limits, and outages, with an evaluation harness, versioned prompt chains, annotated datasets and cross-provider benchmarks on cost, latency, and quality.
  • Architect resilient, high-scale backend systems. Design and scale distributed infrastructure across Python and TypeScript to support heavy edtech workloads. Own the systems design, API boundaries, and database performance, ensuring that our foundational architecture remains highly available, secure, and ready to scale.
  • Extend the context layer. Contribute to our AGENTS.md and Agent Skills so that every session produces better work than the last. These are living production artifacts, and you own the parts that describe your domain.
  • Partner on architecture. Collaborate closely with the Head of Engineering, Chief Innovation Officer, and other product leaders on technical direction, feature roadmap, and the hard technical design decisions and trade-offs underneath.
  • Raise the bar for the team. Review the work of teammates and contractors. Collaborate with teammates on architecture and implementation reviews. Write PR comments, design docs, and agent skills that make the next person faster.

You should apply if:

  • You are AI-native. You are an expert in continuous multi-session development with Claude Code and/or OpenAI Codex. You are an expert at prompt engineering and context engineering. You write Agent Skills the way other engineers write unit tests. You practice Spec-Driven Development (GitHub Spec Kit or equivalent) as part of your normal workflow. You know what a RALPH Loop is and how to deploy one.
  • You ship, a lot. You deliver multiple large features per week. Not because you're cutting corners, but because you've rebuilt your workflow around agentic tools and you have the taste to steer them well. You know the difference between vibe-coding and prompt engineering with specification-driven work, and you know which one to reach for in which situation.
  • You have built real backend AI orchestration layers that run when you're not watching. You think in graphs — shared state flowing through nodes, conditional edges, interrupts, and circuit breakers. You have shipped non-trivial agentic pipelines using LangGraph, Python, and TypeScript, or equivalent. You treat durable execution, structured outputs, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and provider-agnostic model routing as baseline design constraints. You have built evaluation harnesses, annotated datasets, and versioned prompt chains as first-class artifacts.
  • You are self-directed. You thrive in small, high-autonomy teams and startups where the surface area is broad and the context shifts constantly. You write clearly. You own a problem end-to-end without waiting for a ticket to tell you what to do next.
  • You love to learn. You're actively leveraging the latest developments in AI and applying them to enhance both your own and others' work. You're also motivated by MCP's mission and vision, and eager to build teacher- and student-facing products.
  • You want to shape the world. You're motivated to be part of something larger than yourself. You believe that the highest value of your talent is using it to empower others. You're ready to make a real difference in educators' and young people's lives.

It would also be helpful if:

  • You have experience building edtech products.
  • You have experience handling sensitive and/or confidential data, particularly in an education context (COPPA, CIPA, FERPA, PPRA, SOC 2).

Compensation and Benefits

We aim to offer a competitive compensation package, as well as the opportunity to work in a fast-growing nonprofit that is on a mission to improve education worldwide. This includes:

  • Salaried position: $160,000-$190,000 gross salary per year
  • Employer-sponsored health insurance through CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield
  • Employer-sponsored dental and vision insurance through MetLife
  • Participation in Vanguard 403(b) deferred-compensation plan with 3% employer match
  • Paid Time Off, inclusive of: vacation/PTO (20 days), paid holidays, paid parental leave, sick and safe paid time off, "Me Days", and the ability to earn paid Comp time off
  • Annual budget for MCP-funded Continuous Learning for the program(s) you request (available after 6 months of continuous full-time employment)
  • FSA and Dependent Care FSA access
  • 1x Salary Life Insurance company-paid coverage
  • Access to Wishbone Pet Insurance Benefit
  • Ability to work remotely and to set your own hours (within reason)

Overview

About Certara

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

About the Team

The Certara PBPK consultancy team is a global organization focused on using the Simcyp® physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) and physiologically based biopharmaceutics modeling platform to influence decision making on drug development programs from discovery to regulatory filing.

We are the largest PBPK consultancy team in the industry, and our PBPK/PBBM consultants work with hundreds of clients to inform human PK prediction, drug-drug interaction assessment, recruitment and dose adjustments in specific population predictions and biopharmaceutics application including biowaiver, virtual bioequivalence and formulation bridging.

We are seeking a highly motivated, experienced and talented PBPK/PBBM modelling scientist to lead and drive our biopharmaceutics modeling strategy and business.

The successful candidate will join an internationally recognized, multidisciplinary company, providing opportunities for further development of knowledge and skills. We offer a unique and exciting mix of academic and commercial environments which encourage regular attendance at scientific meetings as part of our continuous education programs.

Please note: The post does not include routine laboratory or clinical work.


Responsibilities

Reporting to the Senior Vice President of PBPK Consulting, the role involves leading consultancy projects with clients in the Pharmaceutical Industry to develop PBPK models primarily for biopharmaceutics applications. Specific responsibilities include:

  • Leading biopharmaceutics modeling team of PBPK/PBBM scientists
  • Drive biopharmaceutics modeling business strategy
  • Act as lead consultant across biopharmaceutics and other PBPK modeling projects
  • Oversee work performed by others in your team, including reviewing modelling work, regulatory responses and developing modelling and simulation plans
  • Act as a biopharmaceutics subject matter expert for business development to generate new business clients and maintain existing client relationships
  • Lead and contribute to scientific engagement and marketing activities in field of biopharmaceutics and PBPK modeling
  • Be a contributing member of the PBPK consulting leadership team
  • Keep abreast of the latest scientific developments in PBPK/PBBM communication with colleagues, clients and the wider scientific community
  • Oversee work performed by others in your team, including reviewing modelling work, regulatory responses and developing modelling and simulation plans
  • Grow and mentor the biopharmaceutics modeling team and broader PBPK consultancy group
  • Lead and contribute to cross-Certara modeling and other initiatives

Qualifications

  • A PhD degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience in biopharmaceutics/formulation/IVIVE/drug metabolism/pharmacokinetics
  • 8+ years of experience in the field of PBPK/PBBM modelling with demonstrable experience in biopharmaceutic applications
  • In-depth knowledge of the application of PBPK modelling in the drug discovery and development process and awareness of its acceptance across various regulatory bodies
  • Demonstrable practical experience with the leading PBPK/PBBM modeling platforms, ideally including Simcyp®.
  • Ability and desire to supervise a team of scientists and/or consultants within the PBPK consulting team.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills to effectively engage with peers and clients within industry, academia and regulatory agencies
  • Peer-respected standing in the industry to grow a client base and expand the PBPK consultancy group globally

Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.

Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Red Team Tester – Mid to independently perform authorized adversarial assessments of our government customer's systems, applications, networks, APIs, and cloud environments. You will develop and execute realistic attack scenarios aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework, identify exploitable attack paths that automated vulnerability scanning does not reveal, and evaluate how well defensive controls detect and respond. You will turn technical results into actionable findings and remediation recommendations, and you will guide less-experienced testers through technical mentoring and peer review.

Named one of the Washington Business Journal’sBest Places to Work every year since 2014, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: Remote with ad hoc travel to the Washington DC Metro area.

Required Clearance: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance

Eligibility Requirements: U.S. citizenship is required to obtain the necessary clearance for this position.

Required Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • A senior industry professional certification such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting penetration testing, red team assessments, or offensive security testing.
  • Hands-on experience testing enterprise networks, applications, APIs, or cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of common exploitation techniques and attack paths across Windows and Linux environments.
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and penetration testing methodologies.
  • Experience with tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Wireshark, Nessus/Tenable, BloodHound, or comparable offensive security tools.
  • Scripting experience in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Exposure to AWS cloud security testing.
  • Additional offensive security certifications such as OSCP, PNPT, eJPT, CEH, or Security+.
  • Experience translating technical testing results into well-supported findings and remediation recommendations.

Responsibilities:

The Senior Director also leads QMS integration assessments associated with acquisitions, mergers, divestitures, and business expansions, including evaluation of quality system maturity, compliance, certification impacts, and integration risks. Develops, standardizes, and continuously improves tools and standard work supporting Notified Body engagement.

The Ithaca College School of Health Sciences & Human Performance (HSHP) invites applications for a full-time, 12-month, multi-year renewable notice (non-tenure) appointment as a Clinical Instructor/Clinical Assistant Professor of Speech-Language Pathology and Online Director of Clinical Education to begin December 1, 2026, or as soon as possible after that date. This position can be fully remote. The successful candidate will teach assigned online classes in speech-language pathology and serve as the Online Director of Clinical Education for our online master’s in Speech-Language Pathology, participating in departmental, school, and college service; and advising students as needed. Scholarly activity is required per departmental policy for clinical faculty.

The Online Director of Clinical Education will be responsible for managing all aspects of clinical placements for online students in the M.S. degree program, in cooperation with the Experiential Learning Specialist for HSHP and the graduate chair of the online modality. The position requires the ability to manage databases, maintain records, coordinate with external partners, meet deadlines, and problem-solve under tight timelines. The Online Director of Clinical Education serves as the supervisor and liaison for all practicum experiences for the online graduate modality. Ithaca College is strongly committed to increasing the diversity of its curriculum and fostering an inclusive environment for its campus community. To that end, candidates with related experience are encouraged to apply and to identify their strengths and expertise in these areas. Ithaca College continually strives to build an inclusive and welcoming community of individuals, with diverse talents and skills from a multitude of backgrounds, who are committed to civility, mutual respect, social justice, and the free and open exchange of ideas.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in communication disorders
  • Certificate of Clinical Competence in speech-language pathology from the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in provision of clinical service
  • At least 1 year of clinical supervisory experience
  • Minimum of 2 hours continuing education in clinical supervision, per ASHA requirements
  • Potential for excellence in teaching

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in academic teaching in postsecondary setting
  • Supervising clinical placements
  • Experience and expertise in online teaching
  • Administrative experience
  • Experience in supporting diversity, equity, inclusion, access and belonging initiatives.

Salary Range:

$73,000-$81,000, commensurate with experience and rank

About the SLPA Department:

The Department of Speech-Language Pathology & Audiology at Ithaca College recently celebrated its 100th anniversary. The master’s degree in speech-language pathology is accredited by the Council on Academic Accreditation of the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association. Ithaca College is consistently ranked among the best in the Northeast, and is noted for hands-on preprofessional education, offering both liberal arts and professional degrees. The School of Health Sciences and Human Performance offers graduate degrees in a range of allied health and medical fields, including athletic training, exercise science, occupational and physical therapy, and physician assistant studies.

About Ithaca College:

Ithaca College is a comprehensive residential campus community of approximately 5,000 students, consistently ranked among the best in the Northeast. IC offers a distinct integrative learning experience designed to prepare students for the personal, professional, and global challenges of our age. Since its founding, the College has recognized the profound impact of combining academic theory with hands-on practice and a distinctive integration of performance. With 70 majors and 70 minors across five industry-leading schools, students benefit from small class sizes, personal mentorship, collaborative partnerships, and professional guidance—supported by expert faculty and first-rate facilities typically found at larger institutions.

At Ithaca, faculty and staff are deeply committed to student education and growth. As thought leaders moving their fields forward, IC faculty not only mentor students but also continue to develop as professionals who use their knowledge and expertise to make a difference in the world. Ithaca College is especially noted for hands-on preprofessional education, offering both liberal arts and professional degrees. The School of Health Sciences and Human Performance offers graduate degrees in several health-related fields, including physician assistant studies, athletic training, exercise science, occupational and physical therapy, and speech-language pathology.

Nestled in the heart of New York State’s scenic Finger Lakes region, Ithaca College sits atop South Hill overlooking picturesque Cayuga Lake and is just minutes away from the city center. Combining small town warmth and charm with the vibrancy of a college community, the thriving and culturally diverse city of Ithaca has been rated by Kiplinger’s as one of the top 10 places to live in the United States.

We are seeking a Senior Consumer & Marketing Insights Manager who will bridge the gap between customer and market understanding and business decision-making.

The role is accountable for identifying high-value business questions, delivering rigorous research, translating findings into clear recommendations, and ensuring that recommendations receive an explicit decision and accountable handover.

Business and functional leaders remain accountable for final tdecisions, resource allocation and implementation.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with business leaders to identify and prioritise the customer, market and brand questions most relevant to Novakid’s strategic goals.

  • Design and execute rigorous quantitative and qualitative research, including panel studies, surveys, focus groups and appropriate AI-enabled research methodologies.

  • Analyse and interpret data to produce clear, unbiased and commercially relevant insights.

  • Translate insights into specific recommendations, explaining the expected business opportunity, supporting evidence, risks and proposed success metrics.

  • Facilitate decision sessions with relevant stakeholders and ensure that each recommendation is accepted, rejected or deferred with a documented rationale.

  • Co-create action plans in which every approved recommendation has a named business owner, deadline and success metric. The business owner remains accountable for implementation.

  • Follow up on agreed actions, measure the results of implemented recommendations and capture lessons for future decision-making.

  • Lead a monthly Research Council, sponsored by the CMO, to prioritise research, review findings, make decisions and track the outcomes of previously approved recommendations.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success will be assessed through:

  • the strategic relevance and methodological quality of the research portfolio;

  • the clarity, timeliness and actionability of recommendations;

  • the percentage of completed projects that result in an explicit business decision;

  • stakeholder satisfaction with the quality of the partnership and recommendations;

  • the percentage of approved recommendations with a named owner, deadline and success metric;

  • the measured contribution of implemented recommendations to conversion, retention, brand performance, customer experience or revenue.

The Senior Consumer & Marketing Insights Manager contributes to business impact through better decisions but is not solely accountable for outcomes that depend on implementation by other teams.

Requirements

  • Who You Are:

    • A senior consumer and marketing insights professional with strong quantitative and qualitative research capabilities.

    • Commercially minded and able to connect customer understanding with business strategy.

    • Proactive in identifying important unanswered questions rather than waiting only for research requests.

    • Able to communicate complex findings clearly and credibly to senior and C-level stakeholders.

    • Skilled at facilitating alignment, surfacing disagreements and obtaining explicit decisions.

    • Comfortable challenging assumptions through evidence while recognising that final business decisions and implementation sit with the accountable business leader.

jobs.excerpt: We're Sharp PerformanceSharp Performance exists so that everyone who answers the call has someone in their corner who has walked in their shoes.
jobs.description:
We're Sharp Performance

Sharp Performance exists so that everyone who answers the call has someone in their corner who has walked in their shoes.

We help first responders and their spouses thrive through confidential coaching from people with similar lived experience. Our coaches have carried the badge, worn the gear, or stood beside someone who did. Through our mobile platform, we connect law enforcement, firefighters, and other frontline professionals with coaches who understand the job because they have lived it.

We're early-stage and backed by amazing investors. The team is small enough that your work shows up in the rollout, the product, and the customer's experience within weeks. If building something that matters alongside people who hold a high standard sounds better than a safe seat somewhere else, come build it with us.

About the role

Sharp Performance runs a 1-1 coaching marketplace. The C-Squad owns the core platform behind it: the backend, data model, and integrations that coaches, managers, and every other squad build on. That platform got us here. Now it needs to scale to support more users and functionality without slowing the teams that depend on it.

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to co-own that problem. You'll help set the technical direction for the platform, write a real share of the code, and raise the bar for how the squad designs, ships, and runs software. This is a senior IC role with team-level leverage, not a people-management track.

How we build

We're all in on agentic engineering. Every squad runs AI agents across the SDLC: implementation, code review, testing, incident triage, and maintenance. We treat agents as participants in delivery, not chat assistants. That means a disciplined harness around them: tight scope, specialized agents, verification, and human approval before anything ships. Right now we're giving agents controlled access to production evidence (code, logs, database state) so they can test hypotheses and validate fixes themselves.

That changes what platform work means here. Our systems serve customers and the agents building on them. Clean interfaces, fast feedback loops, good observability, and safe guardrails make both humans and agents faster.

What you'll do

  • Co-own the architecture and long-term health of our core platform: a Laravel monolith with its database, API, background jobs, and internal admin tooling.
  • Build platform foundations other squads rely on: stable APIs and contracts, CI/CD, environments, feature flags, observability, and on-call readiness.
  • Lead scaling work end to end. Find the bottlenecks in the database, queues, caching, and third-party integrations, then fix them before customers feel them.
  • Decide where the monolith should stay a monolith and where a service, queue, or event boundary actually pays off. Write the doc, make the call, and land the migration safely.
  • Make the platform agent-ready: well-bounded modules, fast CI, reliable test environments, and safe, auditable access for agents to the evidence they need.
  • Harden reliability and security as we grow: multi-tenant data isolation, access controls, audit trails, and incident response that holds up to SOC 2.
  • Collaborate with C-Squad engineers. Review designs and code, mentor, unblock, and keep the squad's output coherent.
  • Work with product and the other squads on roadmap trade-offs, especially when platform work competes with feature work.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years building and running production backend systems, with recent time at staff or lead level.
  • A product mindset. You care as much about what we build as how we build it. You ask “why” early, push back when something doesn’t serve users, and work with product and design to shape the roadmap, not just execute it.
  • Deep platform engineering experience: you've owned the infrastructure, deploy pipeline, and runtime of a growing product, not just features on top of it.
  • A track record of scaling a system through real growth. You can tell us what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.
  • Strong relational database skills (MySQL or PostgreSQL): schema design, query tuning, indexing, migrations on live data.
  • Hands-on with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), containers, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with async and distributed patterns: queues, workers, webhooks, idempotency, retries.
  • Comfort leading through influence. You've set technical direction for a team and brought people along.
  • Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents. You know where they help, where they fail, and how to review and de-risk what they produce.
  • Experience building agent tooling or harnesses: skills, MCP servers, eval loops, or guardrails for agents touching production systems.
  • Clear written communication. You write design docs people actually read, and you explain trade-offs to engineers and PMs alike.

Nice to have

  • PHP and Laravel (Horizon, Nova, queues). Not required: strong engineers from Go, Python, Ruby, Node, Java, or similar who can ramp quickly are a good fit.
  • Experience breaking up or modernizing a monolith without a big-bang rewrite.
  • Observability tooling (Sentry, Datadog, or similar) and running incident response.
  • SOC 2/HIPAA or other compliance work in a production environment.
  • Integrations with scheduling, calendar, SMS, or email providers at volume.

Why this role

You'll help own the system everything else at Sharp runs on, at the point where scaling decisions start to compound, and you'll shape how an AI-native engineering team works at the platform level. The scope is wide, the team is small, and your calls will shape how fast every squad can move for the next few years. We're remote-first, async-friendly, and low on process.

Why You'll Want to Be Here

Sharp is a Series A company growing quickly, already working with 100+ public safety agencies, and backed by Andreessen Horowitz and investors behind some of the world's most successful technology companies. Your work helps improve the health, performance, and longevity of the people who run toward danger.

The package includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Access to the same performance coaches we offer our clients

Om Lawgent

Lawgent är en modern juristbyrå byggd för företag som verkar i en tid där juridik, AI, data och europeisk reglering allt oftare möts.

Vi arbetar för att göra komplex juridik tydlig, konkret och användbar. Våra klienter ska inte bara få veta vad lagen säger. De ska förstå vad den innebär för deras verksamhet och vad de faktiskt behöver göra.

Vår verksamhet omfattar bland annat AI och data, GDPR, digital reglering, finansiell reglering, kommersiell juridik, regulatorisk rådgivning och europeisk tillväxt.

Nu växer vi och söker fler jurister i hela Sverige. Du kan bo och arbeta var som helst i landet: vi arbetar digitalt och träffar klienter på plats när det behövs.

Om rollen

Som jurist på Lawgent har du egna klienter och egna uppdrag, från första kontakt till färdig leverans. Du ger råd till företag i frågor där juridiken möter verksamheten, och du gör det så att klienten förstår risken, vilka alternativ som finns och vad nästa steg är.

Du bygger din egen klientportfölj och skapar nya affärer, med stöd av kollegor och ledning.

Exempel på vad du arbetar med

  • Rådgivning till företag inom ditt rättsområde

  • Frågor där AI, data och GDPR påverkar klientens verksamhet

  • Avtal, granskningar och utredningar

  • Klientkontakt, från första möte till löpande relation

  • Nya klientrelationer som du själv skapar och utvecklar

Så arbetar vi

På Lawgent bollar juristerna med varandra varje dag. Det är naturligt att fråga en kollega, oavsett hur länge man har arbetat, och lika naturligt att få frågor själv. Det bästa argumentet får väga tyngst, oavsett vem som kommer med det.

Vi är raka mot varandra och mot våra klienter, och vi vill att det ska vara enkelt att arbeta med oss. Målet är att både klienten och kollegorna vill jobba med dig igen.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har juristexamen eller motsvarande juridisk examen

  • Är nyexaminerad eller har några års erfarenhet som jurist, och vill ta eget ansvar tidigt

  • Talar och skriver svenska flytande. Det är ett krav, eftersom våra klienter finns i Sverige, svensk lagstiftning ska tolkas och arbetet i domstol sker på svenska

  • Uttrycker dig väl på engelska i tal och skrift

  • Tycker om att arbeta tillsammans med andra och tar ansvar för det du lovar

Vi bedömer dig utifrån vad du har arbetat med och hur du arbetar, inte utifrån antal år.

Det är meriterande om du

  • Har kunskap om GDPR och EU AI Act

  • Har haft eget klientansvar

  • Har erfarenhet av affärsutveckling eller av att skapa nya klientrelationer

Ersättning

Du bygger din egen praktik under Lawgents varumärke. Ersättningen är resultatbaserad och utan tak: din inkomst växer med de klienter och uppdrag du drar in. Du får stöd av erfarna kollegor, våra metoder och vårt nätverk från första dagen. Vi går igenom upplägget i detalj under intervjun.

Så söker du

I ansökan svarar du på några frågor och spelar in en kort video där du presenterar dig. Vi läser alla svar innan vi bokar intervjuer.

Skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida.

  • Ensure adherence to MDR, market‑specific requirements, and CooperVision policies.

6. Technical Documentation & Audit Activities

  • Review and assess technical documentation for compliance with MDR and other applicable regulations.
  • Contribute to technical audits and inspection readiness within assigned markets.
  • Support responses to Notified Body queries, audit findings, and corrective actions.

About you:

Skills & Abilities

About the role

Comms8 is looking for a hands-on Bookkeeper & Finance Admin to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration across our group.

This is a practical, detail-focused role for someone who is comfortable keeping financial records accurate and up to date, reconciling accounts, processing invoices and expenses, and preparing regular finance reports.

You will support four entities across two jurisdictions and work closely with our team and accountants in the UK and Hong Kong.

Importantly, our UK and Hong Kong accountants handle all statutory filings and audit requirements. You will provide accurate records and information to support them, but you will not be responsible for owning statutory compliance or audit.

The role will initially focus entirely on finance. Once the month-end process is running accurately and consistently, the role will gradually expand to include general administrative support.

What you'll be doing

Finance & Bookkeeping

  • Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across four group entities
  • Complete regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies
  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable
  • Prepare and issue client invoices and follow up on outstanding payments
  • Process and record business expenses
  • Prepare payroll data for UK employees and offshore contractors
  • Record and reconcile intercompany transactions between business entities
  • Produce a standard monthly finance pack
  • Prepare a weekly cash and aged-debtors report using an established template
  • Maintain accurate and well-organised financial records
  • Respond to queries and provide supporting information to our UK and Hong Kong accountants
  • Support month-end processes and help ensure the books are complete, accurate and ready for accountant review

You will not be expected to handle statutory filings or audits as these will be managed by our UK and Hong Kong accountants, giving you the opportunity to focus on maintaining accurate books and running the day-to-day finance processes well.

Admin Support

Once you have established a reliable month-end routine, the role will expand to include:

  • Contractor onboarding and offboarding paperwork
  • Vendor, subscription and business-tool administration
  • Document filing and record-keeping across the four entities
  • General administrative support for the operations team

What we're looking for

  • 2–5 years of experience in bookkeeping, finance administration or a similar hands-on finance role
  • Solid experience with day-to-day bookkeeping and bank reconciliations
  • Experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing and expenses
  • Good understanding of month-end bookkeeping processes
  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Organised and consistent in maintaining records and following established processes
  • Confident communicating with colleagues and accountants
  • Good written and spoken English
  • Comfortable working across multiple entities and currencies
  • Able to work the required hours with regular overlap with our UK and Hong Kong teams

Experience preparing payroll data, handling intercompany transactions or working with international/remote businesses would be an advantage.

Working arrangement

This is a full-time contractor engagement, not an employment position.

The role is fully remote and open to candidates based across Southeast Asia.

Because you will work closely with colleagues and accountants across the UK and Hong Kong, availability during the required working hours and sufficient overlap with both teams is a mandatory requirement for this role.

Compensation

USD 500–800 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated bookkeeping capability.

What success looks like

In your first few months, the priority will be straightforward: accurate books, clean reconciliations and a dependable month-end process.

Once the finance routine is running smoothly, you will begin supporting selected administrative tasks across the business.

If you are a practical, organised bookkeeper who enjoys keeping financial records accurate and processes running consistently, we'd be pleased to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Us!

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we're proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio's vision.

About Fivestone Studios!

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and making heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

Your Mission

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Immersive Producer to join our team and take ownership of the delivery of complex, multidisciplinary projects across immersive, experiential, digital and physical environments.

We are looking for a senior, hands-on producer who is commercially sharp, highly organised, calm under pressure, and comfortable working across creative, technology, content, fabrication, AV and live environments.

This is not simply a project management role. We need someone who can come into a project, quickly understand what needs to happen, create structure, identify gaps and risks, and drive the team and client towards delivery.

The Senior Producer owns delivery, not the creative or technical answer. The Creative Director owns creative quality. Technical/Technology Leads own technical architecture and specialist decisions. Discipline leads own their areas of execution.

The Senior Producer owns making sure the right people make the right decisions at the right time, with the right information, within the agreed scope, schedule and budget.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

Your Roles & Responsibilities

Project Delivery Ownership

The Senior Producer will own the delivery mechanics across projects, including:

  • Scope — ensuring everyone is clear on what we are and are not delivering.

  • Schedule — building and managing realistic programmes, milestones and dependencies.

  • Budget — managing project budgets, estimates, forecasts, vendor costs, invoices and margin.

  • Resourcing — identifying the right internal and external talent and managing capacity.

  • Client & stakeholder management — driving communication, decisions, approvals and expectations.

  • Risk, quality & change control — identifying issues early, managing dependencies and protecting scope, quality and margin.

  • Documentation & handover — ensuring requirements, decisions, approvals, deliverables and project information are properly documented.

Project Management & Execution

From pre-sales through to closeout, you should be able to independently:

  • Turn a client brief/RFP into a clear scope, assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, schedule and budget.

  • Build and manage project plans, resource plans and budgets.

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary internal teams and external freelancers/vendors.

  • Work closely with Creative, Technology, Design and Production leads without trying to own their specialist decisions.

  • Run client meetings, internal kickoffs, reviews and production cadences.

  • Establish clear deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria and approval processes.

  • Manage procurement, vendor quotes, contracts and change orders.

  • Maintain RAID/risk, decision and change logs.

  • Track project financials, resource utilisation, vendor spend and forecast-to-complete.

  • Manage client feedback and prevent fragmented or uncontrolled scope expansion.

  • Coordinate technical design, prototyping, integration, QA/UAT and installation where required.

  • Be comfortable with the realities of physical production and live environments — site surveys, fabrication, AV, logistics, installation, commissioning and launch.

  • Drive projects through to handover, warranty/support and financial closeout.

The Kind of Projects

You should be comfortable managing projects where multiple disciplines come together, potentially including:

Strategy → UX/UI → Creative → Content → 3D/Motion → Software → Hardware → AV → Fabrication → Installation → Launch

Experience with immersive, experiential, digital experience, exhibition, entertainment, retail, cultural, branded or technology-led projects would be highly relevant.

Requirements

Your Journey Includes

  • Ideally 8+ years of production/project management experience, with meaningful experience delivering complex multidisciplinary projects rather than purely digital or purely corporate projects.

  • Experience across immersive / experiential / museums / cultural / digital / physical / live production, etc.

  • Comfort working with both internal teams and external freelance/vendor networks, and with projects that move from an early ambiguous brief through strategy and concept into technical production, installation and launch.

Your Qualities

  • Senior but hands-on. You should be able to lead a project strategically but also get into the detail when something needs fixing.

  • Commercially minded. You understand that good production means protecting both the client relationship and the company's margin.

  • Highly organised. You naturally create clarity from complexity and make sure nothing falls between the cracks.

  • Proactive. You don't wait for problems to become visible. You identify dependencies, risks and gaps early and push the right people for decisions.

  • A strong communicator. You can speak comfortably with a client, Creative Director, developer, designer, fabricator, vendor or CEO and adjust your communication accordingly.

  • Collaborative but authoritative. You can lead without unnecessarily stepping on the creative or technical ownership of others.

  • Calm under pressure. You are comfortable with changing requirements, tight deadlines, multiple stakeholders and the inevitable challenges of live production.

  • Process-oriented but not bureaucratic. You understand that process exists to make delivery easier, not to create unnecessary administration.

Thank you for applying. We're committed to an inclusive process and we welcome talent from all walks of life. We aim to review every application. Roles in experiential can be ultra-specialized; if it's not a fit for this one, we may still flag your profile for future opportunities. Thanks for helping grow the Sourcing Unicorns talent ecosystem.

Overview

The Director, Global Procure-to-Pay (P2P) leads the day-to-day design, operation and improvement of the end-to-end procurement and accounts payable processes across a global organization, reporting to the SVP, Procure to Pay. The Director turns the P2P redesign into practice: baselining the current-state process, building the target operating model and roadmap, closing control gaps, and delivering automated reporting. This role oversees the organization's shared service center operations in India and serves as the voice of the business in the financial process.

The successful candidate will bring strong leadership, project management, and change management capabilities, with experience designing and optimizing procurement and accounts payable organizations in a complex, multinational environment. This role will serve as a key partner to the Controller on accounting controls and account reconciliations, to the NetSuite team on the technology platform, and to Finance, Technology, and Business Operations leaders to deliver operational excellence, compliance, cost savings, and scalable growth.

Responsibilities

  • Own the global end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, including requisitioning, purchasing, vendor onboarding, invoice processing, payment execution, and supplier management, and manage the details of how the process runs day to day
  • Baseline the current-state end-to-end P2P process, documenting process steps, volumes, systems, handoffs, controls, and pain points, and use the findings to shape the redesign
  • Develop and maintain the P2P target operating model and redesign roadmap in partnership with the SVP, and lead its execution
  • Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics to drive efficiency and continuous improvement, and develop automated reporting and dashboards that replace manual reporting
  • Drive automation initiatives and leverage technology solutions to improve cycle times, accuracy, and customer experience
  • Serve as the voice of the business in the financial process, bringing requester, budget owner, and supplier needs into P2P design and finance decisions, and act as the point of contact for escalations from external and internal stakeholders

Accounts Payable Function Design

  • Design the target accounts payable operating model, including organization structure, roles and responsibilities, tiered support model, service levels, and the division of work between the India shared service center, onshore staff, and automation
  • Design the end-to-end invoice-to-pay workflow, including invoice intake channels, data capture and coding, two-way and three-way match rules and tolerances, exception handling, duplicate detection, and non-PO invoice handling
  • Define approval routing aligned to the delegation of authority, including approver hierarchies, thresholds, delegation and backup rules, and escalation of aged approvals
  • Design payment processes, including payment run schedules, terms management, payment methods, early-pay discount capture, vendor bank-change verification, and remittance
  • Establish payment reconciliation processes that tie payments to bank activity and the general ledger on a defined cadence, with clear ownership of exceptions and aged items
  • Design vendor master data governance, including onboarding and verification, tax documentation, periodic review, and deactivation
  • Embed segregation of duties across requisition, approval, receiving, invoice entry, vendor maintenance, and payment, and review system access against these rules on a recurring basis
  • Define AP month-end close activities with the Controller, including cutoff, accruals for received-not-invoiced items, AP sub-ledger to general ledger tie-out, and aging review
  • Design AP support for tax and statutory reporting, including 1099, sales and use tax, VAT, and withholding, in partnership with the Tax team

Procurement Function

  • Lead the development and maturation of a global procurement organization, including governance, policies, procedures, and operating models.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders across all functions, not only the technology organization, to identify sourcing opportunities and improve procurement compliance and spend visibility.
  • Implement procurement best practices to support cost optimization, risk mitigation, and supplier performance management.
  • Develop supplier management and vendor governance frameworks that align with organizational objectives.

Shared Service Management

  • Provide strategic oversight and leadership of the India-based shared service center supporting procurement and accounts payable operations.
  • Establish a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer service excellence.
  • Partner with service center leadership to optimize processes, staffing models, and productivity.
  • Define service levels, performance targets, and governance for the shared service center

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Procure-to-Pay, Shared Services, Procurement Operations, Accounts Payable, or Finance Operations.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing global teams and/or shared service organizations.
  • Strong knowledge of procurement, accounts payable, internal controls, and process governance.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience managing offshore service center operations, particularly in India with ability to travel to India approximately 2 times per year

Consilio’s True North Values

Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.

Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.

Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.

Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

About Deepdesk

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside.

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks.

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets.

We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go.

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving.

Requirements

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work.

  • Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go.

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch.
  • Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build.

• Front end: TypeScript and React.

  • Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus.
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL.
  • Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus.

  • A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery.
  • Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment.
  • Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python.

Job Title: Associate Consultant - Entry-Level Technology Consulting (Remote)

Job Location: Warsaw, PL

Veeva’s Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an accelerated pathway that transforms early-career professionals into high-impact consultants who deliver cloud and AI solutions, helping global Life Sciences companies bring life-changing therapies to patients.

The Role

You’ll work hands-on with innovative technology, collaborating directly with internal teams and external customers, optimizing their software to solve complex business challenges. In this role, you’ll master our industry-leading cloud platforms and work with cutting-edge AI solutions to transform how life sciences companies operate. Empowered from day one by a team-first culture, you will accelerate your career growth as a technical consultant who thrives in an environment where we work hard for our customers and each other.
Start Dates: October 2026 and April 2027

The Program

As part of the Consultant Development Program, you will:
    • Ramp up quickly. Your journey begins with an intensive, team-based onboarding program that combines hands-on learning, transparent feedback, and active collaboration to develop the consulting skills and industry knowledge to make an impact right away.
    • Learn by doing. You won't be watching from the sidelines. You will take on real responsibility and work directly with customers to solve problems within your first three months.
    • Thrive together. Grow alongside a supportive team of seasoned leaders and peers who actively champion your development through open communication and actionable feedback.
    • Build your future. Advance from Associate to Consultant in less than 2 years. More importantly, you’ll develop the foundation for a successful, long-term career where you can continually expand your technical expertise, lead complex projects, and evolve with our global and diverse team.

What You'll Do

As part of our Managed Services team, you aren't just taking orders; you are a long-term strategic partner. We will teach you how our software works, and you will use that knowledge to solve daily puzzles for our customers. Your day-to-day will involve:
    • Tailoring the software: You will configure our platform to fit exactly what the customer needs—whether that is turning on new features, organizing their information, or adapting the system to match how their business operates.
    • Testing & problem solving: Before new features are released to a customer's entire company, you will help them test those ideas safely to ensure everything works accurately and efficiently.
    • Managing the deliverables: You will take ownership of customer requests by figuring out exactly what needs to be done, estimating how long it will take, and keeping the project on track from start to finish.
    • Becoming a trusted advisor: You will ensure changes are made the right way and actively advise customers on how they can get the most value out of our technology over time.
What We Are Looking For | We are open to graduates of a variety of backgrounds and look for a specific mindset:
    • Drive: You thrive in a challenging, intense environment that rewards initiative and rapid learning.
    • Curiosity: You have a genuine desire to be hands-on with software and master new technologies.
    • Communication: You are fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    • Analytical Mindset: You are a strong critical thinker with a proven track record of academic performance (in any degree/field of study).
    • Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company and we expect that from all employees.
    • Work Ethic: A commitment to excellence and passion for working hard to achieve results.
    • Travel: Willingness to travel as needed (up to 20-30% of the time).
    • Experience: Recent bachelor’s or master’s degree graduate (up to 2 years postgraduate experience maximum)
How We Hire | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
    • Apply: Submit your resume, a short cover letter, and take a quick personality test.
    • Fast Response: We will notify you of your next step typically within one week.
    • Interview & Case: Interview with a Veeva leader. If successful, we will give you a real-world scenario (with 3 days to prepare) to present to our team.
    • Offer: We make decisions quickly—usually within a week of your final presentation.

What We Offer

    • Starting Annual Salary: 120,000 PLN. Perform well, and in one year you’ll receive a compensation increase and participate in our bonus program.
Work Authorization: Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the European Union. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status for this employment position.
Work Environment: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. Associate Consultants work remotely for Veeva in Poland. To take advantage of regular opportunities for in-person collaboration, skill development, and socialization, we require that you live within a 60 minute commute of Krakow, Warsaw, or Wroclaw.

Job Title: Director - Product Management, LillyDirect, EMEA

Job Location: Remote, Indiana, United States of America
