At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


LillyDirect is an innovative, industry-first direct-to-patient e-commerce experience designed to improve access to care, reduce healthcare costs, and provide integrated support to people managing chronic disease. As we scale rapidly, delivering exceptional post-purchase consumer experiences is central to our mission.

We are seeking a visionary Product Management leader to lead product strategy, development, and execution of our digital product portfolio across EMEA. This role is pivotal in shaping how customers experience LillyDirect, driving core KPIs across a consumer focused product portfolio. As a senior product leader, you will define and lead the strategies and roadmaps for consumer-focused digital products designed to reduce friction and build lasting consumer loyalty. We are especially interested in leaders who have launched consumer digital health products within publicly funded, multi-payer healthcare systems alongside a growing private-pay market.

What You Will Do

Product Strategy and Roadmap
Help define and implement a bold EMEA product strategy, roadmap, timeline, and requirements. Align product initiatives with consumer satisfaction goals and business outcomes, CSAT/NPS impact, and ensure consistent delivery across a portfolio of interconnected products. Have a strong voice across the LillyDirect Product team, ensuring that insights inform future strategy. Define how LillyDirect adapts to markets where private prescribing and online pharmacy models operate alongside a national health service.

Team First Mentality
Embody a no-ego, team-first mentality in all interactions. Foster a collaborative culture that prioritizes shared success over individual recognition. Represent the product team with humility and integrity when engaging with business and ops collaborators, engineering, design and third party vendors.

Partnership Champion
Act as a strategic product partner to consumer operations leads, translating collective goals into a compelling product vision and actionable strategy. Collaborate closely with design and engineering to ensure solutions are grounded in consumer needs, are technically scalable, and aligned with the broader LillyDirect experience. Stay up to date on new technology and third-party solutions that augment our roadmap, including online pharmacy, telehealth, and health-system partners. Champion the voice of the consumer in every product decision, CSAT trends, and qualitative research to inform priorities.

User Experience and Design
Partner to understand end-to-end consumer journeys across consumer touchpoints: desktop, mobile web, app, chat, email, phone. Collaborate closely with Design and UXR, to ensure our UX is intuitive and designed as frictionless, anticipating needs before our customers do. Advocate for design quality and accessibility throughout the product lifecycle, and use data-driven insights to continuously reduce consumer friction and improve first-contact resolution rates.

Technical Collaboration and Standards
Partner with engineering leadership to assess architectural trade-offs. Establish technical standards and ensure scalable, modular solutions that can flex with product expansion. Apply working knowledge of health-data privacy requirements under a national regulator, open banking, and national health app ecosystems.

Stakeholder Engagement and Thought Leadership
Build and maintain strong relationships with collaborators. Serve as the internal subject matter expert on consumer product best practices within e-commerce and direct-to-consumer models. Represent LillyDirect’s consumer product vision in industry forums and contribute to thought leadership in customer experience.

Your Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 10 + years of product management experience
  • Demonstrated experience in leading and managing consumer product portfolios at a high-growth e-commerce or direct-to-consumer company
  • Extensive experience partnering and working with engineering teams
  • Experience evaluating third-party solutions and engaging with external vendors
  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

What You Should Bring

  • 5 + years of product management experience shipping products within EMEA markets
  • Proven track record of driving measurable impact in an e-commerce setting
  • Experience launching or operating digital health products in EMEA, ideally within a publicly funded, multi-payer healthcare system
  • Working knowledge of national-level medicines regulation, health technology assessment, and pharma industry codes of practice
  • Familiarity with how regional health bodies, primary care, and prescribing and referral pathways work within a national health service
  • Experience with nationally regulated online pharmacy and private prescribing models
  • Deep understanding of user experience principles and human-centered design
  • Background in managing web and mobile app consumer experiences
  • Exceptional leadership and critical thinking skills with strong eye for business and consumer empathy

Location & Work Flexibility
This is a remote-eligible role. We welcome candidates located anywhere in the United States, with regular overlap with our Silicon Valley and Indianapolis teams. Occasional travel to our hubs for team planning and key moments is expected.

You'll tackle complex challenges at a global scale, drawing on your deep expertise in Java and modern open-source technologies to make a tangible impact on production systems.
You should have extensive experience with Java applications and the latest open-source technologies, ideally from enterprise software development or a high-growth tech company. As a Senior SRE, you'll need to be naturally curious and skilled at problem-solving. You'll also bring a unique engineering perspective, understanding how systems integrate in production to operate at a global scale for hundreds of customers across North America, Europe, and Asia.

    • Build Cloud Infrastructure: Rapidly build new cloud infrastructure from scratch, adhering to software development best practices

    • Lead Incident Management: During an incident, effectively lead triage and mitigation efforts, potentially performing periodic on-call duty for escalations
    • Automate & Optimize: Develop tools and automation to eliminate manual work and reduce issue resolution times
    • Full-Stack Diagnostics: Proactively learn all necessary systems to provide full-stack diagnostics and determine root causes of production problems

    • Influence Design: Participate in engineering design reviews of new features and drive initiatives to improve operational efficiency and platform scalability
    • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Product Management, Design, and QA to deliver cutting-edge solutions and direct customer value
    • Backend Focus: Work across multiple layers of our technology stack, with a primary focus on backend development, and opportunities in frontend and infrastructure
    • Effective Communication: Communicate clearly with engineering teams, succinctly describing problems for seamless hand-offs during outages with both technical and non-technical audiences
    • Mentorship: Actively mentor team members, contributing to a positive and high-performing team environment

Requirements

    • Deep Java Expertise: 5+ years of experience in Java development, with a strong preference for experience within enterprise cloud software companies
    • Operational Experience: Hands-on operational experience in a high-volume or critical production service environment, including incident management and root cause analysis
    • Code Quality: Proven ability to write clean, testable, readable, and maintainable code within a collaborative team setting
    • Open Source Proficiency: Hands-on experience with a range of open-source technologies, such as Spring, MySQL, Hibernate, Solr, Maven, Git, Tomcat, Linux, AWS, Vagrant, Docker, and Kubernetes
    • Database Mastery: 3+ years of experience in relational databases with expert-level SQL skills
    • Scripting Skills: Solid scripting proficiency with languages such as Shell, Bash, Ansible, Python, Go, Ruby, etc.
    • Leadership & Communication: Demonstrated history of incident management and leadership ability, with effective communication skills across all levels (individual contributors to executives)
    • Mentorship: Proven record of making your team better through mentorship

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation

*Ideal candidates will reside in the Dallas, Austin or Houston area.

ABOUT THE ROLE

AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated entirely to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will own AI Security in your territory, from the first conversation through close, hunting the largest new logos while working alongside the Account Executives who already know our customers best. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it.

The timing matters. Abnormal is growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up in close to 80% of customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. Demand is outrunning capacity. You will step into a deep pipeline on day one, and you will have real say in how this category gets sold.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own AI Security in your territory. Carry the AI Security quota and run the full sales cycle end to end, from first conversation through close, including significant upsell campaigns across our existing customer base.
  • Hunt the largest new logos. Take Abnormal's AI Security story into the biggest enterprises in the world, and open doors beyond the customers who already trust us.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly. Inbound interest will outpace your calendar. Decide where your time moves the needle, and where it does not.
  • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your territory, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most.
  • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on behavioral AI, cloud security, and agent security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch.
  • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.
  • Shape the product and the playbook. Feed what you hear in the field back to product leadership in a fast loop, and help build how AI Security gets sold as the suite matures from early availability to GA.
  • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.

WHAT YOU’LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

  • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.
  • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.
  • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.
  • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.
  • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open.

For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of winning new logos and expanding accounts.
  • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.
  • A hunter's drive paired with the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories.
  • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders.
  • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Partnership Development Executive – DeVoe School of Business (B2B & B2G)

Reporting Relationship:Executive Director, Strategic Partnership Expansion

Unit: National & Global

Department: Strategic Partnerships - IWU National & Global

Campus Location: Online/Remote within the United States

Summary of Position:The Partnership Development Executive – DeVoe School of Business represents IWU–National & Global and the DeVoe School of Business in developing B2B and B2G organizational partnerships that create sustainable enrollment pipelines for working professionals and adult learners.

This role focuses on employer-driven talent development by connecting organizations with IWU’s business degree portfolio, including traditional business programs, leadership and management pathways, graduate business programs, MBA-related offerings, and emerging AI-focused business programs and certificates. The position helps employers address workforce needs by developing talent pipelines, career ladders, upskilling pathways, and retention solutions.

The Partnership Development Executive serves as a consultative relationship builder with Human Resources leaders, Chief People Officers, Talent Development Directors, Learning and Development leaders, workforce development organizations, chambers of commerce, municipal and government HR divisions, and other employer decision makers.

This position is designed for a high-potential, relationship-driven professional with non-negotiable excellence in written and verbal communication, professional polish, business acumen, strategic curiosity, and disciplined follow-through. A background in human resources, talent development, workforce development, organizational development, or employer relations is strongly preferred. The successful candidate will identify prospective partners, initiate outreach, conduct professional discovery meetings, present tailored business and AI education solutions, manage pipeline milestones in Salesforce, collaborate with DeVoe faculty and academic leaders, and advance opportunities toward signed partnership agreements.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • B2B and B2G Partnership Development, Discovery, and Advancement
    • Identifies and initiates outreach to prospective employer partners across private-sector, nonprofit, workforce, municipal, and government/public-sector organizations
    • Prepares for and leads professional, agenda-driven discovery meetings with HR executives, Chief People Officers, Talent Development Directors, Learning and Development leaders, City/County HR Directors, state agency HR leaders, workforce leaders, and other organizational decision-makers
    • Positions IWU DeVoe School of Business programs, including traditional business degrees and AI-focused business programs and certificates, as strategic solutions for employer talent pipelines, career ladders, employee upskilling, succession planning, leadership development, and retention
    • Writes clear, polished prospecting emails, executive summaries, meeting recaps, and tailored proposals linking organizational workforce goals to IWU degree and certificate pathways
    • Presents IWU educational solutions, tuition discount benefits, cohort opportunities, and Prior Learning Assessment options clearly and persuasively
    • Works collaboratively with leadership to navigate decision-making pathways, address objections, establish clear next steps, and secure formal partnership agreements using institutional legal templates
    • Develops consultative relationships that move beyond general awareness or event attendance and toward measurable partnership, enrollment, and workforce outcomes
  • Targeted Market Outreach, Strategic Events, & Lead Generation
    • Develops and executes targeted regional outreach plans for priority employers, workforce development boards, chambers of commerce, professional associations, HR networks, and business organizations
    • Builds strategic presence within key professional organizations and employer networks, including SHRM, workforce development organizations, chambers of commerce, talent development groups, industry associations, municipal HR networks, and business leadership forums
    • Partners with DeVoe School of Business faculty by coordinating and exhibiting at events where DeVoe faculty are speaking, presenting, facilitating workshops, or representing the university as thought leaders
    • Leverages faculty expertise and public speaking engagements to generate qualified employer conversations, strengthen DeVoe’s market visibility, and connect organizational needs to IWU programs
    • Uses selective event attendance strategically by conducting pre-event outreach, securing scheduled one-on-one meetings, engaging decision makers during the event, and completing disciplined post-event follow-up
    • Employs market research and AI-enabled prospecting tools to identify workforce trends, talent shortages, skill gaps, AI adoption needs, leadership development opportunities, and high-yield employer targets
    • Represents IWU and the DeVoe School of Business with professionalism at employer meetings, association events, conferences, workforce forums, and community-based business events
  • CRM Pipeline Discipline, Follow-Through, & AI Workflow Utilization
    • Maintains uncompromising daily discipline in Salesforce as the system of record for all accounts, contacts, meeting notes, pipeline stages, and follow-up tasks
    • Demonstrates meticulous follow-through by executing committed action items promptly and maintaining momentum across all active partner relationships
    • Utilizes CRM performance metrics and pipeline management tools to prioritize outreach, track conversion rates, and meet weekly/monthly activity benchmarks
    • Leverages artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to support market research, prospect identification, workflow optimization, strategic planning, communication drafting, and data analysis
    • Ensures that all partner activity is documented accurately, timely, and completely to support team visibility, leadership reporting, and effective handoff
  • Internal Collaboration & Academic Pathway Alignment
    • Collaborates closely with the DeVoe School of Business Dean, faculty, program directors, and academic leaders to understand program offerings, emerging AI curriculum, business programs, custom cohort opportunities, and employer education capabilities
    • Coordinates with DeVoe faculty to support speaking engagements, professional organization involvement, employer-facing workshops, and thought leadership opportunities that can generate partnership conversations
    • Partners with Enrollment Counselors, Marketing, Legal, Operations, and Student Success teams to ensure responsive communication, smooth handoffs, and tailored recruitment campaigns for partner employees
    • Communicates employer feedback, workforce trends, market intelligence, and partnership barriers to academic and enrollment leaders to support continuous improvement and program alignment
    • Helps translate academic offerings into employer-relevant language focused on workforce outcomes, employee development, retention, promotion pathways, and organizational performance
    • Supports internal planning for co-branded employer materials, landing pages, employee communication plans, webinars, information sessions, and partnership launch activities
  • Partner Onboarding, Activation, & Relationship Transition
    • Coordinates the initial onboarding process for newly signed partners, including launch communications, co-branded landing pages, employee announcements, webinars, lunch-and-learns, and discovery sessions
    • Ensures early partner engagement and qualified student interest before transitioning mature accounts to designated long-term account nurture managers or appropriate internal owners
    • Documents onboarding steps, communication commitments, stakeholder contacts, and future engagement opportunities in Salesforce
    • Supports a smooth transition from signed agreement to active enrollment pipeline by coordinating internal teams and ensuring timely follow-up with partner contacts
    • Monitors early partner activity to identify additional opportunities for employee engagement, cohort development, program alignment, and future growth

Qualifications:According to Indiana Wesleyan University employment policy all employees must possess a strong Christian commitment and adhere to the standards outlined in the IWU Community Lifestyle Statement.

Education

  • Required: Minimum of a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution
  • Preferred: Master's degree in business, Human Resources, Management, Leadership, Communication, Higher Education, or equivalent experience

Experience

  • Required:
    Minimum of two to four (2-4) years of successful professional experience in human resources, talent development, learning and development, workforce development, organizational development, B2B sales, B2G sales, business development, partnership development, account management, employer relations, higher education recruitment, corporate recruitment, or a related externally facing role
  • Preferred:
    Experience working with employers, HR leaders, workforce organizations, business associations, chambers of commerce, professional associations, government agencies, or talent development networks
  • Ideal Background:
    A candidate with a talent development, workforce development, organizational development, or employer relations background is strongly preferred because this role requires understanding of workforce planning, employee development, career ladders, retention, talent pipelines, and organizational learning needs
  • IWU is willing to consider candidates with less direct partnership development experience if they demonstrate exceptional communication skills, strong business acumen, professional presence, coachability, initiative, and disciplined follow-through

Required Skills

  • Exceptional Written Communication:
    Proven ability to write clear, polished, persuasive, and error-free business correspondence, prospecting emails, meeting recaps, executive summaries, and proposals. A writing assessment may be part of the interview process
  • Professional Presentation and Executive Polish:
    Confidence, poise, and clarity when presenting to HR executives, C-suite leaders, workforce leaders, faculty, internal stakeholders, and professional business audiences
  • Business Acumen:
    Understanding of employer needs related to workforce planning, talent pipelines, career ladders, employee retention, leadership development, upskilling, succession planning, and organizational performance
  • Consultative Relationship Building:
    Ability to ask strong discovery questions, listen carefully, identify organizational needs, summarize opportunities accurately, and connect employer challenges to relevant IWU academic solutions
  • Strategic Thinking:
    Ability to evaluate partner fit, prioritize high-potential opportunities, plan outreach intentionally, and use events and professional networks to generate qualified partnership conversations
  • Disciplined Follow-Through and Organization:
    Strong time management, attention to detail, personal accountability, and proactive follow-through. Ability to set next steps, document commitments, and keep opportunities moving through the pipeline
  • Technology, CRM, and AI Acumen:
    Experience using CRM systems, pipeline management tools, and performance analytics. Proficiency with artificial intelligence tools and technologies to support market research, prospect identification, workflow optimization, strategic planning, communication, and data analysis. Salesforce experience strongly preferred
  • Collaboration:
    Ability to work effectively with academic leaders, faculty, enrollment teams, marketing, legal, operations, and external partners to advance shared goals
  • Mission Fit:
    Personal ability to articulate and support the Christ-centered mission, values, and educational philosophy of Indiana Wesleyan University
  • Mobility:
    Valid driver’s license with an excellent driving record. Willing and able to travel approximately 50% across Central Indiana and surrounding regions, with occasional evening, weekend, and overnight travel. Able to lift 50lbs

IWU Kingdom Diversity Statement

IWU, in covenant with God's reconciling work and in accordance with the Biblical principles of our historic Wesleyan tradition, commits to build a community that reflects Kingdom diversity. We will foster an intentional environment for living, teaching and learning, which exhibits honor, respect, and dignity. Acknowledging visible or invisible differences, our community authentically values each member's earthly and eternal worth. We refute ignorance and isolation and embrace deliberate and courageous engagement that exhibits Christ's commandment to love all humankind.

LIMITATIONS AND DISCLAIMER

As a religious educational institution operating under the auspices of The Wesleyan Church, Indiana Wesleyan University is permitted and reserves the right to prefer employees on the basis of religion (42 U.S.C., Sections 2000e-1 and 2000e-2).

Employees will be required to follow other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with Federal and State Laws.

jobs.description:
About N-Power Medicine

N-Power Medicine aims to establish a new paradigm in drug development by reinventing the ‘how’ and transforming clinical trials through better integration with clinical practice, ensuring broader participation by physicians and patients. We are building an exceptional multi-disciplinary team with diverse expertise spanning healthcare, engineering, technology and regulatory, and with people who share our core value of Empowering Community through generosity, curiosity and humility. We are working with urgency to bring better therapies to patients faster.

Position Overview

The Strategic Partner Executive is a senior account and implementation leader responsible for the end-to-end operations and success of the partnership with each assigned oncology network partner. This leader is the single point of accountability for ensuring network partners are fully activated and engaged in N-Power’s clinical programs and physicians are actively enrolling, advocating, and referring within and beyond their practice. This is a commercially minded role but is not a business development function, as it begins only after the deal is signed.

This role partners closely with on-site implementation staff to ensure staff roll-out, EHR integration, and day-to-day program execution run smoothly, while also building the physician relationships, advisory boards, and education materials that keep the partnership growing.

This position is remote within the United States, with regular travel to partner sites.

Role Objectives and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for each assigned oncology network partner from contract execution onward, owning overall account health, engagement, and partner satisfaction.

  • Ensure network partners are fully engaged and successfully running the company’s clinical programs, currently focused on Prospective ECAs (ProECAs).

  • Drive active, sustained physician engagement through enrollment, advocacy, and partner-sourced referrals to new network expansion opportunities.

  • Own end-to-end implementation and ongoing operations for each partner, partnering closely with on-site staff on staff roll-out, EHR integration, and day-to-day execution, and surfacing and resolving issues before they impact the relationship.

  • Establish a consistent partner engagement cadence including quarterly business reviews, partner check-ins, onsite visits, and physician advisory boards, blending tactical, day-to-day conversations with strategic discussions on growth, expansion, and advocacy to keep the relationship active between formal touchpoints.

  • Position N-Power as a true partner by ensuring the value we bring is delivered and clearly understood by physicians and practice staff.

  • Actively promote the clinical program within partner organizations, translating our value proposition into terms that resonate with physicians and research teams.

  • Build and continuously refine repeatable playbooks for partner management, physician engagement, and implementation that can scale across the network.

  • Monitor program performance and engagement metrics across the network, proactively addressing gaps.

  • Support the BD team during contract signing by providing operational and implementation insight — helping shape deal terms and expectations that set the partnership up for a smooth launch.

Education, Experience, Behavioral Competencies, & Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in account management, client services, or partnership roles within oncology, healthcare, or life sciences, ideally with direct exposure to clinical research and research site operations.

  • Working knowledge of how oncology research and physicians operate, including academic/community research workflows, practice business administration.

  • Experience with large health systems, including navigating multi-stakeholder relationships and organizational complexity.

  • Demonstrated strong commercial and strategic acumen.

  • Program or implementation management experience, including cross-functional coordination.

  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

  • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree a plus.

  • Generous, Curious & Humble.

Travel Requirements

  • As necessary for partner and physician relationships.

  • Stay informed on industry trends, organizational transformation strategies, AI adoption, workforce transformation, and emerging business challenges affecting enterprise clients.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience selling consulting or professional services
  • Demonstrated success delivering annual consulting services bookings of at least $4 million
  • Proven experience acquiring new enterprise accounts while expanding existing customer relationships
  • Experience selling Organizational Change Management, Workforce Transformation, Enterprise Learning, Agile Transformation, Digital Transformation, or related consulting services
  • Strong understanding of enterprise business transformation initiatives and executive decision-making processes
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex consultative sales cycles from prospecting through contract negotiation and close
  • Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills
  • Highly collaborative with experience working across Sales, Solution Advisory, Consulting, and Delivery organizations
  • Ability to travel as needed

Preferred skills (good to have):

  • Experience selling management consulting or digital transformation services to Fortune 1000 organizations
  • Existing executive network within enterprise organizations across North America

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants to build the function while still personally producing our biggest creative bets.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own production across Brand Creative campaigns and projects, balancing priorities, capacity, staffing, budgets, timelines, and risk across multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Establish how Brand Creative prioritizes, staffs, greenlights, reviews, and delivers projects, creating a production system that makes exceptional work more repeatable.
  • Bring clarity to complex projects by keeping creative leaders and cross-functional partners grounded in the real state of the work, decisions, constraints, tradeoffs, and risks.
  • Work directly with Brand Creative leadership to continually raise the quality of the work and build one of the strongest in-house creative teams in the industry.

What you’ll bring:

  • Significant experience leading complex, multidisciplinary creative production, with a track record of independently owning large-scale campaigns and multiple concurrent creative projects.
  • Deep production experience across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated brand work, with the judgment to choose the right production model for the idea.

jobs.excerpt: Job Profile SummaryThe GPUaaS Acquisition / New Pursuits Sales Executive is a senior individual contributor responsible for creating and closing net-new GPU as a Service business.
jobs.description:
Job Profile Summary

The GPUaaS Acquisition / New Pursuits Sales Executive is a senior individual contributor responsible for creating and closing net-new GPU as a Service business. The role owns the full pursuit lifecycle - target-account identification, outbound prospecting, opportunity qualification, discovery, solution orchestration, commercial strategy, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and booking - with a primary focus on new logos and material new GPU workloads. The executive acts as the single-threaded sales owner for assigned pursuits and mobilizes Rackspace GPUaaS specialists, solution architecture, Product, Capacity/Operations, Finance, Legal, Delivery, and strategic ecosystem partners to win complex accelerated-compute opportunities.

Role Mission

Create net-new demand and convert qualified enterprise AI, training, inference, HPC, and accelerated-compute opportunities into profitable GPUaaS bookings. Build a focused pursuit engine that prioritizes high-value accounts and workloads, maintains sufficient qualified pipeline coverage, advances opportunities with urgency and discipline, and wins based on customer outcomes, technical fit, capacity availability, commercial competitiveness, and execution credibility.

Career Level Summary

  • Operates as a senior P5 individual contributor and expert seller for complex GPUaaS pursuits; no people-management responsibility is required.
  • Owns the customer relationship and sales outcome for assigned new-logo and new-pursuit opportunities from first engagement through contract execution and handoff.
  • Leads cross-functional pursuit teams through influence and establishes clear owners, actions, dates, decision criteria, and close plans.
  • Uses customer, workload, competitive, capacity, financial, and pipeline data to determine where to invest pursuit resources and when to qualify out.
  • Contributes field intelligence to GPUaaS GTM strategy, including ideal customer profile, use cases, competitive positioning, pricing signals, buying patterns, and product/capacity requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned GPUaaS bookings quota and deliver profitable net-new bookings consistent with approved pricing, capacity, contractual, and gross-margin guardrails.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized target-account and workload list focused on organizations with credible accelerated-compute demand, funding, timing, technical fit, and buying authority.
  • Generate new opportunities through direct outbound pursuit, executive networks, marketing-generated demand, strategic technology partners such as AMD and NVIDIA, channel/referral partners, ecosystem relationships, and customer introductions.
  • Qualify opportunities rigorously across workload/use case, GPU platform requirements, cluster size, geography, capacity timing, term, commercial value, decision process, competition, funding, and customer urgency before committing material pursuit resources.
  • Lead customer discovery and translate business and technical requirements into a clear pursuit strategy and differentiated GPUaaS value proposition.
  • Orchestrate Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, Capacity/Operations, Delivery, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive sponsors to develop executable customer solutions and proposals.
  • Develop and maintain a written close plan for material pursuits, including customer decision criteria, buying process, technical validation, commercial milestones, competition, risks, executive relationships, next actions, owners, and dates.
  • Own proposal, bid/RFP, pricing, negotiation, and contracting strategy in partnership with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and GPUaaS leadership; protect approved economics while maximizing probability of close.
  • Create multithreaded customer relationships across economic buyer, technical buyer, procurement, finance, legal, infrastructure/AI leadership, and executive sponsors.
  • Use AMD, NVIDIA, OEM, ISV, channel, and other ecosystem relationships strategically when they improve access, technical credibility, solution differentiation, or probability of winning the pursuit.
  • Maintain accurate CRM data and forecast discipline, including source, stage, amount, term, probability, close date, capacity requirement, next step, blockers, and forecast category.
  • Inspect pipeline weekly for stage movement, aging, qualification quality, capacity alignment, competitive risk, and gap-to-goal; proactively create new pipeline when coverage or conversion is insufficient.
  • Ensure clean transition of booked business to implementation/delivery and the designated post-sale owner while remaining engaged through critical launch milestones when necessary to protect customer confidence and expansion potential.
  • Capture win/loss insights and feed recurring customer, competitive, pricing, product, capacity, and contracting themes back into the GPUaaS operating model.

Knowledge

  • Expert-level enterprise acquisition selling and complex pursuit management, including prospecting, qualification, discovery, executive selling, negotiation, contracting, and closing.
  • Strong working knowledge of GPUaaS, accelerated computing, AI/ML training and inference, HPC, cloud/data-center infrastructure, and the commercial drivers of enterprise AI infrastructure purchases.
  • Working knowledge of GPU platforms and ecosystem participants such as AMD, NVIDIA, OEM/server vendors, ISVs, integrators, channel partners, cloud providers, and GPU/neocloud providers; sufficient depth to position value and orchestrate technical experts without acting as the primary solution architect.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including bookings, ACV/TCV, contract term, consumption/commit constructs, pricing, sold gross margin, capacity economics, deal risk, and approval guardrails.
  • Expert knowledge of opportunity qualification, pipeline management, CRM discipline, forecasting, account/pursuit planning, and competitive strategy.
  • Understanding of data-center capacity, deployment timing, power/cooling constraints, networking, storage, software stack, and service-readiness considerations that can materially affect GPUaaS pursuits.

Skills

  • New-logo acquisition and outbound prospecting
  • Complex enterprise / strategic pursuit selling
  • Consultative and value-based selling
  • GPUaaS / AI infrastructure market fluency
  • Executive selling and multithreading
  • Opportunity qualification and qualification-out discipline
  • Pipeline creation, management, and forecasting
  • Commercial strategy, pricing, and negotiation
  • RFP/proposal and competitive pursuit leadership
  • Cross-functional pursuit orchestration
  • CRM/Salesforce discipline and analytics
  • Executive presentations and customer workshops
  • Close planning, action ownership, and deal velocity

Experience

  • 12-14 years of relevant enterprise technology sales experience, consistent with the P5 Professional Master level.
  • Demonstrated record of personally originating and closing complex, material new-logo enterprise technology transactions as an individual contributor.
  • Experience selling cloud infrastructure, data-center services, AI infrastructure, GPU/accelerated compute, HPC, managed infrastructure, or similarly complex consumption/capacity-based technology strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline rather than relying solely on inherited accounts or inbound opportunities.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional pursuits involving technical validation, capacity/operations, finance, legal, procurement, security, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience competing against hyperscalers, GPU/neocloud providers, infrastructure providers, or other enterprise technology alternatives is preferred.
  • No people-management responsibility is required; success is measured through individual bookings, pipeline creation, pursuit execution, and commercial outcomes.

Education / Certifications

Bachelor's degree preferred in business, technology, engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may substitute. Relevant cloud, AI, infrastructure, or sales certifications are a plus but not required.

Travel

Domestic and international travel as required for customer pursuits, executive meetings, workshops, partner engagements, industry events, and negotiations; travel intensity will vary by territory and active pursuit portfolio and may exceed 50% during major pursuits.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end-to-end solutions. Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

.

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

See yourself at Twilio

Twilio powers real-time business communications and data solutions that help companies and developers worldwide build better applications and customer experiences.

Although we're headquartered in San Francisco, we have presence throughout South America, Europe, Asia and Australia. We're on a journey to becoming a globally anti-racist, anti-oppressive, anti-bias company that actively opposes racism and all forms of oppression and bias. At Twilio, we support diversity, equity & inclusion wherever we do business. We employ thousands of Twilions worldwide, and we're looking for more builders, creators, and visionaries to help fuel our growth momentum.

About the job

Company Overview

Job Summary

We are seeking a Strategic Account Executive to originate, shape, and close transformational software partnerships with leading utilities. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a commercial builder who can create opportunity from ambiguity, lead a complex 6-12+ month enterprise sale, and earn credibility from the executive suite through technical, operational, procurement, legal, and regulatory stakeholders.

You will own account strategy and the commercial relationship for approximately 5–7 named Tier 1 utilities. You will build the business case, coordinate the full Gigawatt pursuit team, close an initial deployment, and remain accountable for major module and platform expansion. The role reports to GTM leadership and works closely across Gigawatt teams.

Key Responsibilities

Own named-account strategy and revenue: Develop and execute account plans for a focused portfolio of strategic utilities, with clear pathways from executive access and qualified opportunity through initial close and multi-module expansion.

Build pipeline from the ground up: Create opportunities through targeted outreach, industry relationships, partners, events, and insight-led engagement; maintain sufficient pipeline coverage to deliver against annual and multi-year revenue goals.

Lead the end-to-end enterprise sale: Drive discovery, qualification, solution shaping, value engineering, commercial proposals, RFI/RFP responses, procurement, negotiation, and contracting through close.

Multi-thread complex buying committees: Build trusted relationships across executive sponsors, operational and functional leaders, technology and security teams, procurement, finance, legal, and other key influencers. Identify champions, blockers, decision criteria, and the path to approval

Quarterback the opportunity team: Bring Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Services, Partnerships, and executives into each pursuit at the right time. Establish clear roles, next steps, decision gates, and accountability.

Navigate utility markets: Leverage deep understanding of utility procurement cycles, regulatory dynamics, long sales cycles, and risk-averse decision-making to shorten time-to-value and win strategic accounts.

Forecast with discipline: Maintain accurate CRM data, opportunity plans, mutual action plans, pipeline reporting, and forecasts. Surface risks early and bring a clear point of view on how to create momentum.

Bring the market back into Gigawatt: Translate customer feedback, competitive intelligence, procurement patterns, and regulatory or market developments into actionable input for product strategy, positioning, and the GTM playbook.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a strong track record of originating and closing net-new business.
  • Demonstrated success personally closing complex, multi-year, seven-figure platform or transformation agreements with large enterprises.
  • Ability to build compelling business cases, quantify value, and communicate effectively with board-level, executive, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong strategic account-planning skills, including identifying champions, economic buyers, decision-makers, and potential sources of resistance.
  • Technical curiosity and ability to develop fluency in an AI-native, data-intensive platform and its role within a customer's enterprise architecture.
  • Builder’s mindset with the ability to operate with pace, ambiguity, limited playbooks, and high personal accountability in an early-stage environment.
  • Excellent written, presentation, negotiation, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience with modern CRM, pipeline management, and rigorous forecasting practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling into utilities, energy, or other regulated and infrastructure-intensive industries such as telecom, government/public sector, or similar.
  • Existing relationships and executive network within utilities and/or energy.
  • Experience selling AI, data, cloud, or other technically complex enterprise platforms.
  • Experience within a high-growth, early-stage or scale-up software company.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree is a plus.

Location

  • Remote but Chicago, Austin, Nashville are preferred.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity package.
  • Opportunity to shape a transformative AI product in a vital industry working with a rock-star team.
  • Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, remote work flexibility, and 401k match.
  • Collaborative culture focused on innovation and impact.
  • If you are passionate about the future of AI in utilities, apply today!

The role combines cloud-services revenue growth with the development and execution of complex, multi-year infrastructure deals. Working closely with APAC and global leadership, you will prioritise opportunities and direct commercial, technical, and executive resources towards sustainable growth across Australia.

Key Responsibilities:

Australian Commercial Strategy and Strategic Accounts

  • Define and execute the Australian commercial strategy, prioritising accounts, sectors, and partnerships with the strongest revenue and strategic potential.

  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise, government, research, and funding stakeholders, strengthening Quantinuum’s credibility and maintaining engagement.

  • Develop account plans that align customer objectives, investment priorities, and procurement pathways with Quantinuum’s capabilities.

  • Own opportunity qualification, revenue delivery, forecasting, and commercial execution, expanding initial engagements into long-term strategic relationships.

  • Provide market intelligence to guide strategy and investment, and mobilise global resources to progress priority opportunities with independence and accountability.

Cloud Services and Customer Expansion

  • Grow cloud-services revenue by identifying valuable customer applications and converting technical interest into paid engagements.

  • Work with customers and internal specialists to establish business cases, adoption roadmaps, and commercial models that support sustained usage.

  • Lead negotiations for cloud-access agreements, renewals, and account expansion.

  • Identify opportunities to broaden customer relationships across Quantinuum’s portfolio, including on-premises deployments where appropriate.

On-Premises Deals and Strategic Programmes

  • Originate and lead on-premises quantum computing opportunities with enterprise, government, and research customers.

  • Establish executive sponsorship, funding pathways, technical requirements, and infrastructure readiness for significant investments.

  • Coordinate technical, scientific, deployment, legal, finance, and executive leadership teams through evaluation, procurement, negotiation, and contract execution.

  • Structure high-value, multi-party and multi-year agreements, aligning customer commitments with deployment and delivery requirements.

  • Develop partnerships that strengthen proposals, enable implementation, and support long-term adoption.

You must have:

  • Demonstrated experience in strategic, complex solution sales within the scientific technology, advanced computing, or enterprise infrastructure sectors

  • Experience navigating technical evaluations, public-sector procurement, funding processes, and multi-stakeholder decisions.

  • Demonstrated success leading strategic technology sales and closing complex, high-value agreements in Australia.

  • Experience developing executive relationships across enterprise, government, and research organisations.

  • A track record of growing cloud or platform-services revenue and progressing infrastructure or on-premises opportunities.

  • Strong commercial judgment, including account prioritisation, business-case development, deal structuring, and negotiation.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional deal teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct reporting authority.

  • Disciplined pipeline management and forecasting, combined with the adaptability required to build a new market.

  • Ability to work independently in an emerging market while collaborating effectively within a global matrix organisation.

  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly within Australiaand internationally as required.

Preferred Experience:

  • Quantum computing, HPC, AI, cloud infrastructure, or related advanced technologies.

  • National computing programmes, research infrastructure, or strategic government technology investments.

  • Established customer, government, research, and partner networks across Australia.

Quantinuum is a leading quantum computing company delivering a full stack platform designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. With active engagements spanning pharmaceuticals, material science, financial services, government, industrial sectors, and leading academic and research institutions worldwide, we are helping organizations unlock the transformative potential of quantum computing.

Our global team of more than 800 employees includes many of the world's leading scientists, engineers, and researchers, with more than 70% of our technology team holding advanced degrees at the Master's or PhD level. Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, Quantinuum operatesacross the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, and Singapore.

By joining Quantinuum, you’ll help shape the future of quantum computing, pushing the limits of technology, and making the impossible possible.

  • Experiencia en prospección activa y desarrollo de nuevos negocios.
  • Manejo de herramientas CRM.
  • Excelente comunicación oral y escrita.
  • Perfil consultivo, organizado y orientado al logro de resultados.
  • Español fluido.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar de forma remota.

  • Conocimientos en pfSense.
  • Experiencia con soluciones Cloud (AWS, Azure o Google Cloud).
  • Conocimientos en virtualización (VMware, Hyper-V o Proxmox).
  • Experiencia con soluciones de backup.
  • Certificaciones comerciales o técnicas relacionadas con tecnología.
  • Inglés intermedio o avanzado.

Competencias

  • Proactividad.
  • Facilidad para desarrollar relaciones comerciales.
  • Comunicación clara y efectiva.
  • Organización y gestión del tiempo.
  • Autonomía.
  • Capacidad analítica.
  • Resiliencia.
  • Orientación al cumplimiento de metas y resultados.

  • Contratación bajo modalidad de prestación de servicios (PJ).

jobs.description:
About LogicGate
LogicGate is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. Built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform.

The GRC MarketGovernance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is a rapidly expanding sector, with a global market size projected to reach $104.5 billion by 2031. LogicGate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale.

Strategic Account Executive

Location: United States - Remote

About the role

Our Strategic Account Executives have a passion for pitching novel technology in big markets. You’ll target large enterprises in all verticals with a focus on their GRC programs. We are disrupting the GRC software industry as a recent Forrester Wave Leader by providing a solution end users can self-manage, saving enterprises huge amounts of time and money and you’ll focus on identifying target accounts and bringing them through the full sales process. This is an opportunity to play a key role in building a business, have a huge and direct impact on top line revenue growth, and be part of a collaborative, high-performing sales team.

How you’ll spend your time:

  • Strategically developing a territory plan for a targeted list of accounts in Salesforce leveraging best in class sales technology including marketing automation, buyer intent signals, pipeline analytics, and more!
  • Generating new business pipeline primarily by cold prospecting through partner collaborations, social communication, email and phone calls.
  • Form strategic sales plan to target use cases within industry verticals.
  • Taking a customer through the full lifecycle of an opportunity including qualification/ discovery, demo (in partnership with a Solutions Engineer), building relationships within an organization, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Being an advocate for our customers. Actively listening to understand their goals and share these potential opportunities with our product team.
  • Leveraging sales enablement tools to effectively measure activities and develop best practices. Continuously refining and improving on sales activities.
  • Consulting and advising our customers on best practices for their use case on the LogicGate platform.
  • Deliver world class customer service in every customer interaction

We get excited about you if you have:

  • Proven sales experience. You will ideally have 10+ years of total Sales experience, specifically 5+ years of large enterprise sales experience selling B2B SaaS technology.
  • Curiosity and the desire to understand our customer’s problems – and effectively communicate how LogicGate can add value.
  • Great listening skills, as well as humility. We won’t be the right solution all the time for every organization, so we believe in understanding customer needs first before we make our pitch.
  • A tech savvy seller – can quickly pick up new technology and understands our platform front and back. Previous experience in BPM or GRC software is a huge plus.
  • Great people skills. Ability to quickly understand your audience and tailor the right message to them, typically via web conference.
  • Excitement to build lasting relationships. Someone who is in it for the long term and understands the value in building trust with customers.
  • Proficiency in using Salesforce.com and sales automation software.
  • Willingness to be creative, test solutions, measure results and iterate on a process for continual improvement.

The anticipated on-target earnings range for the role is $290,000 - $350,000 per year + equity + benefits. Actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors, such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested.

How We WorkAt LogicGate, we empower organizations to transform risk into a strategic advantage. As we continue to scale, we are looking for driven, high-performing individuals who are ready to take ownership, raise the bar, and do the best work of their careers.

Our culture is built on execution, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. We believe the strongest, most innovative teams are forged by diverse perspectives. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where differences are celebrated and supported.

Global Total Rewards
We invest in our people with a comprehensive and competitive rewards package designed to support our team members across the US and the UK:

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive base salaries, variable compensation plans, and equity options.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits tailored to your region.
  • Time Away: Generous paid time off and annual company holidays so you can recharge and return at your best.
  • Growth & Development: Continuous career advancement through structured mentorship, leadership training, and premium learning platforms.

Recognized as a top workplace by Built In, Crain’s Chicago Business, and the Chicago Tribune.

Internal Collaboration

Contribute to New Nuclear go-to-market strategy, sales forecasting, business reviews, and strategic planning.

Nuclear Licensing Knowledge The ideal candidate will be familiar with the licensing and regulatory environment for new nuclear facilities, including several of the following:

NRC licensing processes and regulatory frameworks. New plant licensing pathways, including early site permits, construction permits, combined licenses, and operating licenses. Advanced reactor and small modular reactor licensing considerations, including regulatory engagement and pre-application activities. Licensing and regulatory documentation, including safety analysis reports, licensing-basis documentation, regulatory commitments, and correspondence. Quality assurance, environmental review, and site characterization requirements. Licensing document management, configuration control, audit readiness, and operational program requirements. Stakeholder interactions among utilities, technology vendors, the NRC, contractors, and other organizations supporting new nuclear projects.

Dark Matter Mission Statement

To be the trusted innovation partner that empowers home lending. We fulfill this mission by earning trust through accountability and integrity, bringing clarity to complex challenges, collaborating across our ecosystem, and remaining dedicated to meaningful innovation and customer outcomes.


Position Summary

The Sales Executive IV - Strategic Partnerships is a quota-carrying sales role responsible for generating and closing revenue through a portfolio of strategic relationships, including technology providers, industry organizations, consultants, referral sources, and other ecosystem partners. The role builds and manages executive-level relationships, develops partner-specific account plans and qualified pipeline, and leads opportunities from initial identification through partnership go-to-market by educating partners on Dark Matter Technologies’ value, technology, client base, and ecosystem opportunities.

This role combines strategic partnership development with the ability to educate and inform partners about Dark Matter Technologies’ products, services, technology, client base, market reach, and ecosystem value. The Sales Executive positions solutions in the context of each partner’s business model and growth objectives, prepares estimates, negotiates commercial terms, and coordinates internal resources to deliver outcomes that align partner expectations with the company’s ability to execute. Success is measured by quota attainment, closed revenue, pipeline creation and conversion, forecast accuracy, and the growth and productivity of assigned relationships.


Essential Responsibilities

  • Own and achieve an assigned individual revenue quota, sales goals, and other performance objectives for the strategic partnerships channel.
  • Build, manage, and expand a portfolio of strategic partner relationships that generate referrals, partner-sourced opportunities, integrated solution sales, and recurring revenue growth.
  • Develop and execute relationship and account plans that define revenue targets, priority opportunities, key stakeholders, and the actions required to close business.
  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with current and prospective partners, consultants, industry organizations, and other sources of qualified opportunities.
  • Create and maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline by identifying market opportunities, securing partner commitment, and advancing deals through each stage of the sales process.
  • Lead assigned opportunities from discovery through close by educating partners on Dark Matter Technologies’ technology, platform capabilities, client demand, market reach, and integration value; aligning the opportunity to the partner’s business objectives; positioning the solution; and managing pricing, negotiation, and contracting.

  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing partner relationships, including new products, services, integrations, referral arrangements, pricing initiatives, and additional revenue channels.
  • Translate knowledge of Dark Matter Technologies’ products, services, technology, customer use cases, client base, markets, and competitive environment into clear business, integration, and revenue value that enables informed partner investment and go-to-market decisions.
  • Prepare and present pricing, commercial recommendations, partnership plans, business cases, forecasts, and performance updates to partner executives and internal leadership.
  • Maintain accurate and timely CRM records, including opportunity stage, amount, close date, next steps, relationship activity, and forecast; provide clear visibility into pipeline health, risks, and commitments.
  • Coordinate Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation resources to resolve obstacles and move opportunities from strategy through execution and revenue realization.
  • Represent the company at industry events, partner meetings, executive forums, and trade associations to deepen relationships, strengthen market presence, and create new sales opportunities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Performance Expectations

  • Consistent attainment of assigned revenue quota and sales objectives.
  • Measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline growth.
  • Effective conversion of qualified opportunities into signed agreements and closed revenue.
  • Accurate, disciplined forecasting and CRM management.
  • Growth in revenue, opportunity volume, and strategic value across assigned relationships.
  • Effective management of complex sales cycles from discovery through close.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, marketing, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive field sales, enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, business development, alliance management, or related commercial experience.
  • Demonstrated success carrying and attaining a revenue quota and closing complex, high-value sales or partnership agreements.
  • Proven experience building executive-level relationships and generating revenue through partners, channels, referrals, alliances, or ecosystem relationships.
  • Experience managing a full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, solution development, pricing, negotiation, contracting, forecasting, and close.
  • Experience engaging mortgage, fintech, financial services, and technology providers at the C-suite level, including educating executive stakeholders on technology capabilities, client demand, market opportunities, integration value, and the commercial benefits of partnership.
  • Strong record of leading cross-functional pursuits in a complex, matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in mortgage technology, fintech, financial services, or another regulated, technology-enabled industry.
  • Experience selling software products, technology-enabled services, integrations, platforms, or transaction-based solutions.
  • Experience developing or scaling referral channels, strategic alliances, and partner-led go-to-market motions.
  • Working knowledge of technology integrations, platform partnerships, commercial agreements, pricing, and product commercialization.
  • Established network among relevant technology and service providers, consultants, industry associations, financial institutions, or customer organizations.
  • Knowledge of Dark Matter Technologies’ products, services, and capabilities.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Expertise in translating complex technology solutions into clear business value for external partners. Ability to educate stakeholders on platform capabilities, market reach, client demand, and ecosystem opportunities, helping partners understand the strategic and revenue benefits of integration investments. Fosters alignment between business objectives and technology initiatives, enabling partners to make informed decisions that support mutual growth, customer adoption, and market expansion.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to establish credibility, communicate value, and influence senior decision-makers.
  • Strategic and commercial acumen, including the ability to translate partner relationships and market insights into qualified pipeline and closed revenue.
  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting, account-planning, and CRM discipline.
  • Financial and analytical capability, including pricing, business-case development, revenue forecasting, and performance measurement.
  • Cross-functional leadership and execution discipline, with the ability to coordinate resources and maintain deal momentum across long, complex sales cycles.
  • Ability to remain effective under pressure, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and travel up to 25%.

Compensation and Classification

  • This is a quota-carrying sales position with a competitive base salary and eligibility to participate in the applicable sales commission plan. Commission plan details are provided upon hire.

  • Accountability: Owns commitments, sales activity, forecast accuracy, quota performance, and measurable customer and partner outcomes.
  • Integrity: Acts ethically and communicates transparently throughout the sales process, earning lasting trust with customers, partners, and colleagues.
  • Clarity: Simplifies complex solutions, commercial terms, priorities, and value propositions so stakeholders can make confident decisions.
  • Collaborative: Brings together the right internal and external capabilities to create stronger solutions and close business.

Position Summary
The Executive Client Partneris responsible forleadingDataSpring’smost strategic and consequential client relationships, including marquee health plan and healthcare organization partners represented onDataSpring’sBoard of Directors.

The Executive Client Partner will protectDataSpring’smost important relationships and revenue, influence strategic decisions and future direction,identifyopportunities to innovate alongside clients and partner closely withDataSpring’sExecutive Leadership Team and key cross-functional leaders to deliver a coordinated enterprise experience.

This individual will develop and execute comprehensive account strategies, strengthen executive alignment, drive value realization,anticipaterisksandidentifyopportunities to expand the partnership acrossDataSpring’sportfolio.
