The Executive Client Partner is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the VP, Account Management.
This position will require the ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

Responsibilities

Executive Relationship Leadership

  • Serve as the senior relationship owner for a select portfolio of DataSpring’s largest, most strategic and highest-profile partners.
  • Build trusted relationships with board members, C-suite executives, senior decision-makers and operational leaders across assigned client organizations.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s enterprise strategy, business objectives, operating environment, stakeholder dynamics and future priorities.
  • Establish and maintain multilevel relationship maps that ensure strong connections across executive, operational, technical, financial and procurement stakeholders.
  • Create a consistent and intentional executive engagement strategy, including executive sponsorship, strategic planning sessions, executive business reviews and ongoing leadership communication.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor who brings perspective, insight and recommendations beyond routine account management.

Protect Strategic Partnerships

  • Maintain accountability for the health, retention and long-term strength of DataSpring’s most important client relationships.
  • Anticipate relationship, performance, operational, financial and reputational risks before they affect the partnership.
  • Develop and lead comprehensive risk-mitigation and executive intervention plans.
  • Ensure emerging concerns are elevated with the appropriate context, recommended actions and clearly defined ownership.
  • Protect client trust by ensuring commitments are understood, coordinated and fulfilled across DataSpring.
  • Lead sensitive client discussions and escalations with sound judgment, executive presence and a solution-oriented approach.
  • Partner with DataSpring leadership to ensure marquee clients receive a consistent, proactive and differentiated experience.

Influence and Strategic Alignment

  • Translate client strategies, market pressures and leadership priorities into actionable implications for DataSpring.
  • Influence internal priorities by representing the voice of strategic clients across the Executive Leadership Team, Product, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Technology and other key functions.
  • Provide client and market intelligence that informs product strategy, operating priorities, investment decisions and go-to-market planning.
  • Shape executive conversations around client value, strategic direction, industry change and the future of the partnership.
  • Build alignment among client executives, operational stakeholders and DataSpring leaders around shared priorities and desired outcomes.
  • Help clients understand and prepare for DataSpring’s strategic initiatives, platform evolution and future-state capabilities.

Innovation and Partnership Expansion

  • Identify opportunities to innovate with clients through new solutions, expanded use cases, strategic pilots and collaborative initiatives.
  • Develop a clear understanding of client whitespace, unmet needs and future priorities.
  • Connect DataSpring’s broader portfolio and capabilities to client objectives in ways that create measurable enterprise value.
  • Partner with Sales and commercial leaders to develop and advance qualified growth and expansion opportunities.
  • Support strategic commercial discussions, renewal planning and complex negotiations in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal and executive leadership.
  • Facilitate client participation in advisory groups, innovation forums, market-shaping discussions and other strategic initiatives.
  • Position DataSpring as a proactive partner in solving complex healthcare administrative and data challenges.

Strategic Account Planning and Value Realization

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive, multiyear strategic account plans for each assigned partner.
  • Define clear relationship, adoption, value, retention, innovation and growth objectives.
  • Establish measurable success outcomes and ensure DataSpring can demonstrate the value delivered through its solutions and partnership.
  • Lead executive business reviews that connect performance, insights and opportunities to the client’s strategic priorities.
  • Monitor account health across relationship strength, engagement, solution adoption, operational performance, support experience, financial position and future opportunity.
  • Translate account data, client feedback and industry trends into clear recommendations and executive action plans.
  • Maintain accurate and timely strategic account information in Salesforce and other designated systems.

Enterprise Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with DataSpring’s Executive Leadership Team to establish and execute coordinated strategies for marquee client relationships.
  • Lead cross-functional account teams that may include Sales, Product, Operations, Technology, Implementation, Analytics, Finance, Legal and Communications.
  • Establish clear ownership, decision-making, timelines and accountability across complex client initiatives.
  • Ensure clients experience DataSpring as one coordinated organization rather than a collection of separate functions or products.
  • Mobilize the appropriate internal leaders and subject-matter experts based on client priorities, risks and opportunities.
  • Facilitate internal executive account reviews to assess relationship health, strategic priorities, commitments and next actions.
  • Provide guidance and leadership to Client Partnerships colleagues supporting the operational aspects of assigned accounts.

Organizational and Market Leadership

  • Model the standards, behaviors and strategic discipline expected across the Client Partnerships organization.
  • Contribute to the development of executive-engagement practices, strategic account playbooks, health frameworks and relationship-management standards.
  • Share market, client and competitive insights that strengthen DataSpring’s enterprise strategy.
  • Represent DataSpring at client events, executive meetings, industry forums and other external engagements.
  • Support a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and client-centered decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, public health or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Ten to fifteen years of progressive experience in strategic account management, client partnerships, customer success, consulting, healthcare leadership or another senior client-facing role.
  • Significant experience working with health plans, provider organizations, healthcare technology companies or healthcare administrative solutions is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, high-value enterprise relationships with multiple products, stakeholders and business priorities.
  • Experience engaging and influencing board members, C-suite executives and senior operational decision-makers.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility as a trusted strategic advisor.
  • Demonstrated success protecting and expanding strategic client relationships, including retention, renewals, adoption, value realization and growth.
  • Experience developing and executing multiyear strategic account plans and executive-engagement strategies.
  • Ability to understand complex healthcare business challenges and connect them to data, technology and administrative solutions.
  • Strong commercial judgment, including experience identifying whitespace, shaping expansion opportunities and supporting complex commercial discussions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify emerging risks, lead executive escalations and navigate sensitive or high-stakes client situations.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional teams and initiatives without direct authority.
  • Ability to influence internal executives and translate client priorities into organizational action.
  • Strong strategic thinking, business judgment and decision-making capabilities.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to lead board-level and executive-level discussions.
  • Ability to synthesize client, market, financial, product and operational information into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Strong organizational discipline and the ability to manage a select portfolio of highly complex relationships and priorities.
  • Experience with Salesforce or another enterprise customer relationship management platform.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly for executive meetings, client engagements and industry events.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

The successful candidate will act as the CEO's right hand, ensuring daily operations run smoothly while supporting strategic business activities.

This position offers a clear career progression opportunity into Account Management, with increasing responsibility for client relationships, customer onboarding and project coordination

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive & Personal Assistance

  • Manage the CEO's inbox, calendar, appointments and daily scheduling.
  • Draft professional, accurate and well-structured emails and client communications.
  • Coordinate meetings with clients, prospects, partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Arrange travel, accommodation and business appointments.
  • Handle personal administration, expense tracking and ad hoc requests.
  • Conduct research and prepare reports, presentations and meeting summaries.
  • Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively manage priorities.

2. Financial Administration & Operations

  • Manage bill payments, vendor payments and invoicing.
  • Assist with payroll administration and payment processing.
  • Track expenses, invoices and financial records.
  • Coordinate internal administrative processes and operational workflows.
  • Ensure payments, documentation and financial information are accurate and processed on time.
  • Identify opportunities to improve administrative efficiency and implement better systems.

3. Client Communication & Account Support

  • Prepare professional client follow-up emails based on meeting notes and discussions.
  • Coordinate client meetings, scheduling and ongoing communication.
  • Respond to client requests and ensure timely follow-ups.
  • Assist with customer onboarding and implementation processes.
  • Track client deliverables, action items and outstanding tasks.
  • Support account management activities as knowledge of the business develops.
  • Maintain excellent communication standards when dealing with senior stakeholders and enterprise clients.

4. Project Management & Business Coordination

  • Coordinate projects, deadlines and internal team activities.
  • Monitor outstanding tasks and ensure deliverables are completed.
  • Maintain organised workflows and project documentation.
  • Support quality assurance reviews of software, data and internal processes.
  • Identify operational challenges and proactively recommend solutions.

5. Systems, Technology & AI Tools

  • Use Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs and Sheets.
  • Work with Microsoft Excel for reporting, tracking and administration.
  • Utilise HubSpot CRM for client information, follow-ups and account coordination.
  • Leverage AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and automation platforms to improve productivity.
  • Use AI-assisted meeting notes and summaries to prepare accurate, professional client correspondence.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive administrative processes.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in executive assistance, business administration, operations or similar roles preferred.
  • Previous experience supporting a US-based startup CEO or Founder remotely is essential.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Demonstrated experience drafting professional client-facing emails and business correspondence.
  • Hands-on experience with invoicing, vendor payments, bill payments and payroll administration.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, calendars and document management.
  • Excellent organisational, multitasking and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Experience managing confidential business and financial information.
  • Comfortable working US Pacific Time hours on a permanent basis.
  • Must be available for full-time, exclusive employment, without conflicting employment commitments.

Advantageous Experience

  • Experience working within a SaaS, technology or startup environment.
  • Customer success, client onboarding or account management experience.
  • HubSpot CRM experience.
  • Familiarity with AI tools, workflow automation and productivity platforms.
  • Experience coordinating projects and customer implementations.
  • Exposure to sales support, lead management, prospecting or business development.
  • Experience supporting high-value enterprise clients.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Exceptionally detail-oriented: Produces accurate, polished work with no careless errors.
  • An outstanding communicator: Writes clear, concise, professional emails and confidently communicates with senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive and independent: Anticipates needs, solves problems and takes initiative without constant direction.
  • Highly organised: Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines and responsibilities.
  • Commercially minded: Understands the importance of client relationships, customer experience and business growth.
  • Tech-savvy: Comfortable learning new systems and using AI tools to improve efficiency.
  • Accountable and reliable: Takes ownership of responsibilities and consistently delivers results.
  • Ambitious: Interested in long-term career development and progressing into account management.

Career Growth Opportunity

This position is designed for someone seeking more than a traditional Executive Assistant role.

As the successful candidate becomes familiar with the company's operations, technology and client base, they will have the opportunity to transition into broader Account Management and Customer Success responsibilities, including:

  • Managing client relationships and communications.
  • Coordinating customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Overseeing client requests, deliverables and follow-ups.
  • Supporting long-term customer satisfaction and retention.

Application Requirements

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete:

  1. An updated CV outlining relevant executive support and operational experience.
  2. A short video introduction demonstrating professional communication skills.
  3. A brief written assessment involving drafting a client-facing email from meeting notes.

The VIAVI NITRO portfolio delivers that visibility: NITRO CORE for mobile packet and IMS core assurance, NITRO RAN for radio access network performance, and NITRO AIOps for AI-driven service operations and automation. You will work closely with end customers, development partners, and VIAVI engineering and marketing teams to shape solution strategy, grow market share, and translate complex technology into a clear business case.

  • Drive the solution-sales effort in assigned accounts, managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification through close.
  • Build and maintain executive-level customer relationships and support customers across the full product life cycle.
  • Align VIAVI solutions to customer business metrics and KPIs, scoping projects that combine software, services, and hardware.
  • Conduct competitive analysis through research and dialogue with customers, partners, and VIAVI business-unit experts, and use it to sharpen positioning.
  • Partner with customers, sales, and business development to identify and define solution requirements, and articulate VIAVI key value propositions.

  • Experience with cloud network infrastructure such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and the associated security requirements.
  • Strong grasp of cloud computing technologies, including virtual machines, Docker, LXC, and Kubernetes.
  • Proven ability to position complex solutions that solve critical business and technical problems.

  • Self-starter who can negotiate product requirements between customers and engineering.
  • Experience creating business cases and competitive analyses.
  • Collaborative team player able to drive client and VIAVI stakeholders toward shared goals.
  • Willingness to travel 50–75%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using or selling mobile or wireline assurance solutions.

arkets firms, and other financial services organizations.

jobs.description:
This is a remote role; however, we only operate in the following states: AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX and WI.

ABOUT SULLIVANCOTTER

SullivanCotter partners with health care and other not-for-profit organizations to enhance performance and improve outcomes by developing and implementing integrated workforce strategies. Using our time-tested methodologies and industry-leading research and information, we provide data-driven insights, expertise, and solutions to help organizations align business strategy and performance objectives – enabling our clients to deliver on their mission, vision and values.

ABOUT THE EXECUTIVE WORKFORCE SERVICES PRACTICE

Our Executive Workforce Services consultants provide comprehensive advisory services spanning executive compensation, governance, and leadership strategy. We help organizations define and implement effective executive compensation programs that align with market benchmarks, organizational strategies, and regulatory requirements. Our expertise includes governance support for boards and committees, performance evaluations for executives, and design of competitive total compensation. We also advise on executive benefits and pay-for-performance strategies. Additionally, we provide insights on emerging trends, regulatory compliance, mergers and acquisitions, and employment agreements to ensure a holistic and compliant approach to executive talent management.

PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Provide comprehensive executive compensation consulting services and develop, implement, and/or administer executive compensation programs
  • Provide subject matter expertise and serve as a market expert regarding specific client market compensation issues
  • Conduct executive job evaluations; analyze job responsibilities, activities, duties, requirements, and organizational structure and recommend internal job placement in the appropriate level and title
  • Conduct market pricing, peer group selection, survey analyses, interpreting compensation data, financial modeling, and special research projects
  • Analyze data to determine the appropriate compensation level and job title for existing and proposed executive positions, including more complex positions involving responsibilities within multiple focus areas
  • Identify complex job matching and data issues and proactively consult with clients and key associates to determine the appropriate course of action, acting quickly to remove obstacles impeding project steps
  • Effectively keep the project manager apprised of project status, including delays or potential problems, holding self and team members accountable for client deadlines and deliverables
  • Assist with more complex report and proposal writing related to describing and summarizing project objectives, methodologies, analysis and results, and proof for accuracy
  • Serve as a peer reviewer and mentor of technical knowledge to effectively guide more junior associates in complex research, data collection, and analytics
  • Participate in appropriate client delivery team meetings to understand team and client initiatives
  • Establish client relationships and act as a key point of contact for client inquiries, as appropriate
  • Shadow project and client relationship managers at client meetings or teleconferences, as requested

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in a business-related field, ideally with an emphasis in finance, economics, statistics, mathematics, accounting, or health care administration
  • One to five years of progressive experience directly consulting with clients
  • Three to five years of related analytical experience required involving data analysis, financial modeling, and presentation design
  • Compensation consulting experience preferred
  • Solid technical knowledge and experience working with Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; basic programming experience is a plus
  • Strong critical thinking skills and the ability to:
    • Determine appropriate data analytic approaches and tools based on project tasks and client requirements
    • Analyze, organize, and interpret data using a logical and systematic process
    • Remove irrelevant data when conducting analytical work and developing creative solutions
    • Visualize and articulate complex problems and concepts
    • Recognize patterns in complex sets of data and recommend practical models
    • Identify and recommend solutions to remove obstacles impeding project steps or task achievement
  • Knowledge of laws and regulations that impact our health care clients
  • Excellent interpersonal, writing, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to:
    • Make clear and convincing oral presentations that achieve a specific purpose
    • Successfully tailor communications to the audience, as appropriate
    • Effectively present facts, analysis, and conclusions or solutions in a way that demonstrates command of content
    • Write concise project communications, documents, and presentations with an appropriate level of technical detail and complexity
    • Use an appropriate writing style consistent with organizational guidelines, templates, and brand standards
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills; ability to manage and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Self-starter with demonstrated ability to successfully assist with complex project deliverables in a driven and changing organization
  • Flexible, adaptable, and able to work under tight deadlines or changing needs
  • Confidence and ability to work independently and in a team structure
  • Intellectually curious, seeking opportunities to develop new skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree in a business-related field
  • Certified Compensation or Benefits Professional designation
  • Experience working within a consulting, compensation, or health care-related firm

SALARY, BENEFITS AND PERKS

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Medical and dental coverage at no premium cost for employees
  • 401(k) and profit-sharing retirement plans
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Company-paid holidays
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Bereavement and pet leave
  • Continuing education and professional accreditation sponsorship
  • Life and AD&D insurance
  • Short- and long-term disability
  • Employee assistance program
  • Mental health support program
  • Additional perks

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to academic achievements, skills and experience. The range listed is just one component of the compensation package offered to candidates.

  • $101,400 - 142,000 annually

OUR VALUES IN ACTION: HOW WE CARE

We live our values daily through four commitments:

  • Connect: Collaborate selflessly to support others, advance ideas, and solve problems using critical thinking.
  • Act: Bring integrity and respect to every interaction—no exceptions.
  • Reach: Commit to continuous learning and knowledge sharing that strengthens teams and clients.
  • Embrace: Foster inclusion and belonging so everyone can thrive and contribute.

jobs.description:
Evergreen Services Group is a San Francisco-based holding company that acquires and operates B2B services companies across North America. Since its founding in late 2017, Evergreen has completed 100+ acquisitions across Managed IT Services, Cybersecurity, ERP Software Partners and Government Services. We are driven by a people-first mission to be the best home for businesses and their leaders, by marrying capital allocation with inspired operations.

The Evergreen holding company team is comprised of 40+ professionals based in San Francisco who are focused on capital allocation, M&A, executive level hiring, strategic board leadership, and finance and accounting. Evergreen is a uniquely long-term oriented holding company that seeks to hold and grow businesses indefinitely rather than follow the 5-7 year holding period of a typical private equity fund. This allows us to take a truly long-term view on performance and people. Evergreen is backed by Alpine Investors, a leading private equity firm focused on the services and software industries with $16B+ in AUM.

The Opportunity (Future Leadership Roles)

This posting is intended to build a pipeline of exceptional leadership talent for future opportunities. It is not tied to a specific open position. We regularly acquire new businesses across the United States, and this role description reflects the type of Operating Executive profiles we seek as those opportunities arise.

We are looking for Operating Executives to take on high-impact leadership roles within new businesses acquired throughout the United States. Operating Executives will be responsible for driving organic EBITDA growth and recurring revenue at an operating company through active management and strategic leadership. We believe leadership talent is a key lever to a company's performance and are seeking Operating Executives to inspire the highest levels of performance, followership, and employee engagement within their company.

We primarily hire first-time CEOs into our operating companies and are seeking individuals who are ready to step up to the challenge and opportunity. The ideal candidate will be able to make difficult trade-off decisions between growth and profitability, hold teams accountable to budgets and targets, and create a winning environment of support and success.

With determination and persistence, Operating Executives should be willing to attack tough problems, skillfully analyze and identify root causes and partner with the leadership team to come up with actionable solutions that drive businesses growth.

Responsibilities:

P&L Ownership:

  • Develop and execute strategic plans to achieve financial targets, such as year-over-year monthly recurring revenue growth and year-over-year annual EBITDA growth.
  • Monitor and analyze financial performance, identifying areas for revenue growth and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Prepare and present financial reports, budgets, and forecasts to senior leadership and stakeholders.
  • Strong command of P&L and key levers that drive impact
  • Plan and execute long-term vision that drives sustainable growth
  • Financial discipline to drive growth in a cost-effective manner
  • Makes effective ROI resource-based decisions

Sales and Business Development:

  • Drive revenue growth through effective sales strategies, market analysis, and client relationship management.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients and partners.
  • Involvement in local organizations and business development groups, such as the Chamber of Commerce.
  • Continuously assess market trends, competitive landscapes, and customer needs to adapt and refine sales strategies.
  • Experience or ability with selling and closing on new logo.
  • Experience or ability to institutionalize sales & marketing and build a high-performing sales & marketing team.
  • Understanding of sales funnel and KPIs that drive successful sales & marketing actions and initiatives.

People Management and Leadership:

  • Experience with leading a high-performing, results-oriented team by recruiting, training, and developing team members.
  • Set clear goals and expectations, provide regular feedback, and drive a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Cultivate a healthy, effective team dynamic among the leadership team.
  • Ability to motivate and inspire.
  • Ability and willingness to delegate

Operational Excellence:

  • Streamline and optimize operational processes and procedures to enhance efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations and company policies.
  • Monitor inventory management, supply chain, and logistics to maintain product/service quality and availability.
  • Implement best practices and maintain a focus on quality control.

Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Data-driven approach to prioritization of growth efforts. Sets goals and follows through with them
  • Understand, prioritize, and execute on key growth levers: new customers, retention, pricing, cross-sell/up-sell
  • Grounds decisions in data or evidence
  • Appetite to create and exceed metrics

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree; MBA or equivalent is a plus.
  • Has a track record of achieving revenue generation targets on a limited budget, with a specific focus on new logo revenue
  • Strong background in people management, including hiring, firing, training, and development.
  • Demonstrated expertise in financial management, budgeting, and P&L responsibility.
  • Resourceful and scrappy; willing to roll up sleeves to dig into large strategic challenges as well as day-to-day, unexpected crises
  • Proven experience in an SMB general management or senior leadership role is a plus. Experience in an MSP or SaaS business is also a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a strategic mindset.
  • Proficiency in utilizing technology and data-driven decision-making.
  • Exceptional leadership and team-building capabilities.

We are looking for people that are primarily Location Agnostic, or are available to relocate within one of the following regions: West, Midwest, South West, South East, North East

We encourage you to apply even if you feel that you do not meet all of the above qualifications. Frequently cited statistics show that women and underrepresented groups apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Evergreen encourages you to break that statistic and to apply. No one ever meets 100% of the requirements. We look forward to your application!

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION AT EVERGREEN

At Evergreen, we acknowledge that an emphasis on diversity, equity, and inclusion (“DE&I”) is essential to hiring phenomenal people. To create the best home for businesses and spark success at our firm and throughout our portfolio, we aim to establish an environment where every person is welcomed, accepted, and empowered to excel in their role. About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

The Opportunity

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

What You’ll Work On

The Executive Clinical Specialist is responsible for being a technical leader, in the top 10% of all Abbott Clinical Employees. They provide expert consulting, teaching, and support for electrophysiologists on the EnSite Mapping System and its appropriate application in the clinical setting. The Executive Clinical Specialist is a significant driver of business within their Area and is a mentor to Principle and Senior Clinical Specialists. They are expected to provide consulting to customers on the complete EP product line. They provide collaboration with Area Vice Presidents and Regional Sales Directors to develop business at Strategic Accounts within each Area. They participate in the sales and marketing process and is responsible for ensuring all new accounts are established in accordance with Abbott’s EP Division’s educational and in-service specific objectives and that ongoing product utilization is encouraged when necessary or requested through in-lab support and consultation with the EP and other lab support personnel. They serve in a “Lead” capacity for other clinical employees in the region.

  • Manages regional training budgets as directed by the Regional Sales Director and Area Vice President to ensure goals are accomplished through fiscal responsibility.
  • Maximizes revenue opportunity through demonstrated consultative selling of a broad range of EP products at Strategic Accounts within each sales Region and Area.
  • Works with marketing and education to develop and provide formal training and education to electrophysiologists and their staff on the use of the EnSite Mapping System.
  • Works with marketing and education to develop and provide formal training and education to electrophysiologists and their staff on the use of the Claris Recording System and Viewmate Ultrasound System.
  • Demonstrates a thorough command of EnSite System related product and technical knowledge; cardiac mapping, ablation techniques, anatomy, and clinical science.
  • Provides expert clinical consultation on the use of our system to the EP, and lab support staff.
  • Coordinates all necessary logistics related to hospital training for new and existing accounts.
  • Takes a leadership role in ensuring employees in region are well developed and Abbott is well-positioned to take share at strategic accounts within their area.
  • Initiates, develops, expands, and maintains excellent customer rapport and relationships.
  • Initiates new training courses, while keeping a clinically based "consultative approach" the primary goal.
  • Participates in on-site procedure observations to ensure new product launches and evaluations are successful, utilization is encouraged, customer and personal technical knowledge is enhanced, and customer rapport is developed.

Required Qualifications

  • Masters or Bachelors in Biomedical Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • IBHRE EP “Board Certified” or equivalency required.
  • Minimum 10 years experience in cardiac electrophysiology and experience mentoring or managing other employees.
  • Verification that you will satisfy all vendor credentialing requirements, which may include vaccination for COVID-19. If you require a medical or religious accommodation from these requirements or if you would like to understand more about these requirements, please advise HR so that we can provide additional information and if needed, we can explore any needed accommodation(s).

The IV Support Executive is responsible for contacting and qualifying clients who have purchased investment travel packages, with a primary focus on ensuring their participation in the upcoming investment trips. The role involves assessing potential investors, addressing any travel-related concerns, and coordinating with internal teams to facilitate a smooth and timely travel process. The ultimate goal is to maximize the number of clients traveling within the current business month and ensuring they are well-prepared for their investment visit.

jobs.description:
CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.

Reports to: Chief Administrative Officer

Location: Remote (US or Canada), with regular collaboration across CSC Generation brands

About the Role

    This role exists to find and close executive, strategic, and highly specialized hires across CSC Generation's portfolio — the kind of searches where the right candidate is passive, hard to find, and being courted by everyone else. As Executive & Strategic Recruiter, you will own end-to-end search strategy and execution, partnering directly with hiring executives to define roles, map talent, and close candidates who weren't looking.

    In the first 6–12 months, success means you have personally sourced and closed multiple senior-level searches, built a warm pipeline of high-value passive candidates, and established yourself as a trusted advisor to hiring executives across the portfolio.

    This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end search strategy and execution for executive, strategic, and hard-to-fill roles across CSC Generation's portfolio brands and shared services, including sourcing approach, assessment criteria, and offer strategy in partnership with hiring executives.
  • Proactively source passive candidates through direct outreach, competitive talent mapping, referral networks, and platforms like LinkedIn — going well beyond inbound applicant flow.
  • Partner directly with hiring executives to define hard-to-articulate role profiles and translate them into actionable sourcing strategies.
  • Close searches where the ideal candidate profile is narrow, such as roles requiring deep applied AI or data science experience.
  • Build and maintain relationships with high-value passive candidates over time, even when there is no open role, so the pipeline is warm when the need arises.
  • Manage confidential searches with judgment and discretion, including roles tied to organizational restructuring or leadership transitions.
  • Provide market intelligence on talent availability and competitive hiring activity to inform how and where CSC Generation competes for talent.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated track record of sourcing and closing passive candidates for hard-to-fill executive or specialized roles — not just managing inbound pipelines. You have personally sourced and closed 10–15 or more senior-level searches in the last 12 months.
  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy, ambiguity, and direct executive access as an individual contributor.
  • A genuine network and the instincts to know who to call, not just how to run a search.
  • Technical fluency with modern AI and automation tools, with demonstrated ability to use these tools to increase effectiveness and productivity while exercising judgment about where human review is required in candidate evaluation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Search firm or agency recruiting background — you know how to cold-approach someone who wasn't looking and make them interested in speaking with you.
  • Experience recruiting technical, data science, or AI talent, given CSC Generation's AI-first operating model.
  • Retail, e-commerce, or multi-brand holding company experience.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your work touches every brand and function in the portfolio. Every search you close directly shapes the leadership and capabilities of CSC Generation.
  • AI-First Skill Building: You will operate inside an AI-native company that expects you to leverage modern tools and continuously sharpen how you source, evaluate, and close talent.
  • End-to-End Ownership: You own your searches from intake through close — no handoffs, no committees. You set the strategy, run the process, and deliver the hire.
  • Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
    2. Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Chief Administrative Officer focused on your search approach, sourcing methodology, and how you close passive candidates at the executive level.
    3. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at one of our office hubs (Salt Lake City, Austin, or Toronto). Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
    4. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
    5. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

    Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

  • Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.

CSC Generation will conduct an exhaustive background check including verifying dates of employment directly with your former employer.

Elsevier Clinical Solutions delivers trusted, evidence-based content and technology-enabled solutions that support healthcare professionals, institutions, and patients across the care journey. Elsevier is seeking a Physician Clinical Executive to drive the growth of Clinical Solutions across the APAC region. Based in Malaysia and reporting to the Product Sales Director, Clinical Solutions, this role serves as the physician-level clinical authority for commercial teams, customers, and partners, bringing deep clinical expertise and consultative leadership to the region.

The successful candidate will be a qualified medical doctor with clinical practice experience and the ability to act as a trusted clinical advisor to healthcare organizations across APAC. See yourself at Twilio

Who we are & why we’re hiring

Twilio powers real-time business communications and data solutions that help companies and developers worldwide build better applications and customer experiences.

Although we're headquartered in San Francisco, we have presence throughout South America, Europe, Asia and Australia. About the job

Twilio is seeking a highly proactive and business-minded Executive Business Partner to support executives within our Enterprise Technology organization. This role extends well beyond traditional administrative support. The successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of our business, technology strategy, organizational priorities, and key initiatives—using that context to anticipate needs, manage competing demands, and help leaders and their teams operate more effectively.

You will serve as a trusted partner to your executives, proactively managing their time and attention. You will be expected to exercise sound judgment, take ownership, and move work forward even when direction is not fully defined or all information is not yet available.

This role requires someone who is comfortable taking charge, solving problems, and navigating ambiguity. You will build strong relationships with executive leadership, their direct reports, and administrative partners across the organization, serving as a central point of coordination and a reliable source of insight and continuity.

  • Draft and coordinate executive communications, presentations, program updates, meeting materials, and other written content with a high degree of clarity and professionalism.

Location

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive on our Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) team, you will build a portfolio of clients by prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing new accounts. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, and management consulting. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a territory from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts from scratch - identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time. Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships. These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.

  • Working closely with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), you will prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities while also expanding existing relationships.
  • You’ll operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment, working alongside pre-sales experts and delivery teams to craft compelling, tailored solutions for each client.
  • Your initial portfolio will scale toward an annualized gross sales target of $1M in your first year, with expectations to grow into a $5M book by years 2–3, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

We are seeking scrappy, bold, client-obsessed professionals who are energized by face-to-face interaction, inspired by client success, and motivated to close high-impact deals. This is not a “work from your home office” role. We’re looking for professionals who are ready to get in the field, build lasting relationships, and lead with purpose.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal, learning the core of our model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
  • Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
  • Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
  • Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Work with your Portfolio Leader to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
  • Begin to meet with clients, articulate Toptal’s capabilities, and identify where we can help organizations in your territory plan.
  • Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
  • Learn about the Industry Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, and our client engagement model.
  • Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
  • Meet with Sales Development Representatives and Client Partners and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
  • Collaborate with Pre-Sales Solutions and Delivery teams to understand how we design engagements.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Conduct research and outreach through multiple channels to uncover new business opportunities within your accounts and drive sales pursuits with cross-functional Toptal teams.
  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage Toptal’s engineering, design, and business specialists.
  • Provide consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.
  • Provide advice and support for the planning of long term or short term business objectives or initiatives.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have an initial base of active clients, while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
  • Develop a network of client relationships and build a foundation of advocates and sponsors to expand Toptal’s partnership with existing accounts in alignment with your portfolio strategy.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize our talent network to build world-class distributed teams and increase efficiency.
  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
  • Continue to expand your portfolio of accounts, accelerate growth in your region, and use the full suite of capabilities that Toptal has to offer.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • Extensive experience in engaging and selling Consulting or Managed Services solutions, particularly within Financial Services or Professional Services organizations.
  • Proven track record in full-cycle sales of large, complex, multi-phase, managed technology projects to enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.

  • Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
  • Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location (25% or less).
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

Job Title: Senior AIOps Engineer I
Location: United States
Workplace Type: Remote


Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as our Senior AIOps Engineer I.

In this role, you will partner with product managers, platform engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers to make sure our AI and ML-powered systems are reliable, observable, secure, and cost-efficient in production. You will focus on how AI systems run in the real world: monitoring model performance and drift, keeping deployment pipelines robust, managing incidents, and standing up new AI infrastructure. Our AI/ML stack is built on Python and runs on Kubernetes (GKE) and Google Cloud Platform, using tools such as Union Cloud (Flyte), BentoML, Feast, Label Studio, BigQuery, and Dataflow. On the GenAI side, we operate a centralized LLM routing and gateway service, run batch prediction services for large-scale inference, and are building out RAG infrastructure. You will help evolve this stack so teams can ship AI features quickly and safely.


What You Will Do As A Senior AIOps Engineer I

  • Own production reliability for AI/ML services by monitoring availability and performance, defining SLOs and SLIs (latency, error rates, model performance) tied to user experience and business impact, and owning recurring model refresh cycles (retraining, validation, and redeployment) to prevent staleness and drift.
  • Design and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for models and data pipelines, and integrate model and system metrics with existing observability stacks and dashboards (Datadog, Opik, and others).
  • Streamline deployment workflows with data scientists and ML engineers (blue/green, canary, A/B, and shadow deployments), improve CI/CD pipelines and release processes for AI services, and support the productionization of image-based ML models, including batch prediction workflows.
  • Provision, deploy, configure, and maintain new AI infrastructure as it is adopted, including AI gateways, RAG platforms, LLM observability tools, agentic workflows, and no-code agent builders, using tools such as Union Cloud, BentoML, Feast, Kubernetes, Terraform, and GCP services.
  • Build automation and tooling to reduce manual operational work around model promotion, configuration, environment management, and Docker image maintenance, and support multi-BU infrastructure provisioning (separate environments, projects, roles, and CI/CD integrations).
  • Own the operational health of Label Studio, our production data annotation platform, including supporting GCS buckets, BigQuery pipelines, and database and SSO dependencies, and supporting bi-weekly annotation project cycles.
  • Stand up and operate RAG and vector database infrastructure, including embedding pipelines and context retrieval APIs, and optimize embedding storage and retrieval performance at scale.
  • Monitor and optimize LLM token usage and costs across providers, maintain centralized cost tracking dashboards and alerting across business units, and recommend cost-efficient model routing and provider selection strategies.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for AI/ML systems, triage and resolve production incidents, and lead and contribute to post-incident reviews that drive lasting improvements.
  • Develop production-grade services and tooling, primarily in Python, on Kubernetes, applying strong engineering practices (testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, security), and document standards, architecture diagrams, and operational playbooks for other teams.

What You Will Bring As A Senior AIOps Engineer I

  • A curious and driven mindset, with a strong interest in how AI systems behave in production and how to make them more reliable and observable.
  • 4+ years of applicable experience, including at least 3 years in commercial software engineering or production operations (SRE, DevOps, Platform, or ML Platform), operating services on Kubernetes and/or major cloud platforms.
  • Experience operating production systems at scale, preferably distributed, microservices-based, or Kubernetes-based architectures.
  • Strong GCP experience preferred, including hands-on work with GKE, BigQuery (data warehousing, SQL, schema management), Pub/Sub, Vertex AI (batch prediction, model deployment), Cloud SQL, GCS, and IAM.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools and deployment automation (GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar), infrastructure-as-code tools (preferably Terraform), monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, or similar), and container management and the Docker image lifecycle.
  • Experience operating and administering self-hosted open-source tools on Kubernetes, including installation, configuration, upgrades, security hardening, and backup and disaster recovery.
  • Understanding of basic machine learning concepts and model lifecycles (training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring), and familiarity with common ML tooling.
  • Familiarity with LLM ecosystem tooling (AI gateways, vector databases, RAG pipelines, embedding models, or LLM evaluation frameworks) is a strong plus.
  • Strong computer science and programming fundamentals, with solid problem-solving skills and a proven ability to write high-quality software using Test-Driven Development (TDD), SOLID principles, clean code, and robust documentation.
  • Experience with Python-based data and ML stacks (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch) is a plus. Experience building or operating ML infrastructure (feature stores, orchestration platforms, model serving, annotation tools) is highly desirable.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with data scientists, ML engineers, and product stakeholders in both business and technical contexts.
  • Comfort participating in an on-call rotation and working in a trustful, respectful, and collaborative environment.

The application window for this position is anticipated to close in 2 weeks (10 business days) from 11/2/2026. Please know this may change based on business and interviewing needs.


At this time, Porch Group does not consider applicants from the following states or jurisdictions for Remote positions: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Mississippi, Nebraska, Montana, New Hampshire, West Virginia, or the District of Columbia.


What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range*: $135,000 to $189,000 annually

*Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.

Additionally, you will be eligible to receive long-term incentive awards, subject to program guidelines and approvals.

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing.

  • Our traditional healthcare benefits include three (3) Medical plan options, two (2) Dental plan options, and a Vision plan from which to choose.
  • Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Accident plans are offered on a voluntary basis.
  • We offer pre-tax savings options including a partially employer funded Health Savings Account and employee Flexible Savings Accounts including healthcare, dependent care, and transportation savings options.
  • We provide company paid Basic Life and AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability benefits. We also offer Voluntary Life and AD&D plans.
  • Both traditional and Roth 401(k) plans are available with a discretionary employer match.
  • Supportlinc is part of our employer paid wellbeing program and provides employees and their families access to on demand guided meditation and mindfulness exercises, mental health coaching, clinical care and online access to confidential resources including will preparation.
  • LifeBalance is a free resource to employees and their families for year-round discounts on things like gym memberships, travel, appliances, movies, pet insurance and more.
  • Our wellness programs include flexible paid vacation, company-paid holidays of typically nine per year, paid sick time, paid parental leave, identity theft program, travel assistance, and fitness and other discounts programs.

What’s next?

Submit your application and our Porch Group Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have!

Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

Your Mission

We are seeking a Lead Unity Developer to take technical ownership of the architecture, development, integration, and final delivery of complex Unity applications for immersive and interactive experiences.

In this role, you will bridge creative development, technical art, third-party software development, and physical AV systems integration.

You will be responsible for maintaining the Technical Design Document, defining the application's technical architecture, coordinating development tasks, and ensuring all software and hardware components integrate into a stable, optimized, and deployable application.

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can balance creative ambition with practical implementation, proactively identify technical risks, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and make informed technical decisions throughout production.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

Your Responsibilities

1. Technical Architecture & Documentation

  • Own, develop, and maintain the Unity Technical Design Document (TDD).
  • Define application architecture, software dependencies, integration requirements, and technical workflows.
  • Establish development standards and best practices for C#, Unity project organization, asset management, and source control.
  • Identify technical risks, performance constraints, and integration challenges early in development.
  • Document the final application architecture, configuration, and deployment requirements for ongoing maintenance and support.

2. Unity Application Development & Delivery

  • Lead the development, integration, optimization, and delivery of the final Unity application.
  • Implement and maintain core application systems using C# and Unity's component architecture.
  • Integrate independently developed features, assets, and visual systems into a unified application.
  • Troubleshoot performance, rendering, memory management, compatibility, and application stability issues.
  • Manage application builds, deployment configurations, and production releases.
  • Support system testing, debugging, and final deployment.

3. Development Planning & JIRA Support

  • Collaborate with the Producer and development team to translate technical requirements into actionable JIRA tasks.
  • Define technical dependencies, implementation priorities, and acceptance criteria.
  • Provide technical estimates and identify potential development blockers.
  • Review completed work to ensure consistency with the overall application architecture.
  • Communicate technical progress, risks, and integration requirements to project stakeholders.

4. AV Hardware Consultation & Integration

  • Collaborate with AV integrators and hardware vendors to ensure the Unity application operates correctly within the specified hardware environment.
  • Consult on GPU/CPU requirements, rendering performance, display configurations, and system architecture.
  • Support integration with external hardware, display systems, sensors, touch interfaces, and control systems.
  • Develop or integrate communication interfaces for external hardware and software using appropriate protocols.
  • Identify and resolve hardware/software compatibility and performance challenges.
  • Participate in system testing, commissioning, and deployment as needed.

5. Web Overlay & UI Integration

  • Coordinate with third-party web development vendors responsible for creating web-based UI components.
  • Define and support communication interfaces between Unity and web-based applications.
  • Integrate web-based UI components or overlays into Unity applications where required.
  • Ensure reliable bidirectional communication, input handling, rendering, and interaction between UI and application systems.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and collaborate with external developers on performance and compatibility.

6. Technical Art & Real-Time Visual Integration

  • Collaborate with Unity Technical Artists to integrate real-time graphics, shaders, materials, effects, animation, and visual systems.
  • Establish performance budgets and technical guidelines for externally developed visual content.
  • Evaluate and optimize visual assets to meet target frame rates, resolution requirements, and hardware constraints.
  • Troubleshoot rendering pipeline, shader, material, and asset integration issues.
  • Ensure independently developed visual systems function cohesively within the final application.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Unity Engine: Advanced experience developing and delivering production applications using Unity.
  • C# Programming: Strong proficiency in C# development, debugging, object-oriented programming, and software architecture.
  • Unity Architecture: Experience designing modular, maintainable application systems using Unity's component-based architecture.
  • Graphics & Performance Optimization: Experience profiling and optimizing CPU/GPU performance, memory usage, draw calls, shaders, and real-time rendering.
  • Rendering Pipelines: Working knowledge of Unity's Universal Render Pipeline (URP), High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP), and associated rendering workflows.
  • Systems Integration: Experience integrating third-party SDKs, APIs, plugins, and external software systems.
  • Technical Leadership: Ability to take ownership of technical decisions, coordinate dependencies, and guide development efforts across multiple disciplines.
  • Source Control & Collaboration: Experience with Git, Unity Version Control, Perforce, or equivalent version control systems.

Nice to Have

  • JavaScript / TypeScript: Familiarity with modern web development and communication between native applications and browser-based interfaces.
  • React: Experience integrating React-based interfaces or web overlays with Unity.
  • AI-Assisted Programming: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to improve development efficiency, debugging, and documentation.
  • Shader & Material Development: Experience with Shader Graph, HLSL, compute shaders, and custom rendering effects.
  • Immersive & Interactive Installations: Experience developing software for museums, exhibitions, themed entertainment, or location-based experiences.
  • Multi-Display Rendering: Experience with multi-monitor configurations, high-resolution output, camera synchronization, or distributed rendering systems.
  • AV & Show Control Systems: Familiarity with external control systems and communication protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, WebSockets, OSC, Art-Net, or DMX.
  • Interactive Hardware Integration: Experience with touchscreens, depth cameras, sensors, tracking systems, RFID, and other physical interaction devices.
  • Video & Media Playback: Experience integrating high-resolution video playback, hardware decoding, synchronized media, or third-party media plugins such as AVPro Video.
  • Networking & External Services: Experience with REST APIs, real-time communication, event-driven architectures, and application-to-application messaging.
  • Deployment & Reliability: Experience with unattended installations, application monitoring, automated startup, recovery workflows, and long-duration runtime stability..

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

The Senior Accounting Manager, Corporate Accounting is a pivotal operational leadership role within the US Accounting organization, responsible for driving the day-to-day execution of corporate accounting operations, month-end close workflows, OPEX reporting, balance sheet reconciliations, and audit readiness. Reporting to the Assistant Controller, this role bridges the gap between hands-on transactional preparation and high-level controllership governance.

In addition to operational ownership of the close engine, this individual partners closely with Finance Transformation and cross-functional teams to execute continuous improvement initiatives across corporate accounting operations. They will focus on streamlining workflows, enforcing robust internal controls, and scaling general ledger infrastructure to support SOX compliance and public-company readiness as the company positions itself for future expansion.

Core Responsibilities

1. Month-End Close Execution & Corporate Accounting Operations

  • Close Ownership: Own the day-to-day operational execution of the US corporate general ledger close, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and strict adherence to internal accounting policies.
  • Timeline Management: Manage close calendar tracking, step dependencies, and daily sequencing across general ledger workstreams and operational accounting benches (AP, AR, Payroll).
  • Risk Escalation: Identify, assess, and document close-related risks, control gaps, and judgment areas, formulating structured recommendations to present to the Assistant Controller for final determination.
  • System Synchronization: Coordinate downstream data synchronization with system owners, ensuring sub-ledgers, management tools, and reporting engines tie accurately back to the core ERP system.

2. Journal Entry, Accrual Governance, & Technical Review (Leases, Debt, & Equity)

  • Accrual Management & Model Optimization: Oversee accrual accounting processes, including cross-functional estimate gathering, review of assumptions, and continuous improvement of accrual models and procedures to enhance forecast accuracy and close efficiency.
  • Lease Accounting (ASC 842) Review: Act as the primary accounting reviewer for the corporate lease portfolio under ASC 842, verifying initial lease classification, discount rates, schedule additions/modifications, and monthly right-of-use (ROU) asset and liability entries.
  • Capital Structure Review: Review material and non-routine journal entries and balance sheet schedules relating to corporate debt instruments, interest accruals, and equity/stock-based compensation administration.
  • SOX-Compliant Review Frameworks: Perform first-pass and secondary reviews of higher-risk, material, or manual journal entries, enforcing rigid supporting-documentation requirements and segregation of duties in line with public-company SOX control standards.

3. Balance Sheet Integrity, Fixed Asset Oversight, & Financial Narratives

  • Balance Sheet Integrity: Oversee the preparation and rigorous review of critical balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring audit-ready workpapers, robust supporting documentation, and timely resolution of aged items.
  • Fixed Asset Oversight: Oversee the review and approval of fixed asset rollforwards, CAPEX schedules, and depreciation workpapers prepared by dedicated asset accounting roles, validating accurate capitalization thresholds and asset tagging.
  • Fluctuation Analysis: Lead month-over-month and quarter-over-quarter P&L and Balance Sheet variance analyses for corporate OPEX and general accounting scopes, evaluating underlying business drivers.
  • Reporting Partnership: Partner with the Assistant Controller to translate financial trends, operational estimates, and analytical findings into executive-ready close narratives.
  • Tool Optimization: Collaborate actively with close-management platform administrators (e.g., FloQast) to optimize close tasks, reduce workflow bottlenecks, and strengthen review visibility and auditability.

4. Policy Operationalization, Transformation Partnership, & Controls

  • Transformation Partnership: Partner closely with Finance Transformation peers and system administrators to operationalize new tools, process enhancements, and automated future-state accounting workflows.
  • Process Alignment & Playbooks: Support the implementation of corporate accounting policies, designing operational playbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that translate US GAAP and internal control mandates into daily execution.
  • Technical Support: Partner with Technical Accounting and the Assistant Controller to embed technical updates and accounting standard changes into operational systems and workflows.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate cross-functionally with Accounting Operations (AP, Payroll) and FP&A to elevate upstream data integrity, cutoff discipline, and documentation standards.

5. Audit Management, Risk, & Internal Controls (SOX Readiness)

  • Audit Interface & Request Management: Serve as a primary operational interface for external auditors, managing PBC request fulfillment, technical walkthroughs, and supporting documentation across corporate accounting domains.
  • SOX Framework Execution: Design, execute, and document key management controls (ITGCs, transactional controls, and automated application controls) in alignment with ŌURA’s evolving SOX control matrix.
  • Control Testing & Deficiency Remediation: Proactively identify internal control deficiencies, process vulnerabilities, or segregation of duties gaps, partnering with internal audit and controllership leadership to design and execute immediate remediation plans.

6. Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • People Management: Directly manage, mentor, and upskill a high-performing team of corporate accountants, fostering a culture grounded in technical rigor, accountability, internal control discipline, and analytical review.
  • Performance Excellence: Set clear performance metrics, establish professional development plans, and drive continuous team growth aligned with public-company expectations.
  • Bench Strength: Build a robust internal leadership bench to sustainably support company expansion and organizational evolution.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 8–10+ years of progressive corporate accounting experience, with at least 3+ years in a people management capacity within a fast-paced environment.
  • Technical & Governance Expertise: Strong foundational grasp of US GAAP, operational accrual methodologies, OPEX reporting, lease accounting (ASC 842), corporate balance sheet management, and internal control frameworks (COSO / SOX).
  • Environment: Proven track record of operating within high-growth technology, consumer products, hardware, or inventory-intensive manufacturing companies.
  • Systems & Close Tools Mastery: Advanced hands-on experience utilizing Tier-1 ERP systems (NetSuite, Oracle, or similar) alongside close management platforms (e.g., FloQast) and audit request management software.
  • Public Readiness & SOX Experience: Direct experience designing, testing, or executing SOX control frameworks and external audit processes in a public-company or late-stage pre-IPO environment.
  • Education/Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; active CPA designation required.

Benefits
