Team Description

Reddit's Ads business is at an inflection point, and generative AI is reshaping how advertisers plan, build, launch, measure, and optimize campaigns. The Agentic Ads Experience team is building the next generation of advertiser-facing interfaces: campaign assistants, creative and ad copy generation, one-click campaign creation, audience discovery, conversational analytics, and optimization recommendations. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-moving team shipping generative AI/agentic systems into a high-growth Ads product, where every launch has direct advertiser and revenue impact.

Role Description

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Agentic Ads Experience team, you will design, build, and ship AI-powered product experiences that change how advertisers work with Reddit Ads Platform. You will own features end-to-end: framing the problem, choosing the right combination of software, LLM calls, tools, orchestration, and guardrails, and driving them through rollout, measurement, and refinement. The ideal candidate is a strong product-focused software engineer with hands-on generative AI application experience, who has an opinionated point of view on where agents, workflows, skills, and retrieval belong, and who cares deeply about shipping reliable systems that advertisers actually trust.

Responsibilities:

  • Product Execution: Design and ship advertiser-facing AI features and platform (campaign assistants, creative generation, audience discovery, performance analytics, optimization recommendations) end-to-end, from prototype to GA.
  • Agentic Systems Design: Make the right architectural calls on if and how to use generative AI, whether it’s a single-shot LLM call, a workflow, a skill, a retrieval system, an agent loop, human review, or no AI at all.
  • Reliability and Guardrails: Build for the failure modes of LLMs — structured outputs, tool/action boundaries, retries, cost controls, tracing, evals, and human-in-the-loop where it matters.
  • Measurement: Define offline and online evals, instrument traces, run A/B tests, and connect model and product metrics to advertiser and business outcomes.
  • Safety and Trust: Design for data isolation, permissioning, auditability, and policy compliance when AI systems take action on behalf of advertisers.
  • Collaboration: Partner closely with PM, Design, Data Science, ML Platform, Trust, and sales/ops to turn ambiguous problems into concrete, shippable systems. Collaborate with other product teams on how best to expose their services and capabilities to the platform’s centralized agent(s).
  • Craft and Communication: Write clear design docs, explain trade-offs to non-engineers, and raise the bar on how the org ships gen AI features.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience as a software engineer, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems.
  • Hands-on experience building generative AI applications: structured outputs, function/tool calling, prompt and context design, RAG, model routing, and handling model failure modes.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for agents and LLMs — you follow the space closely, have opinions on the tools, and can talk shop about the evolving ecosystem.
  • Strong systems fundamentals: APIs, distributed systems, queues, data stores, service ownership, auth, idempotency, retries, and observability.
  • Experience defining evals and measurement for AI systems — offline datasets, online metrics, and knowing when and how to measure a launch quality bar.
  • Fluent with AI coding tools and code-assistant workflows as part of your day-to-day engineering practice.
  • Excellent communication skills. You can collaborate effectively in a remote environment and explain complex AI system trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Extensive software development experience in one or more general purpose languages: Python, Golang, Rust, Java, JavaScript, etc.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in Ads, marketing technology, marketplaces, growth, recommendations, search, or analytics.
  • Experience building AI systems where mistakes are expensive: customer-facing products, regulated workflows, policy review, payments, or high-scale infrastructure.
  • Experience building internal workflow automation for sales, ops, support, policy, trust, or engineering productivity.

About InvestEngine

We’re a London-based fintech on a mission to make ETF investing simple and accessible. Over 150,000 clients have trusted us with over £3.5 billion in assets — and we’re just getting started.

We’ve been featured by MoneyWeek, Finder and Forbes, and we’re growing fast with big ambitions.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our Pensions Team as its first dedicated frontend engineer. The team looks after around 100,000 SIPP accounts and thousands of pension transfers every month.

You’ll own our pensions web journeys end to end — from clarifying requirements with Product, Design and Backend to building, testing, releasing and checking how features behave in production. Your first big goal is the frontend scope of a pension administrator migration: new account-opening flows, updated legal documents and in-app changes for existing customers.

The team is backend-heavy, so you’ll be the frontend voice in technical decisions: shaping API contracts with backend engineers, setting how frontend work is reviewed and tested in Pensions, and later onboarding a second frontend engineer.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain customer-facing pension journeys in React and TypeScript

  • Own features from refinement to production, shipping web in the same sprint as backend

  • Agree API contracts, states and error handling with backend engineers and designers

  • Build complex, multi-step forms for account opening, transfers and declarations

  • Write unit and component tests, and release safely behind feature flags

  • Monitor features in production and fix issues quickly

  • Work in a large, long-lived codebase and follow our documented frontend architecture

  • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex) in daily work — and review what they produce

  • Set frontend review and testing practices in the team, and onboard our next frontend engineer

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, Operations and the wider frontend group

What We’re Looking For

  • Commercial experience with React and TypeScript as your main tools over the last 2+ years, in a large, long-lived codebase

  • Production experience with a state manager beyond component state (Effector, Redux or similar)

  • Solid REST API integration skills, including loading and error states

  • Experience working closely with backend engineers — discussing and shaping API contracts, not just consuming them

  • Experience building complex or multi-step forms in production

  • Unit or component testing as part of your daily work (Jest, React Testing Library or similar)

  • General understanding of web accessibility (semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, ARIA)

  • Experience working within a documented frontend architecture

  • Strong ownership: you clarify unclear requirements before you start and see features through to production

  • Clear communication with engineers and non-technical stakeholders

  • English B2+ and fluent Russian

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on backend experience — commercial or personal projects

  • Experience building a Backend for Frontend (BFF) layer

  • Experience planning frontend architecture and breaking work down for other engineers

  • Experience with Effector

  • Playwright or other end-to-end testing tools

  • Feature flags and error monitoring (GrowthBook, Sentry or similar)

  • React Native experience

  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry — not required, we’ll get you up to speed

How We Work

We’re a lean, collaborative team where engineers have a real influence on product, architecture and engineering culture.

We value ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement. We start from the customer problem rather than the ticket, and we pick the simplest solution that works.

In Pensions, you’ll be the team’s frontend owner — the person who makes sure pension features reach customers on web at the same pace as the backend.

What We Offer

  • Impact from day one — own the web side of a business-critical pensions product

  • Real ownership — shape how frontend works in the team from the start

  • Growth — onboard and mentor the next frontend engineer joining the team

  • Modern tooling — TypeScript, React, Effector, Jest, Playwright, Storybook, Claude Code and Codex

  • Remote-first and flexible — work from anywhere, at your own pace

  • Unlimited vacation — take time off when you need it, no fixed limits

  • Supportive team — thoughtful, skilled colleagues who care about quality and results

Hiring Process

  1. Intro call with our Talent team

  2. Technical interview with the Frontend team (about 1 hour, case-based discussion, no live coding)

  3. Gamified cognitive assessment to understand how you think and problem-solve

  4. Final conversation with our CTO

Job Title: Associate Manager - Corporate Events Europe

Job Location: Dublin, Ireland

Job Location Type: Remote

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

This is a hands-on role for a talented events professional with a sharp eye for detail, project management experience, and wants to grow within a fast-moving team.
The successful candidate must be able to focus on event execution, be an operational contributor for all day-to-day processes, help manage budgets, support execution of tactics, activities, and other details. Must be a team player working collaboratively with sales, marketing, and cross-functional teams.

What You'll Do

As part of the European Corporate Events team, you will work with sales, marketing, and cross-functional teams across Europe to plan and execute Veeva’s major customer conferences and internal field kickoff.
You will:
    • Support planning and execution of key components of large-scale world-class conferences
    • Proactive management and execution of major event workstreams end-to-end (hotels, F&B, registration, welcome reception, evening event, meetings, etc.)
    • Executes with high quality of service and timely delivery of all necessary components and materials for each event
    • Evaluate and manage third-party vendors and agencies alongside senior team members
    • Drive cross-functional workstreams independently, keeping timelines, priorities, and stakeholders aligned
    • Review vendor contracts, identify gaps, draft proposed edits with senior team members and Veeva's legal team
    • Manage budgets, procurement, and invoice reconciliation, including YoY cost-per-head analysis
    • Build and maintain the spreadsheets, forms, project plans, and presentations for event planning

Requirements

    • 3+ years experience in mid- to large scale corporate event logistics & production
    • Proven experience managing event program elements from start to finish with minimal supervision
    • Strong project and time management skills
    • Experience managing event/project budgets
    • Extremely organized with strong attention to detail
    • Adaptable and flexible
    • Experience working cross-functionally and collaboratively
    • Collaborative team player who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
    • Strong desire to learn and grow
    • Ability to travel 15%

Nice to Have

    • Experience in enterprise software, SaaS, or life sciences

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

jobs.description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly technical, customer-obsessed Lead Solution Engineer to join our global technical operations team.

This is a premier role designed for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of deep technical problem-solving and direct client consultation. While you will support our diverse, global network of premium publishers, you will also serve as the critical technical lead for our rapidly expanding Brazilian market.

You won't be hiding behind a ticketing system; you will be the face of our technical expertise, working directly with our customers to solve their most complex technical challenges and seamlessly guide them through the adoption of our advanced ad-tech products. Because of this strategic focus, native or professional fluency in Portuguese is required, alongside excellent English communication skills to bridge the gap between our Brazilian customers and our global internal teams.

Core Responsibilities

1. Customer-Facing Problem Solving & Adoption

  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Act as the primary technical escalation point for our premium global publishers. Dive deep into code, network traffic, and ad server configurations to diagnose and resolve integration issues.
  • Brazilian Market Champion: Serve as the trusted technical partner for our Brazilian customers, leading implementation calls, troubleshooting sessions, and product walkthroughs fluently in Portuguese.
  • Technical Onboarding: Lead the end-to-end technical implementation of MonetizeMore's proprietary tools (like PubGuru and Advanced Ads) for high-value accounts, ensuring customers experience zero downtime and optimal revenue performance from day one.
  • Custom Code Solutions: Write and debug custom JavaScript, HTML, and API integrations to adapt our monetization solutions to the unique setups of customer websites and mobile apps.

2. Driving Product Value & Communication

  • Strategic Consultations: Partner with global Business Development and Account Management teams to evaluate a customer’s setup, proactively recommending configurations that unlock higher ad revenue.
  • The Technical Translator: Translate highly complex ad-tech concepts (e.g., Header Bidding, Open Bidding, Core Web Vitals) into clear, actionable value propositions for non-technical customers and business owners.
  • Product Feedback Loop: Act as the bridge between our global clients and internal Product/Engineering teams. Translate real-world customer friction points and feature requests into structured technical requirements to influence our global product roadmap.

Who You Are

  • The Customer-Facing Engineer: You have 5+ years of experience in a highly technical, client-facing role (e.g., Solution Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or a Support Engineer who works directly with customers).
  • Linguistic Capability: You are completely fluent in Portuguese (both written and spoken) and comfortable guiding Brazilian customers through technical solutions, regardless of their technical background. You also possess excellent English skills for internal global collaboration.
  • Web Tech Master: You have strong, practical knowledge of front-end web technologies: JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, CSS, and HTTP/Network protocols. You know exactly how to use Chrome DevTools to debug script execution, layout shifts, and page latency.
  • Ad Tech Exposure (Highly Preferred): Prior experience with Google Ad Manager (GAM), Prebid.js, Header Bidding, SDK integrations, or Google Publisher Tags (GPT) will make you a standout candidate.
  • The Empathetic Problem-Solver: You possess a rare blend of technical curiosity and strong communication skills. You know how to calm a frustrated customer, build trust, and methodically break down a vague bug report into a clear technical fix.

What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an autonomous schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

Assessment Requirement: As part of our hiring process, all applicants who pass the resume screening will be required to complete a TestDome assessment. Only candidates who successfully pass the assessment will be invited to proceed to the Culture Fit Interview.

  • Create, review, and adjust bounding boxes to precisely capture text blocks, paragraphs, tables, and other document regions.
  • Transcribe text exactly as it appears in source documents, preserving original characters, symbols, punctuation, diacritics, and formatting.
  • Review and annotate tables, mathematical expressions, and LaTeX equations while maintaining structural and textual accuracy.
  • Apply Markdown formatting consistently to represent document structures, including headings, lists, tables, and other elements.
  • Process multilingual documents while preserving language-specific characters, writing systems, and special symbols.
  • Follow project guidelines and annotation standards to ensure consistent, accurate, and reliable outputs.
  • Identify discrepancies in annotated data and make corrections in accordance with established instructions.
  • Maintain high levels of transcription accuracy and data quality while meeting project deadlines.
  • Review complex document layouts and technical content to ensure the integrity of digitized information.
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders and follow quality requirements throughout the document annotation process.
  • Native or near-native proficiency in Afrikaans, Amharic, Kinyarwanda, Malagasy, Swahili, Xhosa, or Zulu.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify minor errors in text, formatting, and document layouts.
  • Demonstrated ability to transcribe text accurately and reproduce exact characters, punctuation, symbols, tables, and mathematical expressions.
  • Familiarity with OCR text correction, document annotation, bounding box adjustment, or related data quality tasks.
  • Understanding of Markdown formatting and structured document representation.
  • Ability to review multilingual text while preserving special characters, diacritics, and language-specific writing conventions.
  • Strong reading comprehension and the ability to follow detailed instructions and annotation guidelines.
  • Ability to work independently, maintain consistent quality, and meet project deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when identifying discrepancies in document data.
  • Ability to work with complex document layouts, scanned images, tables, mathematical notation, and technical content.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in data annotation, OCR correction, document digitization, transcription, or data quality review.
  • Familiarity with scanned documents, complex layouts, tables, mathematical notation, and LaTeX equations.
  • Experience working with multiple languages, multilingual documents, or non-Latin scripts.
  • Experience following structured quality assurance procedures and annotation guidelines.
  • Ability to maintain high accuracy and consistency when processing large volumes of document data.

An enterprise client is seeking detail-oriented and quality-focused specialists to support document digitization and data accuracy initiatives. The role involves reviewing, annotating, and transcribing text and document regions from scanned images, ensuring accurate representation of written content through OCR correction, bounding box adjustment, and consistent Markdown formatting. The organization is looking for candidates with native or near-native proficiency in Afrikaans, Amharic, Kinyarwanda, Malagasy, Swahili, Xhosa, or Zulu, strong attention to detail, and the ability to accurately process complex document layouts, tables, mathematical expressions, and multilingual text.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Client Relations SpecialistAre you an experienced client relations or account management professional who knows how to build strong relationships, resolve challenges, and identify opportunities for account growth?
jobs.description:
Senior Client Relations Specialist

Are you an experienced client relations or account management professional who knows how to build strong relationships, resolve challenges, and identify opportunities for account growth?

Join KALAM as a Senior Client Relations Specialist and take ownership of a portfolio of clients, acting as the primary link between them and our internal teams. You will play a key role in strengthening client satisfaction, supporting retention and renewals, managing escalations, and identifying opportunities to expand our partnerships.

About the Role

As a Senior Client Relations Specialist, you will manage the day-to-day relationship with assigned clients and develop a strong understanding of their business, priorities, expectations, and evolving needs.

This role goes beyond responding to client requests. You will proactively monitor account health, identify potential risks, coordinate the resolution of service issues, support renewals, and uncover opportunities for account growth.

You will work closely with Operations, Service Delivery, Quality, Finance, Business Development, Technology, and other internal teams to ensure client commitments are clearly communicated and effectively delivered.

Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship & Portfolio Management

  • Own the day-to-day relationship for an assigned portfolio of clients.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between clients and KALAM's internal teams.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client's business, operating model, requirements, priorities, and contractual commitments.
  • Build trusted professional relationships with stakeholders at different organizational levels.
  • Maintain proactive and regular communication with clients.
  • Ensure clients receive accurate, professional, consistent, and timely communication.
  • Monitor overall account health and proactively identify potential risks and opportunities.

Client Experience & Retention

  • Monitor client satisfaction and the overall client experience across assigned accounts.
  • Identify early signs of dissatisfaction, service concerns, relationship deterioration, or potential churn.
  • Coordinate proactive actions with internal teams before issues escalate.
  • Support client retention and renewal activities.
  • Gather, document, and communicate client feedback to relevant stakeholders.
  • Help strengthen relationships that position KALAM as a trusted long-term business partner.

Complaint & Escalation Management

  • Own client complaints and escalations from acknowledgment through resolution and closure.
  • Assess issue urgency, severity, and business impact.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Service Delivery, Quality, Finance, Technology, and other relevant teams to resolve issues.
  • Keep clients informed throughout the resolution process.
  • Follow up on agreed actions and ensure commitments are completed.
  • Support root-cause analysis to help prevent recurring issues.
  • Escalate major relationship, service, contractual, or financial risks when required.

Account Growth & Commercial Opportunities

  • Identify potential opportunities for account expansion, upselling, cross-selling, and additional services.
  • Understand changing client requirements and translate them into potential business opportunities.
  • Qualify potential opportunities before escalating them to the Senior Client Relations Manager and/or Business Development team.
  • Provide relevant client and account intelligence to support opportunity development.
  • Coordinate internally to confirm operational feasibility before commitments are made.
  • Support proposals, renewals, and account expansion discussions.
  • Maintain ownership of the overall client relationship while senior management or Business Development leads final commercial negotiations.

Renewals & Contract Support

  • Monitor upcoming contract renewals and begin preparations well in advance.
  • Review client satisfaction, account performance, risks, outstanding issues, and potential growth opportunities before renewal discussions.
  • Coordinate required information with internal stakeholders.
  • Support renewal negotiations and discussions.
  • Ensure agreed contractual changes and client commitments are clearly communicated internally.

Financial & Collection Support

  • Maintain awareness of the financial status of assigned client accounts.
  • Coordinate with Finance regarding overdue invoices and collection priorities.
  • Follow up professionally with clients regarding outstanding balances.
  • Escalate payment disputes, recurring collection issues, or financial risks when needed.
  • Coordinate with Finance to resolve client queries related to invoices.

Client Intelligence & Forecasting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date information on assigned accounts.
  • Track changes in client demand, expected volumes, service requirements, business conditions, and expansion plans.
  • Share relevant client insights with Operations, Planning & Control, Finance, Business Development, and other stakeholders.
  • Support operational and commercial forecasting through timely client intelligence.
  • Identify relevant market or competitor information obtained through client interactions.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate closely with Service Delivery, Operations, Planning & Control, Quality, Finance, Business Development, Technology, and other departments.
  • Translate client requirements into clear and actionable internal information.
  • Ensure internal stakeholders understand client priorities and commitments.
  • Coordinate cross-functional actions related to assigned accounts.
  • Follow up on delays, gaps, conflicting information, or unresolved actions that may affect the client relationship.
  • Ensure external commitments remain aligned with KALAM's operational capabilities.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

Experience

  • 3–4 years of relevant professional experience.
  • At least 2–3 years of experience in Client Relations, Account Management, Customer Success, Service Delivery, BPO, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Proven experience managing multiple client accounts or stakeholder relationships simultaneously.
  • Previous experience within BPO, outsourcing, interpretation, contact centers, customer experience, or professional services is highly preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Client Relationship Management
  • Account Management
  • Customer Success & Retention
  • Complaint & Escalation Management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Business Development & Account Growth
  • Negotiation & Commercial Awareness
  • Problem Solving
  • Communication & Presentation Skills
  • Client Reporting & Account Intelligence
  • Time Management & Prioritization

Why Join KALAM?

KALAM provides language and business-process solutions to organizations across international markets, with services covering areas such as remote interpretation, customer experience management, shared services, and digital CX.

If you are passionate about building strong client partnerships, solving complex challenges, and contributing to long-term account growth, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About the role

Comms8 is looking for a hands-on Bookkeeper & Finance Admin to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration across our group.

This is a practical, detail-focused role for someone who is comfortable keeping financial records accurate and up to date, reconciling accounts, processing invoices and expenses, and preparing regular finance reports.

You will support four entities across two jurisdictions and work closely with our team and accountants in the UK and Hong Kong.

Importantly, our UK and Hong Kong accountants handle all statutory filings and audit requirements. You will provide accurate records and information to support them, but you will not be responsible for owning statutory compliance or audit.

The role will initially focus entirely on finance. Once the month-end process is running accurately and consistently, the role will gradually expand to include general administrative support.

What you'll be doing

Finance & Bookkeeping

  • Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across four group entities
  • Complete regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies
  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable
  • Prepare and issue client invoices and follow up on outstanding payments
  • Process and record business expenses
  • Prepare payroll data for UK employees and offshore contractors
  • Record and reconcile intercompany transactions between business entities
  • Produce a standard monthly finance pack
  • Prepare a weekly cash and aged-debtors report using an established template
  • Maintain accurate and well-organised financial records
  • Respond to queries and provide supporting information to our UK and Hong Kong accountants
  • Support month-end processes and help ensure the books are complete, accurate and ready for accountant review

You will not be expected to handle statutory filings or audits as these will be managed by our UK and Hong Kong accountants, giving you the opportunity to focus on maintaining accurate books and running the day-to-day finance processes well.

Admin Support

Once you have established a reliable month-end routine, the role will expand to include:

  • Contractor onboarding and offboarding paperwork
  • Vendor, subscription and business-tool administration
  • Document filing and record-keeping across the four entities
  • General administrative support for the operations team

What we're looking for

  • 2–5 years of experience in bookkeeping, finance administration or a similar hands-on finance role
  • Solid experience with day-to-day bookkeeping and bank reconciliations
  • Experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing and expenses
  • Good understanding of month-end bookkeeping processes
  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Organised and consistent in maintaining records and following established processes
  • Confident communicating with colleagues and accountants
  • Good written and spoken English
  • Comfortable working across multiple entities and currencies
  • Able to work the required hours with regular overlap with our UK and Hong Kong teams

Experience preparing payroll data, handling intercompany transactions or working with international/remote businesses would be an advantage.

Working arrangement

This is a full-time contractor engagement, not an employment position.

The role is fully remote and open to candidates based across Southeast Asia.

Because you will work closely with colleagues and accountants across the UK and Hong Kong, availability during the required working hours and sufficient overlap with both teams is a mandatory requirement for this role.

Compensation

USD 500–800 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated bookkeeping capability.

What success looks like

In your first few months, the priority will be straightforward: accurate books, clean reconciliations and a dependable month-end process.

Once the finance routine is running smoothly, you will begin supporting selected administrative tasks across the business.

If you are a practical, organised bookkeeper who enjoys keeping financial records accurate and processes running consistently, we'd be pleased to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: • Review and annotate document images to accurately identify text, paragraphs, tables, and other document elements.
jobs.description:
• Review and annotate document images to accurately identify text, paragraphs, tables, and other document elements.
  • Correct Optical Character Recognition (OCR) errors, including spelling mistakes, missing characters, formatting inconsistencies, and transcription inaccuracies.
  • Create, review, and adjust bounding boxes to precisely capture text blocks, paragraphs, tables, and other document regions.
  • Transcribe text exactly as it appears in source documents, preserving original characters, symbols, punctuation, diacritics, and formatting.
  • Review and annotate tables, mathematical expressions, and LaTeX equations while maintaining structural and textual accuracy.
  • Apply Markdown formatting consistently to represent document structures, including headings, lists, tables, and other elements.
  • Process multilingual documents while preserving language-specific characters, writing systems, and special symbols.
  • Follow project guidelines and annotation standards to ensure consistent, accurate, and reliable outputs.
  • Identify discrepancies in annotated data and make corrections in accordance with established instructions.
  • Maintain high levels of transcription accuracy and data quality while meeting project deadlines.
  • Review complex document layouts and technical content to ensure the integrity of digitized information.
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders and follow quality requirements throughout the document annotation process.
  • Native or near-native proficiency in Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Luxembourgish, Norwegian, Norwegian Bokmål, Norwegian Nynorsk, or Swedish.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify minor errors in text, formatting, and document layouts.
  • Demonstrated ability to transcribe text accurately and reproduce exact characters, punctuation, symbols, tables, and mathematical expressions.
  • Familiarity with OCR text correction, document annotation, bounding box adjustment, or related data quality tasks.
  • Understanding of Markdown formatting and structured document representation.
  • Ability to review multilingual text while preserving special characters, diacritics, and language-specific writing conventions.
  • Strong reading comprehension and the ability to follow detailed instructions and annotation guidelines.
  • Ability to work independently, maintain consistent quality, and meet project deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when identifying discrepancies in document data.
  • Ability to work with complex document layouts, scanned images, tables, mathematical notation, and technical content.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in data annotation, OCR correction, document digitization, transcription, or data quality review.
  • Familiarity with scanned documents, complex layouts, tables, mathematical notation, and LaTeX equations.
  • Experience working with multiple languages, multilingual documents, or non-Latin scripts.
  • Experience following structured quality assurance procedures and annotation guidelines.
  • Ability to maintain high accuracy and consistency when processing large volumes of document data.

An enterprise client is seeking detail-oriented and quality-focused specialists to support document digitization and data accuracy initiatives. The role involves reviewing, annotating, and transcribing text and document regions from scanned images, ensuring accurate representation of written content through OCR correction, bounding box adjustment, and consistent Markdown formatting. The organization is looking for candidates with native or near-native proficiency in Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Luxembourgish, Norwegian, Norwegian Bokmål, Norwegian Nynorsk, or Swedish, strong attention to detail, and the ability to accurately process complex document layouts, tables, mathematical expressions, and multilingual text.

jobs.title: Senior SNAP Policy Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Position AvailableThe Food Research & Action Center (FRAC) seeks a talented and experienced Senior Policy Analyst to join its Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) team.
jobs.description:
Position Available

The Food Research & Action Center (FRAC) seeks a talented and experienced Senior Policy Analyst to join its Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) team. This position offers an opportunity to help shape national and state policy at a critical moment for SNAP and to be part of a collaborative team working to protect, restore, and strengthen food assistance for individuals and families across the country.

The Senior Policy Analyst will analyze federal and state SNAP policy, translate complex legislative and regulatory developments into actionable information, and support advocacy strategies designed to protect access to benefits and strengthen program administration. The ideal candidate brings strong policy analysis and writing skills, substantive experience with SNAP, and the ability to move effectively between detailed policy analysis and broader advocacy strategy.

This is a fully remote position that offers opportunities to work in coalition with FRAC’s national, state, and local partners and to expand experience as a program analyst, strategist, coalition builder, and project manager. This position works closely with the SNAP Director and other Senior SNAP Policy Analyst. While this role is primarily remote, significant priority will be given to candidates based in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, including nearby Northern Virginia and Maryland suburbs.

Organizational Background

FRAC works to improve the nutrition, health, and well-being of people struggling against poverty-related hunger in the United States through advocacy, partnerships, and by advancing bold and equitable policy solutions. To attain this mission, FRAC engages in research, policy analysis and advocacy, coalition-building, outreach, technical assistance and training, and an array of communications strategies. In partnership with hundreds of national, state, and local nonprofit organizations, public agencies, corporations, and labor organizations, FRAC addresses hunger and food insecurity, and poverty as their root cause.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Analyze SNAP data and research to identify trends, disparities, implementation challenges, and opportunities to improve program access.
  • Evaluate the effects of existing or proposed legislation, regulations, policies and practices to determine ways and provide guidance to defend, improve and expand SNAP’s positive impacts.
  • Make recommendations for policy changes to streamline, improve accessibility, and increase SNAP compliance.
  • Write and/or assist with persuasive analytic and research materials, guides, outreach materials, and reports for use by advocates, government agencies, policy makers, service providers, and the media.
  • Make presentations to diverse audiences at local, state, regional and national conferences and meetings on SNAP access, benefit adequacy, and quality customer service.

  • Provide information, technical assistance, analysis, training, strategic advice, and other hands-on support to national, state and community-based organizations, state and local government agencies, private nonprofit organizations, and activists regarding ways to strengthen SNAP’s access, benefit adequacy, reach, and quality customer service.
  • Provide expertise and support to other program areas and departments assigned by the SNAP Director.
  • Represent FRAC at coalition and partner meetings.
  • Assist in managing regrants to national, state, and local nonprofits and provide technical assistance to the regrantees.
  • Other performance tasks as assigned.

Skills and Experience

The ideal candidate will possess the following characteristics:

  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in advocacy, program operations, policy analysis and/or organizing.
  • Advanced degree in public policy, law, public administration, social work, economics, public health, or related discipline required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of SNAP.
  • Strong policy research, analysis, and writing skills, including the ability to interpret complex statutes, regulations, and administrative guidance.
  • Ability to evaluate policies, processes, or programs to identify issues and recommend solutions.
  • Ability to communicate technical policy issues clearly to both specialized and nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Experience in nonprofit, government or policy work strongly preferred.
  • Ability to tap input and engagement from people with lived experience with hunger and poverty strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.
  • Commitment to FRAC’s mission and to improving access to nutrition assistance for people with low incomes.
  • Ability to work independently and as a member of a team.

Salary/Benefits

The salary range for this position is $86,000 - $89,000 depending on qualifications and experience. Generous leave, health, retirement, and other benefits. FRAC’s normal office hours are between 9:00 am and 5:30 pm Eastern. This position is part of a union and is covered under the terms of the collective bargaining agreement.

No phone calls or emails, please.

Opening/Closing Dates

Applications close 11:59 pm ET on Friday, September 4, 2026

FRAC is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. FRAC is firmly committed to a policy against discrimination based on age, gender, race, religious creed, sexual orientation, disability, or ethnic or national origin.

jobs.description:
We're looking for the right person to build that foundation from the ground up.
This is a hands-on leadership role with real ownership: you'll shape how data is collected, structured, and delivered — and grow a team around you as the function matures.

WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

  • Design the target-state data architecture: Postgres CDC → Kafka → Snowflake → client-facing data products.
  • Own tooling decisions across ingestion, orchestration, transformation, and quality layers.
  • Implement CDC-based ingestion from PostgreSQL services (RDS, Aurora, EC2, K8s operator) using Debezium or equivalent.
  • Build streaming and near-real-time pipelines with defined SLAs.
  • Build a data quality control layer: checksums, reconciliation, schema validation, anomaly detection, and alerting.
  • Define quality checkpoints across the full pipeline — from source capture through Snowflake to client delivery.
  • Define and enforce data contracts with service-owning teams for core entities: transaction, merchant, settlement, and processing status.
  • Build the external data delivery layer: financial settlement, transaction status, processor reconciliation, and client analytics.
  • Design tenant separation and implement replay/reload mechanisms for failure recovery.
  • Start hands-on, then gradually hire and grow a small data engineering team as the function matures.
    Build a pragmatic roadmap with concrete deliverables at 3, 6, and 12 months.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

  • 5+ years in data engineering with end-to-end ownership of production pipelines.
  • Hands-on with Snowflake, PostgreSQL CDC (Debezium preferred), and Kafka.
  • Solid AWS experience — S3, RDS, Aurora, and cloud data infrastructure.
  • Data quality engineering mindset: monitoring, reconciliation, lineage.
  • Comfortable defining data contracts and driving requirements with backend engineering teams.
  • Technical leadership experience: project ownership, cross-team alignment, delivery under constraints.
  • Kubernetes, Airflow/Prefect/Dagster, and dbt are strong pluses.
  • Payments domain knowledge — settlement, transaction lifecycle, processor integrations — is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with gRPC, RabbitMQ, and reading Go/Python service code is expected.
  • English language skills at the B2 level and fluent russian language.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • An opportunity to make something great even greater, you can be the reason why we grow, develop, and become the best fintech company on the market!
  • Career prospects - we are young, we have huge ambitions, and it is important that our employees grow with us
  • Work with coworkers who are passionate about their business
  • Compensation that will fully correspond to the competence and knowledge, with yearly performance reviews
  • Remote work
  • 20 days of vacation time; bank holidays; sick leaves; additional birthday day off

Job Title: Clinical Research Manager

Job Location: Turkey Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Clinical Research Manager oversees clinical monitoring activities and the CRA team's performance to ensure they comply with ICH-GCP, local regulations, and company SOPs, and maintain quality across clinical trials. As a line manager, this role leads a team to achieve organizational goals and ensure high performance by providing guidance, support, and development opportunities while promoting a positive team culture.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Team Resource Allocation & Performance

  • Allocate CRA resources and perform ongoing resource assessments to ensure a balanced workload for quality monitoring and to meet study deliverables.
  • Ensure CRAs have the required level of monitoring knowledge and skills to successfully perform required activities with high quality to meet study deliverables.
  • Is responsible for managing and addressing CRA performance and quality indicators in accordance with ICH-GCP, SOPs and local regulations.
  • Strengthen site relationships to enhance performance and uphold the company’s trial delivery reputation.

Quality and Compliance

  • Review monitoring quality and resolve issues to ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines, ICH-GCP Guidelines, and Good Clinical Practices.
  • Support study/site milestone delivery in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Responsible for execution of assessment visits and accompanied visits (where required) to assess ongoing CRA monitoring competency, identifying issues and developing resolution strategies.
  • Contribute to process optimization initiatives and manage risk escalation and resolution.
  • Support site audits/inspections/Site Compliance Visits (SCV) and ensure corrective action and follow-up for identified issues.

Expense Review and Management

  • Review and approve expenses related to CRA activities to ensure alignment with applicable policies and financially best local practices.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving and efficiency while maintaining quality and compliance standards.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Performs recruiting and hiring activities, along with onboarding new team members to ensure alignment with team objectives and culture.
  • Task Assignment: Assign tasks based on individual strengths and team objectives, ensuring optimal productivity.
  • Support and Resource Provision: Support team members by providing necessary resources to help them effectively perform their roles.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Encourage open communication and collaboration within the team and with other functions, including a point of contact for issue escalation and feedback where required.
  • Performance Evaluation: Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback to promote continuous improvement.
  • Mentoring and Development: Lead and mentor team members, fostering an environment of growth and development.
  • Issue Resolution: Address any personnel issues promptly and fairly to maintain a positive work environment.
  • Career Development Support: Support team members in identifying and pursuing professional development opportunities.

Education Required:

Bachelor’s degree or higher in a scientific or healthcare discipline, and advanced degrees preferred.

Computer Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook

Other Qualifications:

  • Fluent in written and verbal English
  • Minimum 5 years of industry experience in the pharmaceutical or CRO or relevant field

About the role

Comms8 is looking for a hands-on Bookkeeper & Finance Admin to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration across our group.

This is a practical, detail-focused role for someone who is comfortable keeping financial records accurate and up to date, reconciling accounts, processing invoices and expenses, and preparing regular finance reports.

You will support four entities across two jurisdictions and work closely with our team and accountants in the UK and Hong Kong.

Importantly, our UK and Hong Kong accountants handle all statutory filings and audit requirements. You will provide accurate records and information to support them, but you will not be responsible for owning statutory compliance or audit.

The role will initially focus entirely on finance. Once the month-end process is running accurately and consistently, the role will gradually expand to include general administrative support.

What you'll be doing

Finance & Bookkeeping

  • Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across four group entities
  • Complete regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies
  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable
  • Prepare and issue client invoices and follow up on outstanding payments
  • Process and record business expenses
  • Prepare payroll data for UK employees and offshore contractors
  • Record and reconcile intercompany transactions between business entities
  • Produce a standard monthly finance pack
  • Prepare a weekly cash and aged-debtors report using an established template
  • Maintain accurate and well-organised financial records
  • Respond to queries and provide supporting information to our UK and Hong Kong accountants
  • Support month-end processes and help ensure the books are complete, accurate and ready for accountant review

You will not be expected to handle statutory filings or audits as these will be managed by our UK and Hong Kong accountants, giving you the opportunity to focus on maintaining accurate books and running the day-to-day finance processes well.

Admin Support

Once you have established a reliable month-end routine, the role will expand to include:

  • Contractor onboarding and offboarding paperwork
  • Vendor, subscription and business-tool administration
  • Document filing and record-keeping across the four entities
  • General administrative support for the operations team

What we're looking for

  • 2–5 years of experience in bookkeeping, finance administration or a similar hands-on finance role
  • Solid experience with day-to-day bookkeeping and bank reconciliations
  • Experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing and expenses
  • Good understanding of month-end bookkeeping processes
  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Organised and consistent in maintaining records and following established processes
  • Confident communicating with colleagues and accountants
  • Good written and spoken English
  • Comfortable working across multiple entities and currencies
  • Able to work the required hours with regular overlap with our UK and Hong Kong teams

Experience preparing payroll data, handling intercompany transactions or working with international/remote businesses would be an advantage.

Working arrangement

This is a full-time contractor engagement, not an employment position.

The role is fully remote and open to candidates based across Southeast Asia.

Because you will work closely with colleagues and accountants across the UK and Hong Kong, availability during the required working hours and sufficient overlap with both teams is a mandatory requirement for this role.

Compensation

USD 500–800 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated bookkeeping capability.

What success looks like

In your first few months, the priority will be straightforward: accurate books, clean reconciliations and a dependable month-end process.

Once the finance routine is running smoothly, you will begin supporting selected administrative tasks across the business.

If you are a practical, organised bookkeeper who enjoys keeping financial records accurate and processes running consistently, we'd be pleased to hear from you.

About the job

ARS Logistics (Authorized Agent of Trinity Logistics) is a family owned and operated Third Party Logistics company with 20+ years of history. We are proud of what we have built through strong and lasting relationships with our customers and team members.

ARS moves freight across all modes for our customers — Truckload, LTL, Intermodal, Drayage, Ocean and Air. Our customers count on us for consistent capacity on the lanes they ship every week, not just whoever happens to be posted on a load board that morning. We are hiring a dedicated Carrier Sourcing Representative whose whole job is building that capacity: calling carriers, learning their lanes and equipment, and lining up committed trucks on our regular and hard-to-cover lanes weeks before the freight moves.

This is an outbound, phone-first role. You will own a set of target lanes, build a bench of vetted carriers on each one, and hand our operations and account teams capacity they can sell and book — so we cover on time, buy at or below market, and rely less on the spot board. Success is measured in carriers added, lanes with committed capacity, and loads covered by relationship carriers.

Start date: ASAP

Why you’ll like working here

  • A focused job — sourcing and relationships, not dispatch and paperwork.
  • Results you can see — lanes that used to be a daily scramble become routine because of the carriers you found.
  • Collaborative team — you work side by side with our operations, customer service and sales teams, who value open communication and follow-through.
  • Structured upward mobility — a clear growth path as the carrier team expands (senior sourcing, carrier team lead).

What you’ll do

  • Make high-volume outbound calls and emails to carriers, dispatchers and owner-operators to source capacity on assigned lanes — regular weekly lanes, capacity-constrained lanes, and new lanes from customer bids.
  • Build and maintain a carrier bench for every target lane: preferred lanes, equipment, trucks per week, rate expectations and contacts, kept current in our CRM / TMS.
  • Secure capacity and rate commitments weeks ahead, then hand them to operations and account managers so the capacity can be presold to customers and booked on the right dates.
  • Find capacity that never reaches a load board — asset carriers’ headhaul and backhaul lanes, small fleets with consistent routes, and dedicated or recurring-lane programs.
  • Vet every new carrier before it is offered freight: operating authority, insurance, safety record, and double-brokering or identity-fraud red flags, using our carrier onboarding and monitoring tools.
  • Collect carrier rate feedback for customer quotes and RFPs / RFQs so our pricing reflects real cost.
  • Keep relationships warm — regular check-ins, service feedback, and fast resolution of load or payment questions with our operations and accounting teams.
  • Report weekly on lanes covered, carriers added, committed capacity and cost versus market.

What you need to bring

  • 1+ year (2+ preferred) in carrier sales, capacity sourcing or carrier development at a U.S. freight brokerage / 3PL — truckload (dry van, reefer, flatbed).
  • Proven outbound phone volume: comfortable making 60+ carrier calls a day and negotiating with U.S. dispatchers and owner-operators.
  • Working knowledge of DAT and / or Truckstop load boards and rate data, and lane terminology (headhaul, backhaul, deadhead, all-in, linehaul vs. fuel).
  • Understanding of carrier compliance — MC / DOT authority, certificates of insurance, safety ratings — and common double-brokering and identity-fraud schemes.
  • Clear, confident spoken English and professional written English.
  • Disciplined record keeping: every call, carrier and commitment logged in a CRM / TMS the same day.
  • Operational in Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel.
  • Reliable remote setup: backup power, backup internet, backup computer, 2 to 3 screens, and a noise-cancelling headset.
  • Availability during core U.S. Eastern business hours (see engagement details).

Preference given to

  • Experience building dedicated or recurring-lane carrier programs.
  • Carrier onboarding / monitoring tools such as Highway, RMIS, Carrier Assure or MyCarrierPackets.
  • Dialpad or similar VoIP phone systems; Zoho or another CRM.
  • Prior experience supporting a Trinity Logistics agency or another agent-model brokerage.
  • Reefer, flatbed, drayage or cross-border (Mexico) carrier networks; Spanish.

Engagement details

  • Engagement type: Remote independent contractor, Philippines-based.
  • Core availability: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern (1-hour lunch); final schedule may be adjusted based on team coverage. Occasional after-hours carrier calls (infrequent).
  • Compensation: $940 – $1,150 USD per month, based on experience, plus a performance incentive tied to committed capacity and loads covered, with a structured growth plan.
  • Time off: 15 paid business days per calendar year after 90 days, per contract structure.
  • Reports to: Operations Manager.
  • Travel: None.

How to apply

Apply with your resume and answer the screening questions on the application. The screening questions include a link to a 60-second voice recording (Google Drive, Vocaroo or similar) of you introducing yourself to a U.S. carrier dispatcher and asking about their lanes. Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.

jobs.description:
Overview

Location(s): SoutheastPractice/Department: CulturalWork Environment: RemoteCompensation:$135,000-155,000/annually*

Dudek’s journey began in 1980 with a vision to serve Southern California’s water and wastewater agencies.

Today, we are a 100% employee-owned firm supporting clients nationwide and delivering projects that improve and protect the built and natural environments of communities throughout the United States. Our work has been recognized by leading industry organizations, and we’ve been honored with multiple national Top Workplace Awards.

Our employee-owners are unified by a singular commitment to supporting projects that address key societal issues, such as the transition to renewable energy, infrastructure hardening and repair, environmental protection, and community resilience.

Learn more about our award-winning culture, the benefits and perks of being a Dudekian, and the projects you will have the opportunity to shape.

Position Overview

Who You Are

As an employee-owner, you embrace accountability, working safely, and collaboration while thinking resourcefully and independently.

Like all Dudekians, you are curious and solution-oriented, with the ability to adapt quickly to changes and approach challenges with a spirit of innovation.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Dudek is currently seeking a full-time senior-level Cultural Resources/Architectural Historian Senior Project Manager to help lead and expand our cultural resources services in the Southeast. The successful candidate will work in close partnership with our Southeast Lead Archaeologist, pairing built environment, regulatory, and project leadership experience with archaeological expertise. This position will oversee a full range of cultural resources services, lead business development, prepare scopes and cost estimates, serve as a senior technical expert, and build relationships with clients, agencies, State Historic Preservation Offices (SHPOs), and consulting parties. This role will also help guide projects through Section 106, Section 4(f), NEPA, and applicable state review processes and mentor early- and mid-career staff as the Southeast practice grows.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Partner with Dudek’s Southeast Lead Archaeologist to build and grow the cultural resources practice, combining built environment and archaeology services into an integrated offering;
  • Develop a shared growth strategy with the Southeast Lead Archaeologist, including target clients, agencies, markets, and contract vehicles, and track progress against that strategy;
  • Jointly pursue and deliver projects, sharing technical leadership so archaeology and built environment work move together through survey, evaluation, effects assessment, and mitigation;
  • Coordinate with Dudek planners, environmental staff, and cultural resources groups in other regions to incorporate Southeast cultural resources services into larger pursuits;
  • Lead projects through Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act, including 36 CFR Part 800, Section 4(f), NEPA, and applicable state review laws, from identification and evaluation through resolution of adverse effects;
  • Assess effects on historic properties and prepare Finding of Effect documentation for federal and state agencies;
  • Lead consultation with SHPOs, federal agencies, Tribes, local governments, and consulting parties and build consensus among interested and affected parties;
  • Negotiate and author Memoranda of Agreement and Programmatic Agreements;
  • Develop creative mitigation measures, including HABS/HAER/HALS documentation, historic context studies, NRHP nominations, interpretive markers and displays, and public outreach;
  • Advise clients and project teams on regulatory strategies for complex, multi-year projects;
  • Oversee cultural resources surveys, from reconnaissance-level surveys through intensive-level documentation;
  • Oversee the evaluation of historic-era properties under NRHP, state register, and local designation criteria;
  • Provide oversight for complex resource types, including historic bridges, roadways, canals, railroads, historic districts, and mid-twentieth-century development;
  • Apply the Secretary of the Interior’s Standards for the Treatment of Historic Properties in federal, state, and local regulatory settings;
  • Work with state site files and SHPO inventory systems across the Southeast, including the Florida Master Site File, Georgia’s GNAHRGIS, and South Carolina’s ArchSite;
  • Contribute to policies, guidance, and best practices for identifying and evaluating historic resources;
  • Present findings and documentation at agency meetings, public meetings, and historic preservation board meetings;
  • Lead research and writing for historic context statements and registration requirements and oversee property-specific research;
  • Prepare and oversee survey and evaluation reports, effects assessments, and cultural resources sections for NEPA documents, including Environmental Assessments and Environmental Impact Statements;
  • Provide senior-level review of internal and external work products and establish and maintain best practices for documentation, report templates, and data management;
  • Mentor early- and mid-career staff on project and proposal efforts, delegate technical work, provide guidance on technical approaches, and develop internal training;
  • Work with the Southeast Lead Archaeologist to identify staffing needs and recruit as the Southeast practice grows;
  • Assume formal staff-supervision responsibilities as the Southeast team grows;
  • Build long-term relationships with agency, municipal, and private clients and act as a seller-doer who turns existing work into new opportunities and cross-sells services with other Dudek teams;
  • Lead business development for cultural resources and built environment work in the Southeast, including relationships with clients, agencies, and SHPOs;
  • Prepare scopes of work, cost estimates, and proposal content based on project and regulatory needs;
  • Manage projects and deliverables from initiation through completion and ensure deadlines are met;
  • Manage budgets, schedules, client invoicing, project status, and staff billing, with support from other project managers as needed;
  • Communicate regularly with internal project managers and clients.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in history, architectural history, historic preservation, or a related field;
  • 20+ years of professional experience in federal permitting, cultural resources management, architectural history, or historic preservation regulatory compliance;
  • Meets the Secretary of the Interior’s Professional Qualification Standards for Architectural History;
  • Ability to travel as needed;
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license and have active personal automobile liability insurance by the first day of employment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 25+ years of professional experience in cultural resources management, architectural history, and federal permitting in the Southeastern United States;
  • Experience working with multiple Southeastern SHPOs and their survey and reporting guidelines;
  • Experience with transportation, energy, or federal agency projects, such as FHWA/state DOT, USACE, or FERC projects;
  • Previous staff management experience;
  • Experience preparing NRHP nominations, Multiple Property Documentation Forms, or historic context studies;
  • Proficiency with GIS and mobile data collection tools;
  • Excellent technical writing and research skills, with experience providing senior-level review;
  • Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, including archaeologists, planners, and environmental staff.

Compensation: $135,000-155,000/annually*

*Final agreed-upon compensation will be based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s related experience, education, certifications, skills, and work location. Successful candidates must pass a pre-employment drug test and background check prior to beginning employment.

Working Conditions

  • This job operates in a remote or office-based environment and this role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, etc.
  • This job requires occasional project site visits, based outdoors which can include excessive noise, uneven walking surfaces, extreme weather, and moving vehicles and equipment.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. This job requires the following:

  • Working on a computer, sitting, or standing for long periods of time in an office or remote office setting.
  • Attending meetings, both in person and virtually, and speaking on the phone with peers, clients, etc.
  • Specific vision abilities, including close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Their platform scans the open web for personally identifiable information, helps remove that data from brokers and public sources, and gives companies ongoing visibility into what has been found, removed, and what reappears over time.

They sell into organizations where privacy, cybersecurity, executive protection, legal risk, and employee safety matter. This includes law firms, corporate security teams, executive-protection firms, cyber-insurance providers, benefits brokers, PEOs, and enterprise organizations.

About the Role

This is a Founding Account Executive role and the company's first dedicated revenue hire.

This is not a role where you inherit a large sales team, SDR team, or marketing engine. This is for a proven seller who can self-source pipeline, open doors, run complex sales cycles, and close revenue.

You will work directly with the founder and leadership team, help build the sales motion, close the first major wave of enterprise and channel deals, and create the playbook for the future sales team.

For the right person, this role has a clear path into sales leadership and potentially a future CRO-level opportunity based on results.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to procurement, legal, and close
  • Build your own pipeline through outbound, warm introductions, existing relationships, events, and channel partners
  • Open named target accounts quickly using your existing network
  • Sell into buyers across Security, Legal, HR, Benefits, Executive Protection, and Corporate Risk
  • Target direct enterprise opportunities, law firms, executive-protection firms, cyber-insurance carriers, benefits brokers, PEOs, and channel partners
  • Work closely with the founder on early deals, then take full ownership of the sales process
  • Help document what works so the company can build a repeatable sales playbook
  • Bring real market feedback into the business from buyers, partners, and prospects

What We're Looking For

  • 7 to 12 years of B2B sales experience
  • Proven success as a top-performing individual contributor
  • Experience selling into cybersecurity, privacy, data protection, digital risk, HR tech, compliance, cyber insurance, enterprise SaaS, or a related space

  • Experience selling to senior decision-makers such as CISOs, CIOs, General Counsel, COOs, CHROs, corporate security leaders, legal teams, or HR/benefits leaders

The company already has a working product, real enterprise revenue, channel opportunities, and buyers who understand the problem. Now they need the first true sales producer who can bring the market in.

If you are a proven closer who knows how to open doors, build pipeline, and close complex B2B deals, this could be a strong fit.

Please apply with your resume and a short note outlining your sales track record, the markets you have sold into, and the types of accounts you believe you could open quickly.

Veeva Training is a learning management system (LMS) designed to ensure training compliance, qualification and job readiness. On behalf of the MOD, we are currently creating a pipeline for x6 LOPT Redaction Officers(Inside IR35) for a 6 month remote contract.

The Ministry of Defence (MOD) is a central government department with a mission to protect our country and provide the ultimate guarantee of its security and independence, as well as helping to protect its values and interests abroad.

The MOD is one of the biggest public procurement organisations in Europe and the single largest customer for UK industry. It currently manages approximately £20 billion of spend on capital investments in equipment and infrastructure every year. Over the next decade the MOD is committed to spending over £190 billion on equipment and support. The MOD’s customers include both the armed forces and national security agencies, and it has a diverse range of requirements, including military fighting vehicles, education services, nuclear submarines and facilities management.

The MOD’s aim is to provide its armed forces with the best capabilities to enable them to protect the UK’s security and advance national interests, both now and in the long term.

To do this the MOD has an annual budget of almost £53 billion and a workforce comprising 197,000 people. of which 54,000 are civilians working for the UK MOD.

The work really matters; the MOD offers a range of engaging roles which have a direct impact on the quality of services they provide, in many locations across the UK. We support teams working in HR, Primary Health Care, Corporate Services, and many others.

As a LOPT Redaction Officer, your main responsibilities will be:

  • Review sensitive personal records prior to disclosure.
  • Identify and redact information requiring protection on national security grounds.
  • Redact sensitive names, locations and operational references.
  • Check documents against a supplied redlist of sensitive terms.
  • Ensure documents are fully and accurately redacted before release.
  • Support the lawful disclosure of records for Subject Access Requests (SARs) and litigation.
  • Use supplied redaction tools to process documents securely.
  • Provide dedicated redaction support to the Legacy Operations Processing Team.

PLEASE NOTE: SC Clearance is an essential requirement for this role, as a minimum you must be willing & eligible to undergo checks. Please note, due to the exceptional requirements of this position (short-term nature of this role and speed at which we require a postholder in situ) preference may be given to candidates who meet all of the essential criteria and hold active security clearance.

Essential:

  • Strongattention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good general administration skills.
  • Able to read and understand document context.
  • Good understanding of data protection and sensitive information.
  • Able to follow redaction guidance and identify sensitive material.
  • Comfortable applying national security redactions.
  • Case management experience is not essential. The focus is redaction, not managing cases.
  • Must be a UK citizen.

Desirable:

  • Military or defence background would be beneficial.

Please be aware that this role can only be worked within the UK and not Overseas.

Deine Mission:

Du wirst zur fachlichen Stimme unseres Sales und Account Management Teams.

Unsere Account Executives & Account Manager führen die kommerziellen Gespräche. Du bringst die Security-Expertise ein, mit der aus interessierten Unternehmen überzeugte Kunden werden.

  • Beraten statt Kaltakquise:Du steigst in qualifizierte Kundengespräche ein, verstehst Security-Herausforderungen und entwickelst passende Lösungsansätze.

  • Deine Expertise sichtbar machen:Du zeigst IT-Leitungen, CISOs und Geschäftsführungen, wie heyData bei ISO 27001, NIS2 und weiteren Compliance-Anforderungen unterstützt.

  • Lösungen gestalten:Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Sales-Team den richtigen Projektumfang und überzeugst Kunden mit nachvollziehbaren Empfehlungen.

  • Erfahrung mit Demos, Scoping oder technischen Verkaufsprozessen

Du musst nicht jede Anforderung zu 100 % erfüllen.
