jobs.description:
National Sales Executive – Freight Brokerage

Location: Remote – United States
Preference: Middle Tennessee / reasonable proximity to company headquarters preferred, but exceptional candidates nationwide will be considered
Employment Type: Full-Time, W-2
Openings: 1–2

Build the Business. Own the Hunt. Get Rewarded.

An established, family-owned transportation and logistics company is looking for an experienced National Sales Executive – Freight Brokerage to help lead the next phase of growth.

This is a true hunter sales role. We're looking for someone who wakes up thinking, Who can I sell today?

Your primary responsibility will be to identify and win new shipper relationships, develop freight opportunities, and bring new business into the organization. Once the business is won, you'll have an experienced brokerage and operations team behind you to help execute it.

You sell. We execute.

This is an opportunity for an accomplished logistics salesperson to make a meaningful impact at an established, financially healthy company that is actively building its next generation of sales leadership.

About the Company

Our client is an established, family-owned transportation and logistics company approaching its 25th anniversary.

With approximately 20 employees, the company has built a strong reputation through organic growth and a long-tenured team. Many employees have been with the organization for a decade or longer.

The company's historical foundation includes printed media distribution and LTL transportation, which remains an important and profitable part of the business. However, leadership is strategically expanding its freight brokerage operation, particularly truckload and broader transportation services.

The infrastructure is already in place. Now the company is investing in the sales talent needed to accelerate growth.

The Opportunity

As National Sales Executive, you'll be responsible for:

  • Hunting for and winning new shipper accounts
  • Prospecting through cold calling, email, networking, referrals, and other outbound strategies
  • Building relationships with transportation decision-makers
  • Identifying freight opportunities and developing a qualified pipeline
  • Personally leading the sales process from prospecting through close
  • Growing revenue and margin through new customer acquisition
  • Selling truckload, LTL, and other transportation solutions based on customer needs
  • Developing opportunities across a variety of commodities and freight types
  • Meeting with customers virtually and in person when appropriate
  • Working closely with leadership and operations to successfully onboard new business
  • Transitioning day-to-day freight execution to the existing operations team so you can remain focused on business development
  • Maintaining consistent activity, pipeline development, customer meetings, and revenue-producing efforts

This is not a cradle-to-grave brokerage position where you'll spend your days finding customers and your nights covering trucks.

Your job is to find the freight and grow the business.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Proven sales experience within freight brokerage, logistics, transportation, or a closely related industry
  • Demonstrated history of hunting and winning new shipper business
  • Strong prospecting and cold-calling skills
  • Ability to independently develop a sales pipeline
  • Strong understanding of the transportation industry
  • Demonstrated sales production and measurable results
  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and strong sense of ownership
  • Comfort being measured on activity, pipeline development, revenue, and margin production

Strongly Preferred

  • Existing relationships with shippers or transportation decision-makers
  • Demonstrated ability to build a book of business from scratch
  • Specific examples of significant accounts personally won
  • History of producing measurable revenue and/or gross margin
  • Experience selling multiple transportation modes or services
  • Strong customer-facing presentation skills
  • Experience with truckload, LTL, reefer, flatbed, oversized, specialized, or other brokerage services
  • Experience selling customized or comprehensive transportation solutions

Your Existing Book Is Welcome — But It's Not Required

We value candidates with strong existing relationships, but you do not need to bring a portable book of business to be successful here.

If you're currently subject to a non-solicit or other restriction that prevents you from approaching existing customers, we will still consider you.

What matters most is whether you've demonstrated that you can consistently win business.

If you've built a book once, we believe you can build another one.

Why Join This Opportunity?

Sell Without Getting Buried in Operations

You'll have an experienced team supporting the freight after you bring it in.

The existing infrastructure includes:

  • Brokerage management
  • Experienced brokerage and operations professionals
  • Pricing support
  • LTL pricing expertise
  • IT support
  • Accounting
  • AP/AR
  • Carrier payment support
  • Invoicing
  • Tracking
  • Claims support
  • Established TMS and technology infrastructure

You won't be expected to do everything yourself.

Uncapped Earning Potential

We want producers to make money.

The compensation structure includes a competitive base salary and uncapped commission, with earning potential tied directly to production.

Compensation is flexible based on experience, demonstrated production, and overall fit.

Join an Established Company That's Still Building

The company has nearly 25 years of history, a financially healthy business, and an experienced team — but is still small enough that one great salesperson can make a significant difference.

You're not stepping into a finished sales organization.

You're helping build the next one.

Potential for Growth

jobs.description:
About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. Role Summary The Rivian Supply Chain team is looking for highly motivated technical professionals to drive value through expert cost analysis. As a Senior Cost Engineer - Interior, you will serve as a key individual contributor responsible for independently managing the cost analysis of assigned commodities. You will integrate data from various sources to create defensible estimates that directly influence sourcing decisions, design trade-offs, and supplier negotiations. In this role, you will drive results by building compelling business cases that persuade stakeholders to adopt cost-optimized strategies. You are expected to demonstrate advanced proficiency in cost-modeling tools and take ownership of improving team processes. This role offers the opportunity to influence decision-making by presenting logical, data-driven insights in cross-functional forums. This position is based remotely in Mexico and reports to Manager, Cost Engineering. El equipo de Supply Chain de Rivian busca profesionales técnicos sumamente comprometidos para generar valor mediante el análisis de costos realizado por expertos. Como Ingeniero/a de costos sénior - Interior, desempeñará un papel clave como colaborador/a individual responsable de gestionar independientemente el análisis de costos de los productos asignados. Integrará datos de diversas fuentes para crear estimaciones justificables que influyan directamente en las decisiones de abastecimiento, las contrapartidas de diseño y las negociaciones con los proveedores. En este puesto, impulsará los resultados elaborando casos de negocio atractivos que convenzan a las partes interesadas de adoptar estrategias optimizadas en cuanto a costos. Se espera que demuestre un dominio avanzado de las herramientas de modelado de costos y que asuma la responsabilidad de mejorar los procesos del equipo. Este puesto ofrece la oportunidad de influir en la toma de decisiones al presentar información lógica basada en datos en foros interfuncionales. Este puesto está ubicado de manera remota en México y reporta al gerente de Cost Engineering. Responsibilities Knowledge Base: Independently applies manufacturing principles and maintains a working knowledge of material properties, key manufacturing processes, and cost drivers without frequent guidance. Presentation & Storytelling: Builds and presents a compelling business case to explain component cost analysis and persuade stakeholders to use the output to generate financial opportunities. Technical Skills: Demonstrates advanced usage of aPriori and/or Costdata, autonomously modifying cost estimate process setups and options while leveraging the full toolchain (PLM, CATIA, etc.). Organizational Influence & Outreach: Advises outcomes to direct counterparts and uses data-driven insights to directly influence the work of peers. Direction: Manages day-to-day responsibilities and assigned projects with minimal guidance, identifying and managing personal priorities in urgent situations. Base de conocimientos: aplicar de forma autónoma los principios de manufactura y poseer conocimientos prácticos de las propiedades de los materiales, los procesos de manufactura clave y los procesos de costos, sin necesidad de instrucciones frecuentes. Presentación y narración: desarrollar y presentar un caso de negocio atractivo para explicar el análisis de costos de los componentes y convencer a las partes interesadas para que utilicen los resultados para generar oportunidades financieras. Habilidades técnicas: demostrar un uso avanzado de aPriori o Costdata, modificando de forma autónoma los ajustes y opciones de los procesos de estimación de costos, aprovechando a la vez la cadena de herramientas completa (PLM, CATIA, etc.). Influencia organizacional y divulgación: informar de los resultados a sus homólogos directos y apoyarse en conclusiones basadas en datos para ejercer influencia directa en el trabajo de sus colegas. Dirección: gestionar las responsabilidades del día a día y los proyectos asignados con un mínimo de orientación, identificando y gestionando las prioridades personales en situaciones de urgencia. Qualifications Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience. Domain Expertise: Understands how their work informs sourcing decisions, design trade-offs, and supplier negotiations, providing foundational data-driven input to cross-functional teams. Commodity-Specific Experience: Interior content – Seat Assembly, Hard Trim, Soft Trim (cutting, sewing, wrapping), Seat structures Technical Skills: Advanced user of various systems with the ability to conduct larger-scale gap analysis to identify focus areas and outliers. Communication: Confidently fields questions from peers and is learning to tailor their communication style to different audiences. Execution: Proactively communicates issues that have an impact outside of Cost Engineering, flagging risks and opportunities to the relevant teams. Operational Style: Consistently uses first principles to drive change and responds actively to feedback from senior team members to close skill gaps. Travel Requirements: Ability and willingness to travel as needed based on business needs, up to 25%. Educación y experiencia: licenciatura en Ingeniería o un campo relacionado y un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia relevante. Experiencia en el campo: comprender cómo su trabajo influye en las decisiones de abastecimiento, las contrapartidas de diseño y las negociaciones con los proveedores, aportando información fundamental basada en datos a equipos multifuncionales. Experiencia específica en categorías de productos: Contenido de interior: conjunto de asientos, revestimientos rígidos, tapicería (corte, costura, revestimiento), estructuras de asientos Habilidades técnicas: usuario avanzado de diversos sistemas, con la capacidad de realizar análisis de deficiencias a mayor escala, a fin de identificar áreas prioritarias y valores atípicos. Comunicación: responder con seguridad a las preguntas de sus colegas y saber adaptar su estilo de comunicación a los distintos públicos. Ejecución: comunicar de forma proactiva aquellos problemas con un impacto más allá de Cost Engineering, señalando los riesgos y las oportunidades a los equipos pertinentes. Estilo operacional: basarse continuamente en los principios fundamentales para impulsar el cambio y responder de forma activa a los comentarios de los miembros sénior del equipo, con el objetivo de subsanar las carencias de competencias. jobs.description:
UPSTARS – продуктова IT-компанія, з якою злітають і люди, і бренди. Наш основний фокус – технологічні рішення та B2B-послуги для міжнародних клієнтів. Запускаємо зіркові проєкти у сфері iGaming, які отримують визнання та найвищі оцінки профільних рейтингів ✨

І так, підтримувати легальний та прозорий ринок України – це маст хев, тому третіми в країні отримали B2B-ліцензію на надання послуг у сфері азартних ігор.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення QA департаменту шукаємо Senior Manual QA.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • аналіз і тестування вимог, участь в обговоренні завдань;

  • тестування API (REST): перевірка запитів, відповідей, кодів статусів, граничних та негативних сценаріїв;

  • написання та підтримка тест-кейсів, чек-листів для API-специфічних сценаріїв;

  • оцінка і планування задач;

  • мануальне тестування змін (функціональне, регресійне, приймальне), включно з інтеграційним тестуванням між сервісами;

  • аналіз звітів проходження автотестів;

  • доставка коду на тестове середовище та продакшн;

  • локалізація і документація дефектів;

  • надання інформації іншим відділам;

  • супровід фіч та багів в циклі STLC;

  • взаємодія з backend/frontend розробниками та продакт-менеджерами для уточнення вимог до API.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • досвід тестування web-продуктів та API (сайти, CMS, REST-сервіси);

  • розуміння клієнт-серверної архітектури та основ роботи з API;

  • впевнений практичний досвід тестування API: робота з Postman та Swagger/OpenAPI;

  • розуміння HTTP: методи запитів, коди статусів, заголовки, базові механізми автентифікації;

  • базові знання HTML/CSS — достатні для читання розмітки та стилів сторінки;

  • вміння аналізувати логи та діагностувати проблеми;

  • навички роботи в Jira, Git, qase та альтернативні TMS;

  • застосування технік тест-дизайну;

  • досвід роботи з DevTools та BrowserStack;

  • уважність до деталей та відповідальний підхід до роботи.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • досвід роботи в iGaming;

  • досвід тестування мікросервісної архітектури: розуміння залежностей між сервісами;

  • знайомство з message-driven системами (RabbitMQ, Kafka або подібні);

  • досвід тестування websocket-з'єднань / real-time API;

  • досвід автоматизації API-тестів (Postman/Newman) як додаткова перевага до мануального тестування.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

Відчуваєш метч за цінностями і бажання професійно зростати? Давай знайомитися! 😉

P.S. Якщо після відгуку не бачиш нашого листа – зазирни у “Спам” або інші розділи. Іноді наші відповіді губляться там 👀

Job Title: Director of Product- Media OS Activation, IQVIA Digital

Job Location: Chicago, Illinois, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

About IQVIA Digital

IQVIA Digital powers exceptional brand experiences, delivering innovative solutions based on a customer-first, insights-driven, and integrated omnichannel vision. We provide authenticated, privacy-enhanced data and analytics, innovative fit-for-purpose healthcare technology, and the expertise to enable an effective and adaptable marketing model that drives better quality of care and patient outcomes. IQVIA is the leading global provider of data, advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services for the life sciences industry. Learn more at

The Product Team

The Product team is responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for IQVIA Digital's portfolio of data, technology, and media solutions. Through close partnership with clients and cross-functional collaboration with Go-to-Market, Technology, Data Management, and Operations teams, the team translates market insights and customer needs into innovative, scalable products. Built upon IQVIA's industry-leading healthcare data assets and privacy-by-design foundation, these solutions deliver differentiated value to clients, drive business growth, and advance IQVIA Digital's leadership in the healthcare marketing ecosystem.

We are seeking a visionary and execution-oriented Director, Product – Media OS to lead the Activation POD of our flagship platform and drive innovation at the intersection of healthcare, data, and advertising technology.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

  • Help establish Media OS as a market-leading operating system for healthcare marketing.
  • Deliver seamless orchestration across channels, partners, and activation platforms.
  • Differentiate IQVIA Digital through industry-leading data, identity, and performance capabilities.
  • Enable AI-powered optimization that delivers measurable improvements in campaign effectiveness and efficiency.

Position Overview

The Director, Product – Media OS will inform the vision, strategy, roadmap, and market success of IQVIA Digital’s flagship healthcare marketing platform.

This Activation POD leader will drive the transformation of Media OS from a unified omnichannel marketing platform into an intelligent, AI-powered audience and activation ecosystem that enables healthcare organizations to deliver highly personalized, privacy-compliant marketing experiences at scale.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in adtech, martech, digital platforms, data-driven SaaS products, and omnichannel marketing ecosystems, combined with a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Lead a team of highly skilled individuals overseeing the activation portion of the Media OS.
  • Lead integrations with activation partners and ensure consistent reporting is provided to the platform.
  • Help define and lead the long-term product vision for Media OS, aligning with IQVIA Digital’s mission to deliver personalized, data-driven healthcare marketing solutions.
  • Drive the evolution of Media OS into an intelligent, AI-powered audience and activation platform.

jobs.title: Senior Media Buyer
jobs.excerpt: Job Title: MVA Lead Generation Senior Media Buyer I want to hire you… and pay you a lot of money.
jobs.description:
Job Title: MVA Lead Generation Senior Media Buyer

I want to hire you… and pay you a lot of money.

But this role isn't for most media buyers.

If you’re a senior media buyer based in the U.S. who is already actively managing accounts spending 7 figures per month on Meta and/or Google, keep reading.

Because if you're genuinely elite at media buying, obsessed with performance, and want to operate at a scale where small improvements can have massive impact, this could be the opportunity you're looking for.

We operate at serious scale.

You'll be working across 7-figure monthly advertising budgets, multiple platforms, multiple states and markets, and a creative operation capable of producing and testing a massive volume of new ads.

We don't need someone to simply maintain what we've built.

We want someone who can help us make it significantly better.

The Role

This is not a traditional media buyer role.

We don't need someone who waits for instructions, adjusts budgets, turns off bad ads, and calls it media buying.

And we definitely don't need someone who requires leadership to constantly tell them where the next opportunity is.

We're looking for someone who can take real ownership over performance.

Someone who can look across Meta, Google, states, campaigns, and hundreds of creatives and quickly determine:

  • Where should we spend more?
  • Where should we spend less?
  • What's starting to work that we haven't fully capitalized on yet?
  • Why is this state underperforming?
  • What winning ads haven't we expanded yet?
  • What creative are we missing?
  • What should we test next?

Then actually execute.

You won't just optimize campaigns.

You'll help determine where the next level of growth comes from.

What You’ll Actually Own

1. Performance & Scaling

  • You’ll help manage and optimize high-spend campaigns across Meta and Google, including YouTube, Search, and Performance Max.
  • You'll continuously look across platforms and states to identify:
  • Scaling opportunities
  • Budget reallocation opportunities
  • Performance inefficiencies
  • Underperforming markets
  • Testing gaps
  • New strategies worth implementing

We expect you to understand where our money is going, what it's producing, and where the next dollar should be spent.

You'll work with other media buyers and leadership on cross-platform and state-level budget strategy to hit our volume and profitability goals.

2. Creative Expansion

At our scale, media buying and creative strategy cannot operate separately.

You'll know our best-performing ads.

You'll know our best-performing angles.

You'll know which concepts are starting to gain traction.

And you'll make sure we capitalize on them.

That means constantly thinking:

“This is working here → why aren't we running it here, here, and here?”

“This angle is crushing on Meta → let's test it on YouTube.”

“This state-specific concept is working → let's build it for every relevant market.”

“We're relying too heavily on UGC here → let's expand our creative diversity.”

“This angle is starting to work → creative team needs to build 10 more variations before everyone else catches it.”

You’ll bridge the gap between performance data and the creative team.

The creative team should always know what’s working, what’s starting to work, what’s getting fatigued, and what we need more of.

3. Underperforming Markets

When a state isn't producing enough volume, your job isn't simply to say:

"Performance is bad."

Your job is to figure out why.

Is it creative?

Campaign structure?

Budget allocation?

Lack of creative diversity?

A winning angle we haven't brought over from another market?

Platform mix?

Audience?

Offer?

Landing page?

Then build and execute a plan to improve it.

We want problem solvers, not reporters.

4. Media Buying Operations

You'll help own the operational side of running advertising at scale.

That includes:

  • Weekly and monthly spend planning and pacing
  • Cross-platform and state-level budget allocation
  • Campaign launches
  • Creative launches across Meta and Google
  • Key media buying Google Sheets and reporting
  • Performance tracking
  • Testing frameworks
  • Campaign structure
  • Account organization
  • Making sure nothing falls through the cracks

You'll know how our campaigns are structured and understand what is happening across the accounts without needing someone else to explain it to you.

5. Account Monitoring

When you're responsible for significant advertising spend, performance doesn't stop because it's Saturday.

You'll be expected to check campaigns over weekends when necessary to ensure:

  • Nothing is broken
  • Spend is behaving correctly
  • Volume remains healthy
  • Major performance issues are caught quickly
  • High-spending problem campaigns or ads aren't running unchecked

You'll also occasionally need to turn campaigns on/off or make critical changes outside normal business hours when directed by Quintessa leadership.

This isn't about unnecessarily working 24/7.

It's about understanding the responsibility that comes with operating large advertising budgets.

6. Innovation

We don't want someone who only knows how to execute our existing playbook.

We want you improving it.

You should constantly be paying attention to:

  • What other elite advertisers are doing
  • New Meta strategies
  • New Google strategies
  • Creative trends
  • New campaign structures
  • New platforms
  • New tools
  • New testing methodologies
  • Opportunities we're currently missing

Then ask:

“How can we use this?”

Bring ideas.

Challenge existing assumptions.

Run tests.

Learn from them.

Then iterate.

The Standard

This is not a “set it and forget it” media buying role.

We move fast.

We spend aggressively when something works.

We cut things when they don't.

We test constantly.

We expect people to communicate quickly and make decisions.

And we're obsessed with finding incremental improvements because at our scale, small improvements compound into massive results.

You should naturally find yourself checking performance because you're curious about what happened.

You should get excited when you find an ad that's starting to take off.

You should be annoyed when you see an obvious scaling opportunity sitting untouched.

You should constantly be asking:

“What can we do today to drive more volume at a lower cost?”

Who This Is NOT For

This role is NOT for you if:

  • You're not based in the United States
  • You've never actively managed 7-figure monthly ad spend
  • You don't genuinely love media buying
  • You're primarily looking for a comfortable 9-to-5
  • You need someone else to identify every opportunity for you
  • You spend more time reporting problems than solving them
  • You default to “let's wait for more data” every time a decision needs to be made
  • You just want to optimize campaigns and push buttons
  • You don't understand creative diversity
  • You don't understand how creative impacts media buying performance
  • You rarely bring new ideas to the table
  • You're afraid to make decisions
  • You lack urgency
  • You aren't constantly trying to improve your craft
  • You want responsibility without accountability

Who This IS For

This role IS for you if:

  • You've actively managed $1M+ per month in ad spend
  • You're highly experienced with Meta and/or Google
  • You live and breathe media buying aka you LOVE THE GAME
  • You can look at large amounts of performance data and quickly identify what matters
  • You can spot potential winning ads early and know how to expand them
  • You understand budget allocation at scale
  • You think beyond individual campaigns and understand performance across platforms, markets, and creatives
  • You understand creative diversity and how it impacts performance
  • You naturally think in angles, patterns, distribution, and opportunities
  • You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information
  • You're extremely analytical without becoming slow
  • You're proactive rather than reactive
  • You bring solutions, not just problems
  • You're constantly bringing new ideas and tests to the table
  • You're competitive with yourself and want to get better every week
  • You want your decisions to actually matter
  • You want exposure to massive budgets, an elite creative operation, and real decision-making authority
  • You want your income and responsibility to scale with your impact

If you “love the game,” which we call ads, you'll feel at home here.

What You Get

This is the part that should excite the right person.

You'll get:

  • Massive budgets to work with
  • A creative team capable of producing and iterating on ideas quickly
  • Enough data to make meaningful decisions fast
  • The ability to test ideas without fighting for tiny budgets
  • Direct access to leadership
  • Real influence over media buying strategy
  • The ability to see your decisions translate into millions of dollars of spend
  • An environment that rewards performance and initiative
  • The opportunity to build systems and strategies that operate at serious scale

A lot of media buyers eventually hit a ceiling because their company can't give them more budget, more creative, or more room to operate.

We can.

Compensation & Growth

We want exceptional people, and we're willing to pay for them.

$8,000-$14,000/month ($96,000-$168,000/year) depending on experience and skill level.

Plus:

  • Monthly performance-based bonuses
  • Clear opportunities for increased compensation
  • Increased ownership as you prove yourself
  • Opportunity to take on greater leadership within the media buying department

Your upside should increase as your impact increases.

We treat growth like a game.

And we reward people who win.

Final Note

We're building something serious here.

If your goal is to find the easiest media buying job possible, this isn't it.

But if you're obsessed with advertising and want to operate at a level where you're working with massive budgets, huge amounts of data, an elite creative team, and real responsibility, pay attention.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just want to manage campaigns.

We're looking for someone who wants to become one of the best media buyers in the game.

About Quintessa

Quintessa Marketing is a high-performance marketing and intake company supporting personal injury law firms nationwide.

Since 2016, Quintessa has delivered more than 100,000 motor vehicle retainers and achieved sustained double- and triple-digit year-over-year growth. We are building toward a billion-dollar future with a team that values performance, ownership, and impact.

Quintessa donates 50% of its profits to charities, schools, and nonprofit organizations.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Quintessa Marketing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Sponsorship is not available at this time.

If interested, please complete this survey ->

Salary: $8,000 – $14,000 / month

  • Help analyze underperforming states and identify potential reasons performance is struggling
  • Analyze winning ads from other states and platforms to find opportunities we haven't tested yet
  • Review creative diversity across campaigns and identify missing formats, styles, angles, or concepts
  • Research competitors and bring interesting ads, strategies, and ideas to the team
  • Communicate performance insights to our creative team so they understand what’s working and what we should create more of
  • Bring new ideas and observations to senior media buyers instead of waiting to be told everything to look for
  • Continuously improve your understanding of scaling, creative strategy, campaign structure, budget allocation, and performance analysis

You won't be expected to know everything on Day 1.

But you will be expected to learn fast, execute fast, ask good questions, and continuously become a better media buyer.

This is not a “set it and forget it” role.

We move fast, test constantly, and care deeply about performance.

What Makes This Role Different

A lot of junior media buying roles mean spending your entire day launching ads and following instructions.

That's not what we're looking for.

Yes, you'll execute.

Yes, you'll assist our senior media buyers.

But we also want you to think.

We want you to start developing the ability to:

  • Spot trends in performance
  • Recognize winning ads earlier
  • Understand why certain creatives are working
  • Identify scaling opportunities
  • Identify inefficient spend
  • Understand creative diversity
  • Think across states, platforms, and campaigns
  • Bring ideas to the team
  • Turn performance data into actionable insights

You'll have experienced people around you to learn from, but the expectation is that over time you'll need less direction and take on more ownership.

Who This Is NOT For

  • You’re not based in the United States
  • You have little to no hands-on media buying experience
  • You’ve never worked inside 6-figure monthly spend ad accounts
  • You don't genuinely enjoy media buying
  • You're looking for a job where you can simply complete a checklist and clock out
  • You want to push buttons without understanding why you're doing something
  • You don't like looking at performance data
  • You lack urgency or attention to detail
  • You need constant hand-holding
  • You're afraid to ask questions when you don't understand something
  • You aren't interested in creative strategy
  • You don't keep up with what's happening across Meta, Google, advertising, and creative
  • You're comfortable doing the same thing for years without improving

Who This IS For

This role is for you if:

  • You have experience working inside 6-figure monthly ad spend accounts
  • You have hands-on experience with Meta and/or Google Ads
  • You love media buying and want to master it
  • You're hungry to eventually manage significantly larger budgets
  • You enjoy looking at data and figuring out why performance is moving
  • You understand that creative is one of the biggest drivers of paid advertising performance
  • You're interested in learning how winning ads and angles are scaled across markets
  • You're extremely detail-oriented
  • You're fast and reliable when something needs to get done
  • You ask good questions and learn quickly
  • You take feedback well and implement it
  • You bring ideas and observations to the team instead of staying silent
  • You want to work around people who are extremely serious about advertising
  • You want exposure to massive budgets, high-performing creatives, and sophisticated media buying strategies
  • You want your responsibility and compensation to increase as your skills improve

If you “love the game,” which we call ads, you'll feel at home here.

Compensation & Growth

Compensation is based on experience and skill level.

$70,000 - $100,000 per year

Monthly bonuses based on performance goals.

More importantly, there is a clear path to increased ownership, responsibility, and compensation.

The goal isn't for you to stay a Junior Media Buyer forever.

As you prove that you can make smart decisions, identify opportunities, and consistently improve performance, you'll be trusted with larger budgets and more responsibility.

We want people who want to become exceptional at what they do, and we reward people as their impact grows.

Final Note

We’re building something serious here.

You’ll be working inside accounts spending amounts that most media buyers never get the opportunity to touch.

You’ll work alongside experienced media buyers and a creative team producing and testing a massive volume of ads.

And you'll have the opportunity to learn how advertising works when you're operating at serious scale.

We're not expecting you to walk in knowing everything.

We are expecting you to be hungry enough to learn it.

If you love ads, want to become an elite media buyer, and want an environment where you can dramatically accelerate your growth, this might be the role for you.

  • Establish and administer systems to capture and report on contractual terms to help with institutional oversight and administration, including details on entities, currencies, annual commitments, etc.
  • Coordinate contracts from initial request through review, approval, execution, filing, renewal, and expiration.
  • Maintain accurate contract data, including parties, contract type, effective dates, expiration dates, renewal terms, responsible department, and status.
  • Monitor contract deadlines, renewal periods, expiration dates, and other key contract obligations and provide advance notifications to stakeholders.
  • Maintain executed agreements and supporting documentation in accordance with document retention requirements.
  • Coordinate electronic signature processes utilizing DocuSign or similar platforms.
  • Manage and maintain contract tracking systems, contract databases, and contract-management software.
  • Assist with other administrative and legal matters, as needed.

  • 3+ years of experience in contract administration, contract management, legal operations, paralegal work, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with consulting agreements, independent contractor agreements, vendor agreements, software licenses, non-disclosure agreements, grant agreements, and other routine organizational contracts.

jobs.title: Tax Software QA & Support Analyst
jobs.excerpt: This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones.
jobs.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.

A Different Kind Of Job Description

At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.

What's hard about this job

Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.

Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.

The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.

It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.

Why it might be the best career move you'll make

You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.

Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.

You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.

We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.

What You'll Own

  • Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use

  • Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away

  • Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox

  • Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving

  • Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases

  • Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread

Your Hard Skillset

  • Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team

  • Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk

  • A tax background, either at a tax or accounting firm, at a tax software company, or preparing returns yourself. You don't need to be a preparer, but you should know your way around a return.

  • Familiarity with at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem

  • Bonus if you've used Linear or Jira, browser developer tools or screen recording to capture issues

Your Soft Skillset

  • Methodical: you change one thing at a time until you find what breaks

  • Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion

  • Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did

  • Calm and patient with customers who are under deadline pressure

  • You take ownership and follow a problem through to the fix

Who This Suits

  • People who enjoy hunting down a problem more than answering the same question twice

  • Support professionals who want to move into QA and product

  • Tax professionals who want to move into tech without leaving their expertise behind

How We Pay

Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone sees everyone else's salary, and compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone at the same level receives the same three offers.

This role is assessed at Level 1. The salary and equity bandings are:

  • Most Equity: $66,000 per year + $100,020 of equity

  • Great Equity: $72,000 per year + $66,680 of equity

  • Good Equity: $78,000 per year + $33,340 of equity

We run performance reviews every four months, so strong work is recognized quickly.

Benefits

  • Platinum-level medical insurance, fully covered for you, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well

  • Dental insurance

  • Vision insurance

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

  • A minimum of 30 days of paid holiday every year

  • Your choice of the latest and greatest computers, plus a budget for your home office setup

  • Company-wide offsites every four months

The process

  • Quick intro call (30 minutes)

  • Bug reproduction exercise: we give you a real-style customer report, you reproduce the issue and write the ticket (60 minutes)

  • Final round with Rachel and the team (60 minutes)

About Filed

Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms. It works inside the software firms already use, and takes on the work surrounding the accountant so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and their clients. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog and Raine.

About SemiAnalysis

SemiAnalysis is an independent research and analysis firm specializing in the Semiconductor and AI industries. Our in-depth coverage spans the entire supply chain, from semiconductor fabrication processes to cutting-edge AI Models, software, and infrastructure. We are recognized as the leading authority on the semiconductor supply chain, with the highest concentration of industry experts within one team, and a deep-rooted passion for delving into the intricacies.

We are a global team of analysts, each with extensive networks across the semiconductor supply chain and AI ecosystem, publishing industry shaping articles while participating in numerous conferences annually.

Our newsletters reach more than 200,000 subscribers worldwide, including senior management and c-suite leaders at the leading semiconductor and AI companies.

We also offer three core products:

  • Industry Models – we develop and publish industry models on accelerator shipments, datacentre demand and supply, GPU total cost of ownership, and more. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, many of the world’s largest hedge funds, and government agencies.

  • Core Research – our public equity markets product, geared towards financial investors, distils our deep technical research and knowledge into key insights on technology and product trends.

  • Consulting and Technical Due Diligence – We conduct custom research and project work to guide key strategic and investment decisions for the largest private equity funds, leading venture capital firms, companies across the AI ecosystem, and government agencies.

Position Overview

SemiAnalysis is seeking an AI Infrastructure Credit Research Analyst to lead our coverage of how the global AI infrastructure buildout is financed.

This role will examine who is providing capital, how financing arrangements are structured, the terms attached to that capital, and where the underlying financial risk ultimately sits. The analysis will combine SemiAnalysis’s proprietary datacenter and semiconductor supply chain data with detailed balance-sheet, credit, and financial intermediation research.

The successful candidate will build the firm’s coverage of AI infrastructure credit from the ground up, producing definitive research for credit investors, limited partners, financial institutions, regulators, and other market participants.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze the full financing stack supporting the AI infrastructure buildout, including:

    • Hyperscalers balance sheets

    • Neoclouds and AI cloud debt

    • GPU-backed lending

    • Datacenter asset-backed securities

    • Project finance

    • Private credit funds

    • Business development companies

    • Special-purpose vehicles

    • Vendor financing arrangements

  • Map financing relationships across the AI ecosystem, identifying:

    • Who is lending to whom

    • The terms and maturity profiles of the financing

    • The structures through which capital is provided

    • The parties ultimately holding the credit and asset risk

  • Build quantitative models to assess credit risk across AI infrastructure investments.

  • Evaluate counterparty exposure, concentration risk, and dependencies across borrowers, lenders, investors, equipment vendors, and infrastructure providers.

  • Model the value and resilience of collateral, including:

    • GPU depreciation and residual value

    • Power purchase agreements

    • Datacenter leases

    • Capacity contracts

    • Equipment financing arrangements

  • Analyze interest-rate sensitivity, refinancing requirements, maturity walls, covenant structures, and liquidity risks.

  • Develop downside and stress scenarios to assess how weaker demand, declining hardware values, delayed construction, power constraints, or tighter financial conditions could affect borrowers and lenders.

  • Track the migration of lending activity from regulated banks to nonbank financial institutions.

  • Assess how the growth of private credit and nonbank lending changes where financial risk is concentrated and how losses could spread during a downturn.

  • Produce flagship research reports and recurring coverage on AI infrastructure financing and credit markets.

  • Build proprietary datasets from bank reports, fund filings, corporate disclosures, securitization documents, loan agreements, and other financial sources.

  • Work closely with SemiAnalysis’s datacenter, semiconductor, energy, and supply chain teams to ensure financial analysis is grounded in what is physically being built, contracted, delivered, and energized.

  • Present research findings to clients and represent SemiAnalysis’s credit views through public writing, meetings, podcasts, conferences, and other industry discussions.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in credit markets, banking, financial intermediation, structured finance, or related areas.

  • Relevant background may include:

    • Bachelors' Degree in financial economics or a related discipline

    • Sell-side credit or macroeconomic research

    • Buy-side credit research

    • Central bank or financial stability research

    • Private credit or structured finance experience

    • Equivalent professional research experience

  • Strong understanding of corporate, bank, and investment fund balance sheets.

  • Ability to independently interpret complex financial documents, including:

    • Bank call reports

    • Corporate filings

    • Fund and BDC disclosures

    • Asset-backed securities documentation

    • Credit agreements

    • Project finance structures

    • Special-purpose vehicle documentation

  • Strong credit judgement and the ability to identify hidden leverage, off-balance-sheet exposure, weak collateral, refinancing risk, and structural subordination.

  • Strong empirical and quantitative skills, including the ability to build original datasets and analytical models.

  • Ability to validate assumptions, defend methodologies, and clearly explain the limitations of available data.

  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, rigorous research for a demanding professional audience.

  • Ability to work accurately and efficiently under publication deadlines.

  • High level of intellectual independence and willingness to publish conclusions that may differ from prevailing market views.

Preferred Skills

  • Research or investment experience covering:

    • Private credit

    • Nonbank financial institutions

    • Leveraged finance

    • Structured credit

    • Asset-backed securities

    • Project finance

    • Financial stability

    • Bank and nonbank intermediation

  • Understanding of how financial intermediation has evolved since the 2008 global financial crisis.

  • Named authorship on published research from a:

    • Sell-side research team

    • Central bank

    • Bank economics team

    • International Monetary Fund

    • Bank for International Settlements

    • Policy or financial research institution

  • Experience analyzing interest rates and the transmission of monetary policy into lending standards, credit availability, asset values, and refinancing conditions.

  • Familiarity with datacenters, semiconductor economics, AI infrastructure, or power markets.

  • Experience analyzing infrastructure financing structures or capital-intensive technology investment cycles.

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, Excel, or other tools used for financial modelling and data analysis.

  • Experience working with large, fragmented, or difficult-to-structure financial datasets.

  • Strong presentation and client communication skills.

Growth Areas

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Define SemiAnalysis’s AI infrastructure credit and financing coverage from the ground up.

  • Become a leading industry voice on how the AI buildout is financed and where the associated financial risks are concentrated.

  • Build proprietary credit datasets using SemiAnalysis’s unique information on datacenter construction, power availability, accelerator shipments, hardware deployments, and supply chain activity.

  • Develop original risk frameworks for emerging financing structures such as GPU-backed lending, neoclouds debt, private credit facilities, and AI infrastructure securitizations.

  • Expand coverage into adjacent areas such as:

    • Datacenter project finance

    • Energy infrastructure financing

    • Structured credit

    • Financial stability

    • Private market leverage

    • Vendor and equipment financing

    • Monetary policy and credit transmission

  • Work directly with credit investors, private credit firms, banks, asset managers, limited partners, regulators, and companies involved in financing AI infrastructure.

  • Publish research that becomes reference material for the industry and contributes to policy and regulatory discussions.

  • Grow into a leadership role overseeing broader credit, financial markets, and capital structure research within SemiAnalysis.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.
jobs.description:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.

Requirements

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

Highlights

Build next-generation AI agents using C#, Azure, MCP and Azure OpenAI. Join AnywhereNow's Agent Factory team to create enterprise AI solutions that move from concept to production.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Game Developer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Game Developers to contribute to a pioneering customer project focused on evaluating and advancing AI capabilities in the domain of game creation and interaction. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Leverage your hands-on experience to build authentic debugging and feature challenges within real game projects, directly impacting how AI agents learn to analyze, play, and develop games. Developers from all backgrounds—whether from AAA studios, indie circles, or solo projects—are encouraged to participate.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and build small-scale game projects or interactive scenes in a major game engine to serve as the foundation for assessment tasks.
  2. Integrate realistic gameplay bugs that require thorough playtesting and on-screen analysis to discover and resolve.
  3. Develop multifaceted gameplay feature challenges that rely on multiple in-game systems and mechanics.
  4. Draft clear and concise briefs for each task, emulating the style of instructions from players, designers, or producers.
  5. Create comprehensive reference solutions—including both bug fixes and feature implementations—for every assignment.
  6. Define detailed success criteria, including input sequences, expected visual outcomes, and verifiable in-game states.
  7. Conduct end-to-end playtesting of each task to guarantee reliability and solvability.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated experience in game development, whether in AAA, indie, solo, or serious hobby contexts.
  2. A portfolio or verifiable published work (personal site, itch.io, Steam, GitHub, game jam entries, or shipped title credits). Your portfolio is the most important part of your application and plays a major role in our selection, so please include the work that best represents your skills.
  3. Advanced proficiency with at least one major game engine (Unity, Godot, Unreal), including editor tools, scene management, and debugging utilities.
  4. Comfort with engine scripting languages such as C#, GDScript, C++, or Blueprints, with the ability to interpret, troubleshoot, and enhance gameplay logic.
  5. Proven ability to identify and resolve gameplay issues through iterative playtesting.
  6. Strong written communication skills for drafting precise task instructions and acceptance criteria.
  7. Experience in game QA, technical design, systems design, automated testing, or prior contribution to AI evaluation projects is a plus.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Job Title: Lead, Information Security

Location: 55 Water Street, New York, NY 10041 (Telecommuting permitted from anywhere within the U.S.)


Job Duties: S&P Global Inc. seeks a Lead, Information Security who will perform security analysis and communicating vulnerabilities identified in web applications with stakeholders, developers, and senior management. Provide scoping data to assist in developing project proposals. Create detailed assessment reports describing identified security weaknesses, potential business risks, and prioritizes mitigation recommendations. Develop improved methodologies, processes, infrastructure, tools, and deliverables that contribute to the ongoing enhancement of vulnerability assessment capabilities. Gather requirements from Business Analysts and Application Owners. Incorporate and define security requirements, map security requirements and define the data flow diagrams, and deliver threat models in the design phase. Provide strategic direction and tactical oversight for major security projects, including penetration tests, patch management, change control, application security, and infrastructure security. Perform application security assessments for native, web, and hybrid applications using open source and commercial tools. Report key metrics to executive management and reporting on the health of applications and infrastructure components, interacting with application owners and product engineering team to share the assessment results.


Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related IT field plus 5 years of experience in the job offered or related occupation. 5 years of experience must include: Utilizing enterprise-grade Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools, including Fortify, to tune rulesets, integrate SAST into complex pipelines, and interpret false positives with accuracy. Using Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) tools, including Burp Suite Pro and OWASP Zap, to review black-box and gray-box testing efforts, including logic flaw exploitation. Managing open-source risk across large codebases, using Mend to perform Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and conducting manual code reviews across multiple programming languages, including Java, Python, C# and either JavaScript or Node.js. Conducting formal threat modeling using frameworks, including STRIDE, PASTA, or MITRE framework, and integrating threat modeling into architectural and design phases of the SDLC. Building, scaling, and managing secure SDLC programs in large organizations, including embedding security into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps. Applying or mapping application security controls to regulations, including DORA, ISO/IEC 27034, NIST 800-53 / SSDF, and SOC 2 Type II and performing remediation efforts or assessments tied to audits and regulatory reviews. Application security across distributed product teams, including managing security for hundreds of applications across varied stacks and creating centralized risk dashboards using ServiceNow or similar platforms. Scoping, coordinating, and validating results from external/internal pentests and translating test findings into actionable development tasks, prioritizing remediation based on risk. Securing applications in multi-cloud environments, including AWS (IAM, Cognito, API Gateway, Lambda) and Azure (App Services, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud), as well as integrating application security tooling and controls within cloud-native CI/CD workflows.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer with strong expertise in .NET (C#) and React/JavaScript to join an innovative engineering team building scalable, high-quality web applications.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across both front-end and back-end development, takes ownership of their work, and enjoys solving complex technical challenges.

This is an AI-first engineering environment where AI-assisted and agentic development are integral to the software development process. You should have hands-on experience leveraging AI coding assistants and autonomous agents to accelerate development, improve efficiency, and deliver reliable solutions.

Beyond using AI tools, you must be able to critically evaluate, test, and take ownership of AI-generated code, ensuring it meets production standards.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using .NET (C#) and React/JavaScript.

  • Build responsive front-end experiences and reliable back-end services.

  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services.

  • Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic workflows throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Review, debug, test, and validate AI-generated code to ensure quality, security, and maintainability.

  • Collaborate with engineering and cross-functional teams to design and deliver new features.

  • Participate in code reviews and follow established development standards.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize application performance.

  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Stay current with emerging technologies, development practices, and AI-powered engineering tools.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in full-stack software development.

  • Strong proficiency in .NET (C#) and experience developing back-end applications.

  • Solid front-end development skills with React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

  • Hands-on professional experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic development tools to build, debug, and improve software.

  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs.

  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and data modeling.

  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows.

  • Understanding of web application security best practices.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to adapt to new technologies and continuously develop technical skills.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

  • Experience customizing AI development workflows, including custom prompts, tool integrations, or multi-agent systems.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies.

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

Compensation & Engagement Details

  • Engagement: International Independent contractor

  • Compensation: USD $23–26/hour (approximately $3,680–$4,160/month).

  • Timesheets: Hours worked must be documented and submitted through timesheets.

  • Time Off: Days off, sick days, and local public holidays are unpaid and non-billable. There may be opportunities to work on certain holidays.

  • Equipment: The company will provide and ship the required hardware.

  • Expected Start Date: Approximately four weeks after signing the offer to allow for equipment shipment and setup.

Recruitment Process

Candidates can expect the following steps:

  1. Latino Legends Application: Complete our application for through our website.

  2. Recorded Screening Questionnaire: Short recorded responses to help us assess your experience and communication skills. Successful candidates will be submitted to the client's ATS.

  3. Initial Technical Challenge: A one-hour technical exercise. Candidates are not expected to complete the entire task; the goal is to demonstrate their approach and problem-solving skills.

  4. Hiring Manager Interview: Discuss your technical challenge, approach, and implementation decisions.

  5. Peer Interview: Meet with members of the engineering team.

  6. Final Interview: Conversation with the SVP of Engineering.

  7. Reference Checks: Successful finalists will be asked to provide 2–3 professional references from previous supervisors, managers, or team leaders before the formal offer is issued.

Ready to take the next step in your engineering career? Apply through Latino Legends!
